title: Bookkeeper & Executive Assistant — QuickBooks & Paychex Experience Preferred
description:
We are looking for a highly trustworthy, extremely detail-oriented Bookkeeper & Executive Assistant to help manage the financial and administrative side of an established U.S.-based business.



This is not simply a data-entry bookkeeping position.



I am looking for someone who understands the numbers, catches mistakes, stays ahead of deadlines, and keeps our financial records organized and accurate. You will work closely with me and help make sure everything is properly prepared for payroll, taxes, Paychex, and our CPA.



Bookkeeping & QuickBooks



You will be responsible for helping with:



* Managing and maintaining QuickBooks Online

* Accurately categorizing transactions

* Reconciling bank and credit card accounts

* Reviewing transactions for errors or discrepancies

* Keeping our books current, clean, and organized

* Accounts payable and expense tracking

* Tracking receipts, invoices, bills, and financial documents

* Reviewing financial reports and identifying anything that does not look correct

* Preparing financial information and documentation for our CPA

* Helping make sure our books are tax-ready throughout the year



Payroll, Paychex & State Tax Coordination



Our company uses Paychex for payroll and payroll-related tax filings, so experience with Paychex is highly preferred.



You will help:



* Work with and understand the Paychex payroll system

* Review payroll information for accuracy

* Help prepare payroll information before processing

* Maintain employee payroll records and documentation

* Review payroll reports and reconcile payroll with QuickBooks

* Coordinate with Paychex when there are questions, discrepancies, or changes

* Track payroll-related deadlines and documentation

* Help oversee and verify payroll tax filings handled through Paychex

* Understand and help track employer requirements in Illinois and Indiana

* Maintain organized records related to state payroll taxes and filings

* Work with Paychex and our CPA to make sure required information is provided and records remain accurate



You do not need to be our CPA or tax professional, but you must understand bookkeeping and payroll well enough to know what needs to be completed, what documentation needs to be maintained, and when something does not look right.



Executive Assistant Responsibilities

 and Instagram. You take a script we write, and turn it into a finished video using AI avatars.



What you'll do



Take a written script and a reference video

Create the video using AI tools (avatar, voice, b-roll)

Edit it, add captions, and submit by midnight PHT

Apply feedback so the next batch is better



You'll start with one avatar account (3 videos per day, Monday to Friday). Once you're consistent, you move to two accounts (6 per day). Weekends off.



Pay



$4 per video. At 3 videos a day that's about $260/month. At 6 a day it's about $520/month. Paid on time, every time, no exceptions.



This is a long-term position



We are not looking for someone for one month. My longest editor has been with me for four months and has never had a single complaint about pay, hours, or how they're treated. That's how I run things and it isn't changing.

Hungry. You want to get better, not just get paid.

Consistent. You hit deadlines every day, not most days.

Good instincts. You can look at a video and tell whether it's good, and say why.

You must include proof you actually made them. Any of these works: the project file, the raw export before captions, a screen recording of your timeline, or a link to the account they were posted on. Videos with no proof will not be counted.



With either option, include:



The word BLUEBIRD at the start of your message, so I know you read the whole post

Your 
 username — this is where we do all our work and communication

What AI tools you currently have access to, and which ones you don't

Headline block. A hook plus a headline setting up NuWave as the one place to get everything. Then a CTA button label.

Testing block. Heading plus 2 to 3 sentences. Raw facts: house lines are lab tested. For brands they resell, vendor certificates of analysis are on file and available on request.

Sourcing block. Heading plus 2 to 3 sentences. Raw facts: house lines come from Indonesian farming partners they work with directly, which is how they keep the product consistent year to year.

description:
# AI & Marketing Virtual Assistant | Social Media, CRM & Outreach



**Full-Time | Remote | $5-$9 USD Per Hour**



***IF INTERESTED MAKE SURE TO READ ENTIRE POST AND FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WONT BE CONSIDERED FOR INTERVIEWS***



Are you the type of person who loves technology, marketing, AI, and finding better ways to get things done?



We are a growing Arizona restoration and construction company looking for a **smart, resourceful, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant** who wants to become a long-term member of our team.



This is not a traditional VA position.



You won't spend your entire day doing data entry or managing someone's calendar. You'll have the opportunity to work across **AI, digital marketing, LinkedIn, social media, CRM management, lead generation,
 marketing, automation, and outbound calling.**



We realize that's a unique combination of skills, and we don't expect you to be an expert at everything on day one.



What we're looking for is someone with a strong foundation who **learns quickly, communicates well, is comfortable talking to people, embraces technology, and knows how to use AI to help solve problems and get better results.**



Just as important as your skills, we're looking for the **right person**.



We want someone who is honest, dependable, takes pride in their work, and is looking for a **long-term career with a growing company**. Someone who consistently shows up on time, brings a good attitude, follows through on commitments, and wants to continue learning and improving as we grow together.



We don't expect perfection. We do expect **consistency, accountability, effort, and honesty.**



If you're looking for a position where you can learn new skills, take on more responsibility, contribute ideas, and grow with a company over the long term, **we'd love to hear from you.**



If you're someone who tends to start strong but loses interest or consistency after the first few months, this probably isn't the right position for you.



If this sounds like the type of opportunity you're looking for, keep reading.



# What You'll Work On



## AI & Technology



Technology will be a major part of your job.



We want someone who actively uses AI rather than someone who has only experimented with it.



You may work with:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* GoHighLevel

* Canva

* AI image-generation tools

* Automation platforms

* Marketing software

* CRM systems

* New AI tools as they become available



We especially value people who can be given a goal and figure out how to accomplish it.



If you don't know how to do something, that's okay. What matters is what you do next.



Do you research it? Ask AI? Watch tutorials? Test different solutions? Figure it out?



**That's the type of person we're looking for.**



# LinkedIn & Social Media Marketing



You will help manage the owner's LinkedIn presence and increase our visibility online.



This may include:



* Creating LinkedIn posts

* Brainstorming content ideas

* Using AI to develop and improve content

* Managing connection requests

* Researching potential connections

* Engaging with other people's content

* Writing thoughtful comments

* Following up with connections

* Helping build relationships with potential referral partners

* Tracking LinkedIn activity

* Repurposing content for other platforms

* Scheduling social media content



The goal isn't to spam people.



We want to build a strong professional network, provide useful information, create real relationships, and establish our company and leadership as trusted experts in our industry.



# Content & Creative Marketing



If you enjoy creating things, you'll have plenty of opportunities here.



You may help create:



* Social media graphics

* Flyers

* Marketing materials

* Images

* Social media posts

* Basic videos

*
 content

* Educational content

* Promotional materials



Experience with **Canva is a major plus.**



Experience using AI for content creation, graphic design, image generation, video, or marketing is even better.



# GoHighLevel & CRM



We use technology heavily throughout our business.



**GoHighLevel experience is highly preferred.**



You may help:



* Manage contacts

* Maintain accurate CRM information

* Manage pipelines

* Create tasks

* Manage leads

* Build workflows

* Create automations

* Build follow-up campaigns

* Send SMS campaigns

* Create
 campaigns

* Organize contact lists

* Track lead activity

* Improve existing CRM processes



If you don't have GoHighLevel experience but have extensive experience with another CRM or marketing automation platform, we still want to hear from you.



#
 & SMS Marketing



You may help us create and improve:



*
 campaigns

*
 newsletters

* SMS campaigns

* Follow-up sequences

* Lead nurture campaigns

* Marketing automations

* Contact databases

* Campaign reporting

* A/B testing



We don't want someone who simply pushes buttons.



We want someone interested in understanding **what's working, what's not working, and how we can make it better.**



# Lead Generation & Phone Outreach



This position requires someone who is **comfortable talking to people on the phone.**



You may:



* Make outbound calls

* Follow up with leads

* Speak with potential customers

* Contact homeowners who may have recently experienced property damage

* Contact potential business and referral partners

* Follow scripts and established processes

* Ask questions and gather information

* Schedule appointments

* Follow up by phone, text, and

* Document conversations in our CRM



You don't need to be a professional salesperson.



But you **cannot be afraid to pick up the phone.**



We will provide training, scripts, systems, and processes.



You need to bring confidence, strong communication skills, a willingness to learn, and the ability to have a natural conversation with someone you've never spoken with before.



# The Person We're Looking For



The right person will probably describe themselves as:



* Tech-savvy

* Resourceful

* Creative

* Organized

* Curious

* Dependable

* Adaptable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with people

* Comfortable working independently

* Excited about AI

* Interested in marketing

* Willing to learn

* Able to solve problems

* Comfortable receiving feedback

* Interested in constantly improving



We don't want someone who needs step-by-step instructions forever.



We will train you and give you direction, but over time we want you to **take ownership of your responsibilities.**



If you see a problem, tell us.



Even better, come to us with a possible solution.



# Skills That Will Help You Succeed



You do **not** need experience with everything below.



Experience with any combination of these is valuable:



* AI tools

* ChatGPT

* GoHighLevel

* CRM management

* Marketing automation

* Cold calling

* Lead generation

* Appointment setting

* LinkedIn

* Social media marketing

* Canva

* Graphic design

*
 marketing

* SMS marketing

* Content creation

* Dialpad

* 

* WordPress

* Construction

* Home services

* Restoration

* Roofing



# Schedule



* Full-time

* Approximately 40 hours per week

* Monday through Friday

* Must be available during Arizona business hours

* Remote position

* Long-term opportunity



# Pay



**$5-$9 USD per hour, depending on experience and skill level.**



When applying, please tell us your desired hourly rate.



# What Success Looks Like



We're looking for results, not someone who simply logs into work every day.



Depending on your responsibilities, we may track:



* Leads generated

* Outbound calls

* Conversations

* Appointments

* Follow-up completion

* LinkedIn activity

* Social media output

* Campaign performance

* CRM accuracy

* Marketing output

* Completed projects

* Process improvements



# How to Apply



Please answer **ALL of the questions below.**



We intentionally use a detailed application process because we're looking for someone who can become a valuable, long-term member of our team.



## Basic Information



1. What country and city do you currently live in?



2. What hourly rate are you looking for in USD?



3. Are you available to work approximately 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, during Arizona business hours?

## Cold Calling & Communication



6. Rate your cold-calling ability from 1-10 and explain your rating.

## CRM, GoHighLevel & Automation

15. Imagine a new lead enters our CRM. We want to immediately send a text, create a task for someone to call the lead, send an
 if they don't respond, and automatically stop the follow-up campaign if the customer responds. How would you approach building this?

## Marketing & Social Media

# Video Submission

title: Google Ads Manager – E-Commerce & Investment Campaigns
description:
ob Type: Part-Time initially, with potential for long-term/full-time work

Start: Immediately

Location: Remote – Philippines preferred

Experience: 3+ years of proven Google Ads experience

Industry: E-Commerce / Clothing / Investment



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Google Ads Manager / Google Ads Specialist who can start immediately and take responsibility for managing and optimising our Google advertising campaigns.



We operate an online clothing business and want to significantly increase sales through Google Ads. We are looking for someone who understands how to advertise individual products and product categories, rather than simply running generic search campaigns.



You must be commercially minded and focused on generating actual sales and profitable ROAS, not simply generating clicks or impressions.



There will also be a second project involving the creation and management of a Google Ads campaign for an investment opportunity connected to our company.



Main Responsibilities – Clothing E-Commerce



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing our existing website and Google Ads/Google Merchant Center setup.

* Identifying the products with the greatest sales potential.

* Creating highly targeted Google Shopping / Performance Max / Search campaigns.

* Setting up campaigns around specific products, brands, categories and high-intent searches.

* Reviewing product feeds and identifying any Merchant Center issues.

* Optimising product titles, descriptions, images and other information where required for advertising performance.

* Managing bids, budgets, keywords, audiences and search terms.

* Monitoring conversions and ensuring proper conversion tracking is installed.

* Analysing which products are actually producing profitable sales.

* Cutting wasted advertising spend.

* Scaling campaigns that are performing well.

* Continuously testing different products, audiences, keywords, ads and campaign structures.

* Providing regular reports showing spend, revenue, conversions, CPA and ROAS.



Sales Is the Priority



We are not looking for someone who simply manages an advertising account.



We want someone who understands e-commerce and can help us generate as many profitable sales as possible.



You should be able to look at our website and say:



“These products should be advertised first, this is how I would structure the campaigns, this is the budget I recommend, and this is how we can scale the winners.”



You should be comfortable making decisions based on actual performance data.



Second Project – Investment Opportunity



In addition to the clothing business, we want to create a separate Google Ads campaign for an investment opportunity associated with our company.



You will be expected to:



* Understand the investment proposition.

* Help identify the appropriate target audience.

* Research relevant keywords and audiences.

* Develop appropriate campaign structures.

* Create compelling but compliant ad copy.

* Build landing-page/conversion strategies.

* Set up appropriate tracking.

* Monitor leads and conversion rates.

* Optimise the campaign based on actual results.



Important: You must understand that financial/investment advertising can be subject to Google advertising policies and applicable laws. We expect the successful candidate to work within those requirements and flag any compliance issues before launching campaigns.



We Also Want You to Teach Us



This is very important.



We don’t just want someone to manage the account for us.



We want someone who can teach us what you are doing and why you are doing it.



You should be comfortable sharing your screen with us and explaining:



* How Google Ads works.

* How to create campaigns.

* How to select products.

* How to set budgets.

* How to read campaign data.

* How to identify profitable products.

* How to optimise campaigns.

* How to scale successful campaigns.

* How to identify wasted spend.

* How to use Google Merchant Center.

* How to understand ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC and conversion rates.



We want to build a long-term working relationship where you become our Google Ads expert while also helping us become more knowledgeable ourselves.



Immediate Availability



We need someone who can start immediately.



You must be available for regular communication and be comfortable communicating through WhatsApp, Zoom/Google Meet or similar.



Initially, we would like to work closely together while the accounts are being reviewed and campaigns are built.



Requirements



You MUST have:



* At least 3 years of hands-on Google Ads experience.

* Strong experience with Google Shopping.

* Strong experience with Performance Max.

* Experience with e-commerce businesses.

* Experience advertising individual products.

* Experience with Google Merchant Center.

* Strong understanding of conversion tracking.

* Experience analysing ROAS and profitability.

* Excellent analytical skills.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

* Ability to work independently.

* Immediate availability.



Strongly Preferred



Experience with:



* Fashion/clothing e-commerce.

* Shopify or WooCommerce.

* Product feeds.

* Google Analytics 4.

* Google Tag Manager.

* Merchant Center.

* Performance Max.

* Search campaigns.

* Remarketing.

* Conversion tracking.

* Scaling e-commerce accounts.

* Lead-generation campaigns.

* Financial/investment advertising.



What We Expect From You



We want you to be proactive.



Don’t simply wait for us to tell you what to do.



If you see something wrong, tell us.



If you see an opportunity, tell us.



If you think we are wasting money, tell us.



If you think a particular product could generate significant sales, show us how you would advertise it.



We want someone who thinks like a business owner and understands that £1/$1/AED spent on advertising needs to produce a measurable commercial return.



First Week Objectives



During your first week, we would expect you to:



1. Audit our website.

2. Audit our Google Ads account.

3. Audit Google Merchant Center.

4. Review our product catalogue.

5. Identify tracking problems.

6. Identify immediate opportunities.

7. Identify products worth advertising.

8. Recommend campaign structures.

9. Set up the initial campaigns.

10. Begin optimisation and testing.

11. Explain everything to us as you go.



To Apply



Please DO NOT send a generic application.



In your application, please provide:



1. Your Google Ads experience:

How many years have you been managing Google Ads?



2. E-commerce experience:

Tell us about the e-commerce businesses you have worked with.



3. Clothing/Fashion experience:

Have you advertised clothing or fashion products before? If yes, explain.



4. Results:

Give us 2–3 examples of campaigns you have managed, including approximate advertising spend, sales generated and ROAS where possible.



5. Google Shopping / Performance Max:

Explain your experience with these campaign types.



6. Teaching:

Are you comfortable sharing your screen and teaching us how you manage the campaigns?



7. Availability:

How quickly can you start?



8. Working hours:

What hours are you normally available in Philippine time?



9. Your proposed approach:

If we gave you an online clothing store with hundreds of products tomorrow, what would you do during your first 7 days?



10. Your rates:

Please provide your hourly rate or monthly rate.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION TEST



At the beginning of your application, write:



“I CAN START IMMEDIATELY”



Applications that do not include this sentence may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can start immediately, produce measurable results, communicate well, and become a long-term member of our team.



If you are confident that you can take an e-commerce Google Ads account, identify the products with the highest potential, drive sales and continuously improve ROAS, we would like to hear from you.

title: Assistant Revenue Manager - Short-Term Rentals
description:
Assistant Revenue Manager - Short-Term Rentals



Get Ghost Hosts is hiring an experienced Assistant Revenue Manager to support revenue management across a portfolio of professionally managed short-term rental properties in the United States.



This is a hands-on revenue management position for someone who has already worked with a multi-property STR or vacation rental portfolio.



You will monitor portfolio performance, investigate properties falling behind expectations, execute pricing and restriction changes, maintain revenue management systems, and help prepare client-facing reporting.



The most important part of this role is judgment. We need someone who can look at a portfolio, recognize when something looks wrong, investigate why, and clearly explain what they found.



You will work with a small team, close to the people making the pricing decisions. Over time, routine portfolio decisions become yours to own.



Position Details



* Independent contractor, remote, based in the Philippines

* Expected workload: approximately 40 hours per week

* Portfolio: 200 properties across 5 client accounts

* Systems: PriceLabs, OwnerRez, Guesty, Hostaway, Airbnb, Vrbo, Google Sheets, Slack

* Reports to the revenue management leadership team at Get Ghost Hosts

* Start date: immediate



What You'll Be Responsible For



* Reviewing portfolio performance and identifying properties that require attention

* Investigating properties pacing behind expectations and diagnosing the cause

* Executing pricing and restriction changes within established strategies

* Managing PriceLabs settings, overrides, minimum stays, and pricing rules

* Maintaining competitive sets and reviewing direct competitor activity

* Monitoring events, holidays, weekends, high-demand periods, and calendar gaps

* Maintaining rolling 90-day forecasts

* Preparing recurring reports and written performance summaries

* Performing quality control on pricing, restrictions, inventory, and revenue management configurations

* Documenting actions taken and following up to determine whether they worked



Required Experience



You must have professional short-term rental or vacation rental revenue management experience.



We are looking for someone who has:



* Managed or supported revenue management for a portfolio of multiple short-term rental properties

* Hands-on experience with PriceLabs is strongly preferred; comparable dynamic pricing experience may be considered

* Experience analyzing property performance and making pricing or restriction decisions

* Experience working with Airbnb, Vrbo, or professional vacation rental operations

* Strong spreadsheet skills

* Strong written English



Experience managing only your own Airbnb property does not meet the experience requirement for this position.



PMS experience is valuable but is not restricted to a specific platform. If you have used Hostaway and we use another PMS, that is fine. We care more about your ability to understand and work within professional short-term rental systems.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is strongly preferred:



* Larger multi-property portfolios

* Property management companies

* Revenue management companies

* Forecasting

* Client-facing reporting

* Portfolio-level performance analysis



Schedule



This role supports properties located in the United States.



You must be available and reachable during a daily overlap window with the U.S. morning. In Philippine time, this is approximately 10:00 PM to 12:00 AM PHT, Monday through Friday.



You do not need to be in active meetings for the full two hours, but you do need to be online and responsive during that window.



The remainder of your working hours are yours to schedule around required deliverables, deadlines, reviews, and operating procedures.



A short weekend review is also part of the role, roughly 30 to 45 minutes on Saturday morning and Sunday morning PHT.



Weekend reviews focus on urgent pricing, availability, and near-term demand issues rather than full portfolio analysis.



Some additional coverage may be required around major U.S. holidays and significant demand periods. Exact hours and holiday coverage terms will be confirmed before an offer is made.



Work Environment



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser-based systems and spreadsheets

* A dependable backup plan for internet or power interruptions

* A private working environment suitable for handling confidential client and business information



Compensation



$640 to $960 depending on experience



Paid monthly in USD



Compensation will depend on demonstrated revenue management experience and the level of responsibility you can independently handle.



Contractor Terms



* This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment.

* We define deliverables, deadlines, coverage windows, and operating procedures. Outside of those requirements, you organize your own work.

* The engagement is exclusive. You may not take other clients as to not create a conflict of interest.

* You are responsible for your own BIR registration and Philippine tax obligations.

* An NDA and confidentiality agreement must be signed before you receive access to client systems.

* Client data must remain inside approved company systems and tools.



How to Apply



Use the subject line **ARM - [Your Name]**.



Please keep your application concise.



Submit the following:



1. A brief description of your short-term rental revenue management experience.

2. Approximately how many properties you have worked with at one time.

3. List the revenue management and PMS platforms you have personally logged into and used in your work. For each, briefly explain what you actually did inside the system.

4. Describe one property you managed that was materially underperforming. What information first told you there was a problem, what did you investigate, what action did you take, and what happened afterward? Include approximate numbers where you can.

5. At the very bottom of your application, tell us approximately how many properties you were personally responsible for reviewing each week.



The Hiring Process



1. Written application.

2. Candidates who appear to meet the experience requirements will receive a short practical revenue management exercise using sample data. The exercise should take approximately 30 minutes.

3. Candidates who perform well on the exercise will interview with the revenue management team.

4. Final candidates will complete a paid trial using live portfolio work at the full agreed rate.

5. Successful candidates will move into an ongoing engagement.



We use the practical exercise and paid trial to evaluate actual revenue management judgment rather than relying only on résumé terminology or interview answers.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Assistant Revenue Manager:



* Identifies underperforming properties early

* Investigates the cause before escalating

* Executes pricing and restriction changes accurately

* Keeps forecasts and reporting current

* Follows through on actions and checks whether they worked

* Surfaces important risks without creating unnecessary noise

* Takes increasing ownership of routine portfolio decisions



The goal is for senior revenue management time to remain focused on strategy, exceptions, and high-impact decisions rather than routine monitoring and follow-up.

title: Appointment Setter / Sales Closer — High-Ticket B2B Offer (Commission Only, 20%) — UK & US Hours
description:
About us



The Studio Formula is a done-for-you client acquisition service for boutique Pilates and fitness studio owners in the UK, US, Canada and Australia. We build and run their paid ads, landing pages and follow-up automation so their classes fill.



We're not a coaching company and we don't sell a course. The founder owns and operates a Pilates studio running 91% class occupancy and 57% profit margins — and has never taught a class in it. That studio is where the system was built, and it's the proof the offer rests on.



The offer is $3,000 setup + $1,997/month on a 90-day program, backed by a written guarantee: we agree a member target with the client on the call, and if we miss it we refund the setup fee and keep working free until we hit it.



What you'll do



You own everything from booked application to closed client:



- Work inbound applications from paid ads — no cold calling, no DM prospecting, no list building

- Confirm and re-confirm booked calls so people actually show up (this is half the job)

- Chase no-shows and rebook them

- Run the 45-minute Strategy Call: work through the prospect's real numbers (classes per week, occupancy, member value), calculate what their empty class spots cost them monthly, and close the ones who fit

- Disqualify the ones who don't. Studios under $20,000/month get turned away — we'd rather lose the sale than take money from someone it won't work for

- Keep GoHighLevel clean: notes, pipeline stages, follow-up tasks



Hours



Calls run in United States timezone:

- US East Coast: late evening / overnight PHT

You need to be genuinely available in the US block. That's where the leads currently are.



Compensation — read this carefully



This role is commission only. There is no base pay and no hourly rate.



- 20% of the client's first payment

- The first payment is the $3,000 setup + the first month at $1,997 = $4,997

- Your commission: $999 per closed client

- Paid via Bank Transfer, in USD, within 7 days of the client's payment clearing

Nothing is clawed back if the client later cancels



Full-time paid position available after 3 months of proven results. We run other offers, and a setter/closer who proves out on this one moves into a salaried role across the portfolio. That's the actual path here — this is a proving ground, not a permanent commission arrangement.



What we're honest about



We'd rather tell you now than have you quit in week two:



This offer is early. We are building the sales process, not handing you a finished one. There is no proven script yet. You'll be building it with the founder from real call recordings.

Lead volume is currently low — single-digit applications per week while we scale ad spend. If you need 20 calls a week to make your numbers, this isn't your role yet.

Show rate is currently poor (~25%). Fixing that is the single biggest thing you can do here and the fastest way to earn.

If you want guaranteed income from day one, apply somewhere else. If you want a percentage of a high-ticket offer you helped build, and a full-time seat if it works, read on.

Requirements

2+ years closing or setting for info products, coaching, consulting, agency or other high-ticket B2B offers. This is non-negotiable — we will ask for specifics and check them.

Comfortable holding a 45-minute consultative call with a business owner who has real money at stake

Excellent spoken English, neutral or Western accent. You'll be speaking with UK, US and Australian business owners about a $5,000+ commitment. They need to feel they're talking to a peer.

Confident with numbers — you'll be doing live arithmetic on a prospect's occupancy and member value on the call

GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred (or comparable CRM — HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive)

Quiet room, headset, stable internet, Zoom

Thick skin about disqualifying people. We turn most applicants down and you have to be able to do that without flinching.

This is NOT for you if

You've never closed a deal over $1,000

You need a base salary to cover your bills right now

You want a script handed to you on day one

You're uncomfortable telling a prospect they're not a fit

How to apply



Send the following. Applications missing any item are deleted unread.



A 2-minute video or voice recording answering: "A Pilates studio owner doing $25,000/month tells you 'I need to think about it, $3,000 upfront is a lot right now.' What do you say?" — unscripted, one take, don't over-produce it

Your last 3 months of numbers: calls taken, close rate, average deal size, offer you were selling

Two sentences on why a commission-only role makes sense for you right now

Subject line: STUDIO — [your close rate] — [highest ticket you've closed]



Example subject line: STUDIO — 22% — $8,000



We reply to everyone who follows the format. We reply to nobody who doesn't.

title: Exciting Sales Closer + Ops Role for Busy Residential & Commercial Cleaning Company (US Based)
description:
Read every word. There's an instruction near the bottom that gets you hired. Miss it and you're out — that's test #1, and it starts now.



We're Greater Phoenix Cleaning. We clean homes and businesses across Phoenix, Arizona, and we are on a tear — building this into a multi-seven-figure company with locations opening across the United States.



Think of us like a championship sports team. Everyone here is a starter. Everyone is accountable. We train hard, we keep score, we celebrate the wins loudly, and we don't carry passengers. If you're used to hiding in the middle of a big org where nobody notices you coasting — you will hate it here, and we'll notice fast.



We're hiring ONE leader. A Closer. Someone who can run the day-to-day of a busy cleaning company, close deals on the phone, take an angry customer and turn them into a raving fan, keep a crew of cleaners moving, and stay calm and sharp when the day goes sideways — because some days, it will.



We hire leaders, not order-takers. If you need someone telling you what to do every hour, close this post — we'll both be happier. If you see a problem and just handle it, keep reading.



THE ONE THING THAT'S NON-NEGOTIABLE

We do not hire lazy. Not "a little lazy on Fridays." Not "lazy in the parts nobody sees." If you cut corners anywhere in your life, it shows up everywhere eventually — and it has no home on this team. We want the person who does it right when no one is watching, who finishes what they start, and who is a little annoyed by their own unfinished work. If that's not you, you already know, and this will save us both time.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Close deals. Talk to people who want their space cleaned and turn them into paying customers. Negotiate, handle objections, win. Recurring customers and raving fans are the engine of this company. One-time cleans are not. Turning the customer into a fan and a long-term friend is the goal!



Own escalations. When a customer is upset, you step in, take the heat, fix it, and save the relationship. People feel handled when they deal with you.



Run the day. Keep jobs on track, connect customers and cleaners, put out the small fires before they become big ones.

Lead the crew. Not babysit — lead. Set the standard, hold the line, help people win.



Upgrade the machine. Spot what's slow or broken and build a better way. Solve a problem once so it never comes back.



WHO YOU ARE



Happy. Real energy. People feel better after talking to you. This matters more than you'd guess.

Hungry. You want to grow, earn, and build something real. Coasting bores you.

Humble. You take hard feedback like a pro and never think you're above the work.

Sharp. Fast learner. You connect dots other people walk right past.

A leader. You've led something — a team, a shift, a project — and you were good at it. People follow you without being told to.

A self-development junkie. Books, courses, podcasts — nobody has to push you. You sharpen your craft on your own time because you actually enjoy it.

Growth mindset. "I don't know how yet." Every setback is just data.



WHY THIS BEATS A CORPORATE JOB

No red tape. No politics. No pretending to look busy. We move fast, we have fun, we treat people like adults, and we keep score honestly. You'll work directly with the owner and have a real seat at the table as we scale nationwide. The people who join early and perform are the people who lead our future locations. We build leaders here — that's the entire point.



THE HONEST PART

This is demanding. Customers can be hard, days get chaotic, and you'll be trusted with a lot, fast. If you want easy and quiet, we are not it. If you want to be pushed, to grow, to earn, and to help build something that becomes a household name across America — welcome home.



Cleaning, home-services, dispatch, or field-team experience is a real plus. But we'll take a phenomenal leader and teach them cleaning over someone who knows cleaning but can't lead. Both? Even better.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the tryout — you're going to close us on camera)

We're a sales team. So don't type us an essay — we won't read a wall of text, and neither will your future customers. Get on camera and close us. If you can't close us on hiring you, you can't close the people who pay us. It's that simple.



Two things — that's the whole application:



-Put the word DESERT in the first line of your message so we know you read this. No DESERT, no reply. (Test #1 — passed or failed before we even hit play.)



-Record a 2–3 minute video of YOURSELF ON CAMERA — face visible. Not a voice-only clip. Not just your screen. You, talking to the lens like it's a customer who just said "let me think about it." Loom, YouTube unlisted, Google Drive — paste the link. In it, close us:

1. Who you are and why you're a leader, not an order-taker. Ten seconds. Don't ramble — tight is a skill.

2. One time you turned an angry customer or a bad situation completely around. Specifics. What you did, how it ended.

3. What you're doing right now to get better at your craft — the last book, course, or podcast you finished and the one thing you actually changed.

4. Then close. Ask us for the job. Handle the objection out loud: "Why you over everyone else applying?" Sell us. Don't be shy — that's the entire test.



No cover letter. No essay. If the video isn't there — or it's a black screen with a voice — we skip it, no exceptions. The people who won't get on camera are exactly the people we don't want on the phone.



We watch every video that comes in with DESERT. Show us the close.



Let's go build something big.



— The Greater Phoenix Cleaning Team

title: Amazon/Walmart VA – Full Account Management
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Virtual Assistant to fully manage our day-to-day Seller Central operations — from daily account maintenance and customer service to PPC advertising, product image creation, listing optimization, and everything in between. This is a full-scope role for someone who can own the account end to end with minimal supervision.



What You'll Do



PPC & Advertising



Create, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns on Amazon

Manage Walmart Connect (Sponsored Products) campaigns

Conduct daily/weekly bid adjustments, budget management, and search term (negative keyword) mining

Monitor ACOS/TACOS, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rates; provide weekly performance reports

Run keyword research for new campaign targets and expansion opportunities



Product Images & Creative



Design and edit product listing images (main image, infographics, lifestyle images, comparison charts) in accordance with Amazon and Walmart image guidelines

Create A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content modules and Walmart Enhanced Content

Design storefront/brand store graphics and banners as needed

Work from provided product photos, brand guidelines, and reference listings to produce on-brand creative

Basic photo editing/retouching (background removal, resizing, compression for upload requirements)



Daily Account Maintenance



Monitor Amazon and Walmart Seller Central dashboards daily for account health, policy violations, and performance notifications

Respond to buyer/customer messages within required response-time windows

Track and manage orders, shipments, returns, and refunds

Monitor inventory levels and flag low-stock/restock needs

Check and resolve listing errors, suppressed listings, and pricing/Buy Box issues

Track account health metrics (ODR, late shipment rate, valid tracking rate, etc.) and escalate issues promptly

Respond to and manage product reviews/feedback where applicable

Maintain a daily/weekly task log or checklist for the team



Listing Optimization & Keyword Research



Conduct keyword research using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar

Write and optimize listing titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend search terms for both Amazon and Walmart

Monitor listing health, suppress/error flags, and buy box status

Perform competitor research and identify optimization opportunities

Assist with keyword indexing checks and rank tracking



Catalog & Listing Management



Create new product listings on Amazon and Walmart (single and variation/parent-child listings)

Prepare and upload flat files/bulk feeds; troubleshoot upload errors

Request and manage category/gating approvals

Set up and maintain UPC/GTIN, brand registry, and catalog data accuracy

Update pricing, titles, and content as needed for seasonal or promotional changes



Customer Service & Case Management



Respond to customer inquiries and messages within platform SLAs

Open and manage Seller Support cases with Amazon and Walmart for account, listing, or order issues

Handle A-to-Z Guarantee claims, chargebacks, and buyer disputes

Process and track returns, replacements, and refunds

Respond professionally to negative feedback and product reviews, and request removal of policy-violating reviews when applicable



Inventory & Supply Chain Support



Monitor inventory levels across FBA/FBM and Walmart fulfillment; flag restock needs before stockouts

Create and track FBA shipment plans, and monitor shipment/receiving status

Monitor storage fees, aged inventory, and excess/long-term storage alerts

Coordinate with suppliers or the team on purchase order timing based on sales velocity



Promotions & Account Growth



Set up and manage Lightning Deals, Coupons, Prime Exclusive Discounts, and Walmart promotions/rollbacks

Support external traffic/deal-site coordination as directed

Monitor and manage the brand Storefront and Walmart brand shelf content



Reporting & Analytics



Prepare regular (daily/weekly/monthly) sales, PPC, and account health reports

Track key KPIs: sales, sessions, conversion rate, ACOS/TACOS, inventory health, and account health metrics

Flag trends, risks, or opportunities to the team proactively



Account Health & Compliance



Monitor account health dashboards daily (Amazon Account Health, Walmart Seller Scorecard) and address issues before they escalate

Respond to policy violation notices, IP complaints, and listing suppressions

Assist with reinstatement/appeal documentation if an account or listing is suspended

Stay current on Amazon and Walmart policy changes that affect the account

What We're Looking For

5+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or Walmart Seller Center accounts end-to-end (please share account examples/portfolio)

Hands-on experience running Amazon PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products required; Sponsored Brands/Display a plus) and familiarity with Walmart Connect

Experience with day-to-day account operations: order management, customer service, case handling, and account health monitoring

Proficiency in Canva, Photoshop, or similar design tools for product image/infographic creation

Working knowledge of keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, or similar)

Experience creating and managing product listings, including variations and flat file uploads

Strong written English for customer communication and listing copywriting

Highly organized and able to independently manage multiple SKUs, cases, and tasks without heavy oversight

Reliable internet connection and own equipment

Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel for reporting and task tracking



Nice to Have



Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Storefront design

Experience managing FBA shipment plans and inventory forecasting

Experience handling A-to-Z claims, suspensions, or reinstatement appeals

Experience with PPC automation/management tools like Helium 10 Adtomic or Perpetua

How to Apply



Please send:



Your updated resume/CV

A short portfolio or examples of product images/A+ Content you've created

Examples of PPC campaigns you've managed (screenshots or case study, with results if possible — sales figures may be redacted)

A brief summary of your experience with account maintenance, customer service, and case management

Your available hours and expected hourly rate



Subject line: "Amazon/Walmart VA – Full Account Management – [Your Name]"



We review applications on a rolling basis and will follow up with qualified candidates for a short paid trial task.

title: |APPOINTMENT SETTER |Fluent English|
description:

Hours: 40 hrs/week, Mon-Fri, 9:00 PM - 5:00 AM Philippine time. This is a NIGHT SHIFT role — only apply if that schedule genuinely works for you long-term.

You don't sell anything, you book the meeting. We provide the script, the leads, the dialer, and training. You bring the voice and the consistency.





REQUIREMENTS:

Excellent conversational English with a clear, confident phone voice

Cold calling or appointment setting experience for US/Western clients preferred

Own computer, headset+mic, GOOD internet, quiet workspace, backup for power outages etc...

TO APPLY (read carefully — applications missing these are ignored):

Attach or link the recording.

Include a screenshot of a internet speed test from your workspace.

We're a growing company — top performers get raises, bonuses, and first shot at team lead as we scale.

title: Experienced Content & Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
# HIGHLY EXPERIENCED IN ORGANIC SOCIAL MEDIA PERFORMANCE + LEAD ENGAGEMENT



We’re looking for someone who genuinely lives and breathes social media.



Not someone who needs a daily list of posts to make.



Not someone whose idea of content creation is asking ChatGPT for 10 Reel ideas and posting whatever comes back.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE CHEAPEST PERSON.



We are looking for someone genuinely good who can take ownership, think independently and become increasingly valuable to the business.



We are prepared to pay well for the right person. Someone willing to really roll their sleeves up and make an impact in an up-and-coming business with a lot of potential. 



Someone who can look at our audience, existing content and analytics and tell us what we should be doing next.



This is a full-time marketing role working across two established Australian fitness and coaching businesses, with the primary focus being the Sam Roberts Online Coaching brand 



Sam helps busy dads and men over 40 lose weight, improve their energy and get control of their health again.



We already have:



* A clearly defined target market and brand position

* A large library of existing content

* Proven content themes and messaging

* A dedicated video editor

* Additional graphic design support

* Sam and the business owner handling filming

* Established lead-generation and DM systems

* A substantial internal AI knowledge base containing our brand, audience, scripts, offers, content strategy and coaching methodology



We don’t need someone to build everything from zero.



We need someone who can help us get far more out of what we already have, identify what we should create next and gradually take ownership of the content pipeline.



# WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



A major part of your role will be social content and organic growth.



You’ll be responsible for things such as:



* Researching high-performing social content, creators, formats and emerging ideas

* Finding outlier Reels and understanding WHY they performed

* Developing new content concepts and scripts for Sam

* Preparing scripts, references and virtual filming briefs before filming sessions

* Finding intelligent ways to repurpose existing footage and content

* Turning strong ideas into Reels, Stories, carousels and other social content

* Maintaining the content calendar and production pipeline

* Creating simple graphics and carousels yourself when appropriate

* Coordinating more involved work with our video editor and graphic designer

* Scheduling and publishing content

* Reviewing social analytics

* Identifying winners, losers and patterns

* Recommending what we should do more of, less of and test next

* Building a backlog so we are not constantly scrambling for something to post



We want someone who thinks beyond:



“What do I need to post today?”



And instead thinks:



“What is working, why is it working, and how can we turn that into more growth?”



# YOU’LL ALSO HELP MANAGE LEADS THROUGH DMs



Initially, a meaningful part of this role will involve helping us manage conversations with leads through Instagram and other social DMs.



We already have a structured process for this.



You will not be expected to invent our sales process from scratch.



You will need to be:



* Confident communicating with people

* Comfortable asking good questions

* Able to build rapport naturally through written conversation

* Comfortable following up with leads

* Commercially aware without being pushy

* Able to recognise buying signals

* Comfortable helping qualified prospects move towards booking a conversation with us

* Organised enough to manage multiple conversations properly



This is NOT primarily a DM Setter position.



We are intentionally combining these responsibilities because our current volume does not justify employing another full-time person purely for DMs. Yet.



At present, the DM component may account for roughly 3–4 hours of your working day, although this will naturally fluctuate.



The remainder of your time will be focused primarily on marketing and content growth.



As our marketing improves and lead volume grows, we expect to eventually hire a dedicated DM Setter.



If that happens, the DM component of this role would reduce significantly so you can focus increasingly on content and growth.



There is plenty of room for this position to evolve as the business grows.



# WHY WE ACTUALLY LIKE COMBINING THESE RESPONSIBILITIES



The person helping create our marketing will also hear directly from the people responding to it.



You’ll see firsthand:



* What prospects are worried about

* What stops them from taking action

* What questions keep coming up

* What language our market naturally uses

* Which content generates real conversations

* Which objections appear repeatedly



We want someone who notices those patterns and feeds them back into better marketing.



The DMs are not just something to “get through”.



They are another source of market intelligence.



# YOU’LL ALSO SUPPORT OUR GYM BRAND



The Sam Roberts Online Coaching brand will receive the majority of your marketing attention.



You will also support our established Australian gym, 5th Element Wellness 



Additional gym marketing work will be required depending on priorities and available capacity.



# THE PERSON WE WANT



You do not have to be world-class at everything.



But you should be genuinely strong in several of these areas:



* Social media marketing

* Instagram

* Short-form content

* Hooks and retention

* Copywriting

* Content research

* Content repurposing

* Canva

* Social analytics

* Written English

* Organisation

* AI tools

* Marketing judgement



Most importantly, you need to be able to think independently.



If you prefer waiting for somebody to assign your next task, this isn’t the right position.



We want someone who notices opportunities and brings them to us.



We also want someone who is comfortable making recommendations.



If you think something we’re doing could be better, we want you to tell us why and what you would do instead.



# AI IS A MAJOR PART OF HOW WE WORK



We use AI extensively and expect you to become very good at using it.



You’ll have access to a substantial internal ChatGPT project containing detailed information about our:



* Target market

* Brand voice

* Offers

* Coaching methodology

* Content strategy

* Previous scripts

* Lead magnets

* Positioning

* Content examples

* Personal stories

* Marketing systems



We want you to use AI as a:



* Research assistant

* Creative sounding board

* Content critic

* Brainstorming partner

* Script-development tool

* Analysis tool



But we do NOT want generic AI content.



You need enough judgement to recognise when AI has produced something:



* Boring

* Generic

* Repetitive

* Inaccurate

* Off-brand

* Overwritten

* Obviously AI-generated



The human still needs to be the marketer.



A good workflow is:



Think → develop an idea → use AI to challenge or improve it → apply your own judgement → execute.



Not:



Ask ChatGPT for five posts → copy → publish.



# EXISTING TEAM SUPPORT



You will not be expected to do everything yourself.



We already have:



VIDEO EDITOR



Our editor handles the majority of our heavier video editing.



You would help provide:



* Researched topics and scripts

* Creative direction

* Reference content

* Editing notes

* B-roll ideas

* Feedback



You should still be comfortable creating simpler assets, carousels and Stories yourself.



SAM + MATT



We handle filming, technical expertise, higher-level strategy and approvals.



As you learn the business, our goal is for us to spend LESS time managing the day-to-day content process because you increasingly own it.



# YOUR WORKING HOURS



This is a genuine full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



Our required schedule is based on Melbourne, Australia time because part of the role involves covering leads during our afternoon and evening.



Melbourne is typically 2–3 hours ahead of the Philippines depending on daylight saving.



SUNDAY

3:00pm – 9:30pm Melbourne time

This includes a 30-minute unpaid break, giving you 6 paid hours.



MONDAY TO THURSDAY

12:30pm – 10:00pm Melbourne time

This includes a one-hour unpaid meal break, giving you 8.5 paid hours per day.



There will be some flexibility around exactly when you take your breaks, provided our important afternoon/evening lead coverage is maintained.



FRIDAY + SATURDAY

Days off.



TOTAL PAID HOURS

40 hours per week.



Because Melbourne uses daylight saving and the Philippines does not, your local Philippine working hours will change slightly throughout the year.



Your approximate Philippine hours will generally fall between:



Sunday: 12:00/1:00pm – 6:30/7:30pm



Monday–Thursday: 9:30/10:30am – 7:00/8:00pm



Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable working this schedule long term.



# COMPENSATION



Again, we are NOT looking for the cheapest person.



We would rather pay more for someone excellent who reduces our workload, takes ownership and helps grow the business than save money hiring someone we constantly need to manage.



Compensation will be based on:



* Experience

* Capability

* Previous results

* Quality of work

* Marketing judgement

* Level of responsibility you can take



Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP, NOT USD, when applying.



# INITIAL 90-DAY PROBATION



The first 90 days will be your initial onboarding and probation period.



During this period, you’ll work closely with the business owner to learn our:



* Audience

* Brand

* Content standards

* Offers

* Marketing approach

* DM process

* Systems



Content will initially receive closer review and approval.



As you demonstrate that you understand the brand and consistently produce work we trust, you’ll be given increasing autonomy.



Our goal is not to micromanage you, though you should be comfortable using screen-recording/time-tracking software during the first 2–3 months while trust is established.



Our goal is for you to eventually own the content pipeline and work increasingly independently.



By the end of your first few months, we want you increasingly coming to us saying:



“Here’s what performed. Here’s why I think it worked. Here’s what I think we should create next. I’ve already prepared the scripts.”



Rather than:



“What would you like me to work on today?”



# NICE TO HAVE



These are valuable, but none are mandatory:



* Fitness, health or coaching marketing experience

* Experience working with personal brands

* Experience marketing to mature men

* Previous DM setting or lead-generation experience

* Sales experience

* Meta Ads knowledge

* Direct-response marketing experience

* ManyChat experience

* Video editing

* Advanced Canva or Adobe skills

* Experience working with Australian businesses

* Experience with social research tools such as Sandcastles



Strong marketing ability, natural communication and good judgement matter more to us than ticking every box.



# HOW TO APPLY



Please
:


 



Include your application with the subject:

Content & Growth Specialist Application – [YOUR NAME]



Attach:



* Your CV

* Any relevant portfolio

* Any relevant examples of your previous marketing/content work



Then answer the following 8 questions directly in the BODY of your
.



Please number your answers 1–8 EXACTLY as shown below.



IMPORTANT: For these application questions, please answer in your own words.



We use AI heavily in our business, and strong AI skills are actually an advantage for this role.



However, at this stage we specifically want to assess your natural writing, communication and marketing judgement.



Please do not use ChatGPT or another AI tool to generate or substantially rewrite your answers. Basic spelling and grammar checking is completely fine.



If you progress to the practical assessment, you will be encouraged to use AI and other tools exactly as you would in the actual job.



Generic or clearly AI-generated applications will not progress.



# 1. AVAILABILITY + CURRENT WORK



Are you available to work the following schedule long term?



Sunday: 3:00pm–9:30pm Melbourne time, including a 30-minute unpaid break



Monday–Thursday: 12:30pm–10:00pm Melbourne time, including a one-hour unpaid meal break



Friday + Saturday: Off



Please also tell us:



* Any other jobs, clients or regular work commitments you would continue if hired

* Your earliest possible starting date



# 2. SALARY EXPECTATION



What monthly salary in PHP would you expect for this position?



Please provide your expectation in PHP, NOT USD.



We are not trying to find the lowest salary expectation.



Please tell us what you genuinely believe is appropriate based on your experience and capability. 



# 3. SHOW US YOUR WORK



Share links to 1–3 pieces of social content OR social media accounts that you are particularly proud of working on.



For each example, tell us exactly what YOU personally contributed.



For example:



* Research

* Idea/concept

* Hook

* Script

* Caption

* Graphic design

* Filming

* Editing

* Publishing

* Strategy

* Analytics



Please be specific.



We want to understand what YOU did, rather than simply seeing something produced by the wider company or marketing team.



# 4. SHOW US HOW YOU THINK ABOUT GOOD CONTENT



Give us THREE social media accounts that you think are producing excellent organic content right now.



They do NOT need to be in the fitness industry.



For each account, briefly explain:



* What they do particularly well

* Why you think their content performs

* One thing you would consider adapting from their approach for another brand



There are no “correct” accounts here.



We’re interested in how you think about content.



# 5. TELL US ABOUT SOMETHING THAT DIDN’T WORK



Tell us about a piece of social content you personally worked on that underperformed.



Please explain:



* What you expected to happen

* What actually happened

* Why you think it underperformed

* What you learned

* What you changed afterwards, if anything



We are much more interested in your thinking than whether every piece of content you’ve created has been successful.



# 6. ONE REEL SUDDENLY TAKES OFF



Imagine we publish 20 Reels in one month.



Most perform fairly similarly.



One Reel suddenly generates 5–10x more views, shares AND enquiries than everything else.



What would you do next?



Walk us through your thinking and the specific actions you would take.



Please don’t just tell us that you would “create more similar content”.



We want to understand HOW you would analyse the result and d
 what to do next.



# 7. HOW DO YOU USE AI?



Give us TWO specific examples of how you currently use AI to make your marketing or content work better.



Then give us ONE example of something you would NOT trust AI to do without significant human judgement or input.



Remember, we specifically want this answer in your own words.



# 8. NOBODY HAS GIVEN YOU A TASK LIST. WHAT DO YOU DO?



You begin your Monday shift.



We only have four days of scheduled content remaining.



Sam cannot film anything new until the following week.



Our video editor is already busy editing previously filmed Reels.



You have access to our existing social accounts, previous content, footage library, analytics and internal marketing resources.



Nobody has given you a list of tasks.



What do you do?



Walk us through:



* What you would look at first

* How you would d
 what matters most

* What you would try to produce

* How you would use the assets already available

* What you would bring back to us

* What you would do to make sure we don’t end up in the same position again



We’re specifically interested in seeing whether you naturally wait for direction or look for ways to move the marketing forward yourself.



# WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?



We will review applications and invite the strongest candidates directly to an online interview.



During the interview we will:



* Discuss your previous marketing experience

* Talk through real social content

* Explore how you think

* Discuss your application answers

* Role-play some realistic DM conversations with potential leads



We are not expecting you to memorise a sales script before the interview.



We want to see whether you can listen, communicate naturally, ask good questions and think on your feet.



The strongest candidates may then be invited to complete a PAID practical marketing assessment using real business content.



If you love social media, have up-to-date strong opinions about why content works, enjoy figuring things out and want genuine ownership rather than being handed a repetitive daily task list, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company
description:
# Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company



**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week, with occasional additional hours as business needs require  

**Working Hours:** [Insert required U.S. time zone and schedule]  

**Compensation:** [Insert salary range and payment details]



## About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based home services company seeking a dependable, detail-oriented full-time bookkeeper in the Philippines. You will oversee the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll coordination, invoicing, collections, commissions, and financial records.



This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and keeps financial information accurate and organized. You will work closely with company leadership, tea
mbers in the United States and abroad, and our external accountant.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Financial Records



- Maintain accurate and organized records in QuickBooks.

- Categorize and reconcile transactions, accounts, and payments.

- Keep financial information current and identify discrepancies promptly.

- Prepare regular reports that give management a clear view of the company’s financial position.

- Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.



### JobNimbus and Invoicing



- Maintain the financial side of our JobNimbus CRM.

- Confirm that customer invoices are accurate, complete, and issued on time.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue balances.

- Record payments and keep customer account information current.

- Assess applicable late fees according to company policies.

- Perform other collection-related activities to help ensure timely payment.

- Reconcile financial information between JobNimbus and QuickBooks.



### Weekly Payroll



- Verify hours submitted by tea
mbers in the United States and abroad.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or unusual time entries before payroll is processed.

- Prepare and coordinate weekly payroll for U.S.-based and international tea
mbers.

- Maintain accurate payroll records and resolve payroll discrepancies.

- Protect confidential employee and payroll information.



### Commissions and Spreadsheets



- Maintain spreadsheets used to calculate commissions and other team compensation.

- Verify commission amounts against completed jobs, collected payments, and company policies.

- Provide accurate commission reports before payments are approved.

- Maintain organized and auditable spreadsheet records.



### Accountant Coordination



- Coordinate with our external accountant regarding filings and financial reporting.

- Provide requested records and supporting documents accurately and on time.

- Help ensure the accountant has the information needed for tax filings, compliance, and year-end reporting.

- Respond promptly to questions and resolve missing-information requests.



### General Financial Administration



- Manage other financial and bookkeeping responsibilities as needed.

- Improve financial processes and help maintain strong internal controls.

- Communicate financial concerns, overdue accounts, and discrepancies to management.

- Meet recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.

- Experience processing or coordinating payroll.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections.

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information professionally.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively with a remote team.

- Willingness to work the required U.S. business hours and occasional additional hours when needed.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using JobNimbus or a similar home-services CRM.

- Bookkeeping experience with a U.S.-based company.

- Experience in roofing, construction, contracting, or another home-services industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and basic accounting practices.

- Experience calculating sales commissions or performance-based compensation.

- Experience working directly with an external accountant or CPA.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep QuickBooks and JobNimbus accurate and up to date.

- Ensure weekly payroll is prepared correctly and on time.

- Make sure invoices are issued promptly and actively followed up until collected.

- Maintain accurate commission calculations and supporting records.

- Give management timely visibility into financial issues.

- Provide complete, organized information to our accountant.

title: Social Media Manager | Strategic Social Lead with Video Editing
description:
The problem we need your help with. Our socials have gone quiet. Almost all of our inbound comes from Referrals, Google and ChatGPT search instead. We have loads of content and always creating more, however time is preventing us from getting it out there.



We want one person to fix that. Not to post more. To build the thing that turns content into an audience, and an audience into booked calls.





**Who we are**

OKR Quickstart is a small remote-first and mission driven coaching and training business based in Australia, working with customers across the globe.



We help business leaders set clear goals and actually hit them. We also coach product management, the work of building software products customers actually want.



Our audience is specific and small. Roughly a few thousand executives, product leaders and CEOs worldwide. That changes everything about how this job works, and if you already know why, we want to talk to you.





**What owning it means**

Curating is tidying up what exists and putting it in a queue.



Owning is d
 what good looks like here, holding that standard, and telling us when we're wrong.



We mean owning. Concretely:

1. You d
 what we post and why, and you can defend it.

2. You build the house style. The look, the tone, the templates that make our content feel like us. You don't inherit one.

3. You tell us what to stop doing, not only what to add.

4. You bring the numbers to the weekly call and say what you're changing because of them.

5. You give the founder honest feedback on his content. Regularly. That's the job done well, not rudeness.





**What you'll actually do**

Strategy and growth

1. Set the content plan: pillars, formats, hooks, cadence.

2. Track what's working on LinkedIn and YouTube right now and bring it back to us.

3. Report on performance in terms of conversations started, not likes.

4. Build the path from a post to a booked call, and instrument it so we know what came from where.



Production & video editing

5. Edit long and short form for YouTube, LinkedIn and Instagram. CapCut is our main tool.

6. Trims, audio cleanup, captions, text overlays, simple b-roll.

7. Repurpose what we already have into new formats and channels.



Distribution and community

8. Post and schedule consistently across LinkedIn, YouTube and podcast platforms.

9. Manage comments and DMs in our voice. We'll agree where your authority ends.

10. Light admin, plus moving prospects through our CRM and LinkedIn chat. No phone selling.





**How we work**

1. You run your own days. The founder travels a lot. Self-managing means you plan your week, keep your commitments, and ship when nobody is watching.

2. We're direct with each other, both ways. We give feedback plainly and we expect it back. If short, factual feedback reads as hostility to you, you'll find us uncomfortable.

3. Flag problems the day they happen. Internet drops, a login you can't get, a deadline that's about to slip. Early is never held against you. Late is.

4. You hold us accountable too. If we owe you a file, a login or a decision by a date, chase us. We coach this for a living. We can take it.

5. Weekly team call. Everyone brings their asks and their blockers. You'll do the same.



**Must have**

1. A real track record on YouTube, and ideally LinkedIn. Show us what you grew, over what period, and what changed because of you.

2. Native-level English, written and spoken. Our audience is English-speaking business leaders and the writing has to pass as ours.

3. Video and audio editing. CapCut ideally, though we'll train you on our setup.

4. The self-management and communication habits above. These are not negotiable and they're what we screen hardest on.





**Nice to have**

1. Copywriting.

2. Miro, Canva, Photoshop or similar.

3. Experience with a B2B or professional services audience rather than consumer.





**What you'll need**

1. Reliable internet with a real backup. Mobile data, a second provider, or a co-working space. A single point of failure won't work for us.

2. A machine that can handle video editing without a fight.

3. A power backup plan. Tell us what it is.





**Where this goes**

This starts part time and moves to full time on results. If the content engine works, there's a bonus structure and eventually a content team for you to lead.



We'd rather pay well and keep someone for years than churn cheap help. Tell us what you're looking for and we'll have a straight conversation about it.





**How to apply**

Read this whole section. We delete applications that miss any part of it, and that isn't us being difficult. Following a brief exactly is the job.



Send your answer to the following questions:

1. Portfolio highlights: Two links to published work you personally made, with the channel or account name for each. Tell us which parts were yours and who else worked on it. Also share any stats you have relating to your Social Media work.

2. Portfolio other: Any other items you’d like to share

3. The short questionnaire at 





**Our process**

1. Apply and fill out the questionnaire. Please make sure to apply through Onlinejobs and complete the form using your matching name and
 address.

2. Shortlisting

3. Interview with a team member.

4. Interview with the founder.

5. A short paid test task on our real footage. You get paid whether or not we proceed. We don't do unpaid trials.

6. A 30-day paid trial period with the criteria written down and given to you on day one.

-Strong customer-service and hospitality instincts.

-Ability to manage multiple properties and competing priorities.

-Previous experience coordinating cleaners, maintenance teams, and other vendors.

-Previous experience managing or training other virtual assistants.

-Experience creating or improving SOPs.



How Success Will Be Measured

-5 minute or less response time to guest messages

-100% 5 star reviews on Airbnb and 10/10 on VRBO. We maintain nearly 100% perfect scores and expect the same from you.

-Vendor and cleaner issues being resolved quickly and strong follow-through on open tasks.

-Team members being held accountable and supported.
