* Follow established scripts while still sounding natural

* Ask questions and gather information

* Follow up consistently with people who don't initially respond

* Help generate qualified leads and appointments

* Document conversations and activity in our CRM



**You MUST be comfortable picking up the phone and talking to people.**



You don't need to be the world's greatest salesperson, but you cannot be afraid of cold calling.



If you strongly dislike talking to strangers or making outbound calls, **this position is not a good fit.**



## GoHighLevel & CRM



Experience with **GoHighLevel is highly preferred.**



Depending on your experience, you may help with:



* Managing contacts

* Managing CRM data

* Creating and updating opportunities

* Managing pipelines

* Creating tasks

* Building workflows

* Creating automations

* Managing SMS campaigns

* Managing
 campaigns

* Creating follow-up sequences

* Tracking leads

* Keeping CRM information clean and organized

* Improving existing systems and processes



Experience with other CRMs or marketing automation platforms is also valuable.



## AI & Technology



**AI will be a major part of this position.**



We don't want someone who is afraid of new technology.



We want someone who sees technology and AI as tools that can help them accomplish more.



You may use tools such as:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* AI image-generation tools

* Canva

* GoHighLevel

* Automation software

* AI research tools

* AI writing tools

* Other new AI platforms as they become available



You do NOT need experience with every platform.



What's more important is that you are **curious, resourceful, and capable of teaching yourself new technology.**



If you're given a problem you haven't seen before, we want your first reaction to be:



**"Let me figure this out."**



Not:



**"I don't know how to do that."**



## LinkedIn Marketing & Outreach



You will help manage and grow the company owner's LinkedIn presence.



Our goal is to build genuine relationships, increase visibility, establish authority, and create business opportunities.



You may help with:



* Finding people and companies we want to connect with

* Sending connection requests

* Managing LinkedIn outreach

* Following up with connections

* Engaging with other people's content

* Writing thoughtful comments

* Researching prospects

* Creating LinkedIn posts

* Brainstorming content ideas

* Using AI to help create and improve content

* Tracking outreach and engagement

* Helping grow the owner's professional network



**We are NOT interested in spamming thousands of people.**



We want to use LinkedIn to build real relationships and establish our company and owner as trusted experts in our industry.



## Social Media & Content Creation



You may also help us create and manage marketing content.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating social media posts

* Creating graphics

* Designing flyers

* Creating simple marketing materials

* Editing images

* Creating or editing short videos

* Brainstorming content

* Repurposing existing content

* Scheduling posts

* Researching competitors

* Researching industry trends

* Using AI to help create better content



Experience with **Canva or similar design software is highly preferred.**



##
 & SMS Marketing



You may help create and manage:



*
 campaigns

*
 newsletters

* SMS campaigns

* Lead nurture campaigns

* Follow-up sequences

* Contact lists

* Campaign reporting

* A/B testing

* Marketing automations



Experience with GoHighLevel
/SMS marketing or other
 marketing platforms is a major plus.



# Who We're Looking For



Skills matter, but **how you think and work matters just as much.**



Our ideal candidate is:



* Highly comfortable with computers and technology

* Experienced using AI

* Comfortable making cold calls

* A strong English speaker

* A strong written communicator

* Resourceful

* Organized

* Creative

* Adaptable

* Dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Curious

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to follow established processes

* Able to work independently

* Willing to research solutions

* Comfortable taking ownership

* Interested in improving processes

* Able to recognize problems and suggest solutions



We especially like people who don't need their hand held through every task.



If something isn't working, we want someone who can recognize the problem, investigate it, and come back with a possible solution.



# Experience We're Looking For



Experience in any of the following is valuable:



* GoHighLevel

* Cold calling

* Outbound sales

* Lead generation

* Appointment setting

* LinkedIn outreach

* LinkedIn management

* Social media marketing

* Canva

 marketing

*

We are specifically interested in finding someone with the right combination of **technology skills, communication ability, resourcefulness, and willingness to learn.**



# Schedule



* Full-time

* Approximately 40 hours per week

* Monday through Friday

* Must be available during Arizona business hours

* Remote position

* Long-term opportunity



# Compensation



**$5-$8 USD per hour to start, depending on experience and ability.**



We are looking for someone who wants stability and a long-term opportunity, not someone looking for a temporary position between other jobs.



# How We Measure Success



We care about results, not simply logging hours.



Depending on your responsibilities, performance may be measured through:



* Outbound calls

* Conversations

* Qualified leads

* Appointments

* Follow-up completion

* LinkedIn activity

* LinkedIn engagement

* Campaign response rates

* CRM accuracy

* Tasks completed

* Marketing output

* Improvements made to existing processes



# How to Apply



**Please complete ALL portions of the application.**



We intentionally have a detailed application process because we are looking for the right person to join our team long-term.



## Written Application



Please answer the following questions completely.



### Basic Information



1. What country and city do you currently live in?



2. What hourly rate are you looking for in USD?

### LinkedIn, Social Media & Marketing

21. Imagine you were responsible for helping the owner of a restoration company become more well-known on LinkedIn among property managers, plumbers, insurance professionals, and other local businesspeople. What would you do during your first 30 days?

### Work Style & Fit

title: Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Note: Interested applicants must submit their initial application exclusively through the OnlineJobs platform. Do not
 the company directly. Any candidate who contacts the company outside of the OnlineJobs system will be disqualified from consideration.



Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. This role is best suited for someone with experience coordinating schedules, customers, and day-to-day operations in a fast-paced service environment.



What You’ll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping keep our field operations organized and running on schedule.



You will:

-Prepare and adjust cleaning schedules in Jobber

-Coordinate changes caused by call-outs, delays, and customer rescheduling requests

-Identify overlaps, drive-time issues, staffing conflicts, and other schedule problems

-Reassign or resequence jobs within established guidelines

-Answer inbound customer calls related to scheduling and basic support

-Make outbound calls to communicate delays and schedule changes

-Maintain accurate customer, job, and service information

-Update operational trackers and reports

-Complete invoicing, payroll-support, and cost-of-service tasks

-Escalate decisions that require management approval



You will follow established processes while also using judgment when a situation does not perfectly match the written procedure.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Experience



Previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, operations coordination, or managing appointments in a fast-paced service environment is preferred.



Direct experience scheduling or dispatching employees who travel to customer locations is strongly preferred, but candidates with strong general scheduling, customer service, administrative coordination, or operations experience may also be considered.



Relevant backgrounds may include:

-Residential cleaning

-HVAC

-Plumbing

-Electrical

-Landscaping

-Pest control

-Home health

-Delivery

-Property maintenance

-Appointment scheduling

-Customer service

-Administrative or operations coordination

-Managing changing schedules, CRM updates, multiple priorities, and operational processes



Strongly Preferred

-Direct Jobber experience

-Experience with other field-service platforms

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Slack

-Spreadsheet and reporting experience



Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork



How to Apply



Complete our Culture Index survey:


/p/8Y0GG4Nyz4



In your application message, please include:

- A brief summary of your scheduling, dispatch, or operations experience

- The scheduling, CRM, or field-service software you have used, including whether you have Jobber experience

- One specific scheduling or operational problem you handled and what you did to resolve it



Please make your answers specific and based on your actual experience.



Applications that do not complete the Culture Index survey or do not provide enough information for us to understand your relevant experience may not be reviewed.

Working on EST Timezone

Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, especially Photoshop, After Effects, and Premiere Pro

title: Client Outreach Specialist
description:
About Divine Cleaning LLC



Divine Cleaning LLC is a growing residential cleaning company serving homeowners, property managers, real estate investors, apartment communities, and other property professionals. We are looking for a motivated Client Outreach Specialist to help us expand our client base and build relationships with property management companies and apartment communities.



This is a sales-focused cold outreach position for someone confident communicating with businesses, comfortable making a high volume of calls, and motivated by performance-based incentives.



Position Details



Position: Client Outreach Specialist

Schedule: Monday–Friday

Hours: 9:00 AM–2:00 PM U.S. Chicago Time (CST/CDT)

Hours: 25 hours per week

Pay: $5 Per Hour or $125 per week

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Part-Time Contractor

Primary Market: United States



Target Markets



You will primarily conduct outreach to businesses located in:



Chicago, Illinois

Metro Detroit, Michigan

Toledo, Ohio

Columbus, Ohio



What You'll Do



Your primary responsibility will be to identify and contact potential clients for residential property cleaning services.



You will:



- Make outbound cold calls to property management companies, apartment complexes, real estate companies, investors, and other potential clients.

- Use a company-provided calling script when contacting prospects.

- Speak with property managers, leasing managers, maintenance managers, office managers, and other decision-makers.

- Leave professional voi
s when the appropriate contact is unavailable.

- Send professional
s to prospective clients.

- Submit inquiries through company websites and contact forms.

- Follow up with prospects who have previously been contacted.

- Research companies and identify appropriate decision-makers.

- Clearly explain Divine Cleaning LLC's services and value proposition.

- Maintain accurate records of every outreach attempt.

- Update the company's Airtable client outreach database after each interaction.

- Track follow-ups and make sure prospects are contacted again when appropriate.

- Communicate promising leads to management.

- Help develop relationships that can turn into recurring cleaning contracts.



Technology You'll Use



We will provide you with the tools necessary to perform your job, including:



- Connecteam: Used to Clock in and out for every shift.Track your working hours.

- Airtable: Record every company contacted. Track contact information. Record call outcomes. Track follow-up dates. Document conversations and notes. Track leads through the outreach process.

- Company
: Send professional prospecting
s. Respond to interested prospects. Follow up with potential clients.

- Company Phone Number: Make outbound calls using a company-provided business phone number. Leave voi
s and communicate with prospects.



You will receive training and instructions on how to use our systems.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



Fluent in English with excellent verbal communication skills.

Confident speaking with business owners and property management professionals.

Comfortable making cold calls every day.

Professional, friendly, persuasive, and personable.

Able to communicate clearly over the phone.

Comfortable following a sales script without sounding overly robotic.

Highly organized and detail-oriented.

Reliable and able to work independently.

Comfortable using computers and learning new software.

Able to accurately document information in Airtable.

Persistent and comfortable hearing "no."

Motivated by performance-based incentives.

Able to maintain a professional attitude even when prospects are not interested.

English & Communication Requirements



Strong spoken English is required.



We prefer candidates with a natural American or North American-sounding English accent, particularly since you will be communicating with businesses in the United States. However, we are open to candidates with other accents as long as their English is fluent, easy to understand, and professional. Your ability to communicate clearly is more important than having a specific accent.



???? Performance Bonus



We want to reward you for helping the company grow.



$100 USD BONUS FOR EVERY NEW CLIENT YOU WIN



For every qualified new client that you personally generate through your outreach efforts and that becomes a client of Divine Cleaning LLC, you will receive a $100 USD bonus.



This means your earning potential increases as you help the company acquire more clients.



For example:



1 new client = $100 bonus

3 new clients = $300 bonus

5 new clients = $500 bonus

10 new clients = $1,000 bonus



The specific requirements for what qualifies as a "new client" and when the bonus is paid will be explained during onboarding.



What Success Looks Like



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply make calls—we want someone who actively works to generate business.



A successful Client Outreach Specialist will:



Research → Contact → Follow Up → Build Relationships → Generate Leads → Win Clients



You should be comfortable making numerous outreach attempts throughout your shift while maintaining professionalism and accurate records.



Application Requirements:



???? VIDEO APPLICATION REQUIRED



Do NOT apply through a traditional resume-only application.



We specifically want to see and hear how you communicate.



To apply, you must submit a short video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a great fit for this position.



Your video should allow us to evaluate:



Your spoken English.

Your communication skills.

Your confidence.

Your professionalism.

Your personality.

Your ability to communicate clearly.

Why you believe you would be successful in a cold-calling/sales position.

How to Apply



Send an
 to:







Your
 must include ONE of the following:



A YouTube link to your video, OR

A Google Drive link to your video.



If using Google Drive, please make sure the video can be viewed by anyone who has the link.



Your Video Should Answer:

Tell us a little about yourself.

What experience do you have with customer service, sales, cold calling, or business communication?

Why do you believe you would be good at this position?

How would you handle someone telling you they are not interested?

Why should Divine Cleaning LLC hire you?

What motivates you to perform well in a sales position?



A video is REQUIRED to apply.



Applications without a video will not be considered.



⭐ Why Work With Divine Cleaning LLC?

Work remotely from home.

Consistent Monday–Friday schedule.

Work directly with a growing U.S.-based cleaning company.

Receive training and provided sales scripts.

Use company-provided phone and
.

Opportunity to earn $100 USD for every new client you generate.

Opportunity for additional responsibilities and growth as the company expands.

Become part of a growing business rather than simply performing repetitive call-center work.

Important



This position requires someone who is comfortable talking to strangers, making cold calls, following up repeatedly, and asking for the business.



If you are shy about making calls, uncomfortable speaking English, or do not enjoy sales and outreach, this position may not be the right fit.



If you are confident, persistent, organized, motivated, and excited by the opportunity to earn additional money by generating new business, we want to hear from you.



Apply by sending your video to:







Video required. No video = no application.

description:
WE ARE HIRING: ELITE CONTENT OPERATOR / SOCIAL MEDIA WARLORD



American Light Design



This Is Not a Normal Marketing Job

We are not looking for a “social media manager.”

You think like Alex Hormozi.

In execution.

Volume wins

Iteration wins

Turn views into leads

You know content is not art.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

X

Emerging platforms

Position American Light Design as the undisputed leader in outdoor comfort, luxury outdoor environments, and experience-driven design



Strategy



Study winning creators relentlessly



Analyze metrics and iterate quickly



Test hooks, thumbnails, captions, offers, formats, and storytelling angles



Build scalable content frameworks



Operate like a media company, not a marketing department



THE STANDARD



We are looking for the top 0.001%.



That means:



You move fast



You execute without babysitting



You are deeply creative AND deeply operational



You thrive under pressure



You can create structure from chaos



You can handle high output consistently



You care about results more than excuses



You are addicted to improvement



You know how to win attention online



You should already:



Have a portfolio that proves you can create high-performing content



Understand short-form editing at an elite level



Understand hooks, pacing, retention, and conversion



Be fluent in modern content culture

WHAT THIS IS REALLY ABOUT

title: Virtual Assistant - Business Acquisition
description:
Virtual Assistant – Business Acquisition Research



We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant / Business Acquisition Researcher to assist with identifying and evaluating businesses available for acquisition.



This is not a basic VA or data-entry position. The ideal candidate has previous experience assisting entrepreneurs, investors, business brokers, or acquisition professionals with business-for-sale research, deal sourcing, or acquisition searches.



Primary Responsibilities



Source new businesses for sale every day based on specific acquisition criteria.

Search business-for-sale marketplaces, broker websites, direct-owner opportunities, and other relevant sources.

Pre-screen and vet each opportunity before presenting it.

Review asking price, revenue, cash flow/SDE/EBITDA, location, industry, years in business, and other available financial information.

Identify potential red flags or reasons an opportunity does not meet our criteria.

Provide direct links and organized information for every qualified opportunity.

Maintain an organized acquisition pipeline and prevent duplicate submissions.

Conduct additional research on promising businesses, sellers, and markets when requested.

Prioritize quality and relevance over sending a large number of random listings.



Required Experience



Previous experience with business acquisitions, M&A research, business brokerage, deal sourcing, or searching for businesses for sale.

Strong online research and due-diligence skills.

Ability to understand basic business financial metrics such as revenue, profit, SDE, EBITDA, asking price, and valuation multiples.

Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and consistently deliver qualified opportunities.



Important



You will receive specific acquisition criteria that every opportunity should be evaluated against. We expect well-vetted, relevant businesses to be provided daily. Simply copying listings from BizBuySell or similar websites without reviewing whether they meet our criteria will not be considered satisfactory work.



To Apply



Please include:



Your previous experience helping someone search for or acquire a business.

The websites, databases, or methods you have used to source acquisition opportunities.

An example of how you would determine whether a business is worth presenting to a buyer.

Any experience reviewing business financials or calculating valuation multiples.

Your availability and expected hourly or monthly rate.



Applicants with direct business-acquisition or deal-sourcing experience will be strongly preferred.

title: E-Commerce Catalog & Product Listing Specialist

Familiarity with inventory management systems and multi-channel inventory practices.



Familiarity with project management tools and organized task-tracking practices.



Understanding of online merchandising principles and basic SEO for product listings.



Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency, organize product data, create or optimize listing content, research keywords, or support other e-commerce tasks.



Photo-editing experience for product listings is a plus, including cropping, resizing, background removal, color correction, or formatting images for marketplace requirements.



Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage projects with minimal supervision.



Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.



Self-driven, efficient, goal-oriented, and results-focused work style.



Ability and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and processes.

title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant (Accounting Degree Required)
description:
Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant



Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required



***About the Role



We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses.

This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting.



You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder.



This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others.



We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility.



You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group.



**Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance



Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including:

•	Bank and credit card reconciliations

•	Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight

•	Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations

•	Intercompany transactions and reconciliations

•	Balance sheet reconciliations

•	Fixed asset and accounting schedules

•	Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation

•	Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies

•	Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records

•	Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses



You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required.



2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts



Take full ownership of the month-end process, including:

•	Month-end journals

•	Accruals and prepayments

•	Payroll reconciliations

•	Balance sheet reconciliations

•	Intercompany reconciliations

•	Revenue and expense cut-off

•	Review of P&L and balance sheet

•	Investigation of unusual movements

•	Preparation of management accounts

•	Month-end management commentary

•	Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time



The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task.



3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

•	Prepare and maintain annual budgets

•	Maintain rolling forecasts

•	Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast

•	Monitor actual results against budget

•	Analyse and explain material variances

•	Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks

•	Monitor working capital

•	Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues

•	Recommend practical actions based on financial results



4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis



A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group.

This includes:

•	Gross profit by client

•	Gross profit by employee

•	Gross profit by team/division

•	Gross profit by business entity

•	Client revenue versus labour cost

•	Actual hours/cost versus client budget

•	Employee utilisation and productivity

•	Revenue and cost per employee

•	Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas

•	Identification of scope creep and cost overruns

•	Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies

•	Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency



The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change.



5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting



Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group.



Responsibilities include:

•	Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards

•	Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data

•	Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP%

•	Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity

•	Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost

•	Monitor employee utilisation and productivity

•	Track budget versus actual performance

•	Monitor cash flow and working capital

•	Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts

•	Maintain historical KPI trends

•	Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention

•	Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance

•	Provide concise management commentary and recommendations

•	Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical



The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group.



This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports.



6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration



Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including:

•	Insurance renewals

•	Professional and business licence renewals

•	Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals

•	Finance and loan documentation

•	Subscription and contract renewals

•	Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar

•	Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance

•	Obtaining information and quotations where required

•	Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation

•	Escalating matters requiring management approval



An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up.



7. Founder / Personal Finance Support



Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including:

•	Personal cash flow and financial reporting

•	Investment and property-related accounting records

•	Loan and finance schedules

•	Personal financial administration

•	Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning

•	Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters



A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential.



8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

•	Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems

•	Reduce unnecessary manual work

•	Identify opportunities for automation

•	Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency

•	Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled

•	Document important finance processes

•	Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth



**What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis.



You should have:

•	Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

•	CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded

•	Strong Australian accounting experience

•	Strong management accounting experience

•	Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close

•	Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience

•	Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills

•	Advanced Excel skills

•	Strong Xero experience

•	Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills

•	Experience working across multiple entities

•	Strong attention to detail

•	Strong written and verbal communication skills

•	Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills

•	High level of confidentiality and professional judgement

•	Ability to work independently with limited supervision



**The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who:

•	Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

•	Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion

•	Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why

•	Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis

•	Is willing to remain hands-on

•	Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment

•	Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems

•	Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks

•	Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent

•	Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes

•	Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes

•	Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information



**Key Measures of Success



Success in this position will include:

•	Accurate and timely month-end closing

•	Reliable management accounts

•	Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts

•	Reliable budget versus actual reporting

•	Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting

•	Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area

•	Reliable KPI dashboards

•	Early identification and escalation of financial risks

•	Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility

•	No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines

•	Improved finance processes, controls and automation

•	Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up



**The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group.

For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: EXPERIENCED XACTIMATE RESTORATION ESTIMATOR - $2500 month
description:
# EXPERIENCED XACTIMATE RESTORATION ESTIMATOR



## Full-Time Remote | Phoenix, Arizona Hours



**PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING.**



There are specific application instructions throughout this post.



**If you do not follow ALL application instructions, you will not be considered for the position.**



We are looking for someone who pays attention to details, follows directions, and takes their career seriously. Consider the application process your first opportunity to show us how you work.



---



# THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION



**Xactimate experience is REQUIRED.**



You must already be proficient at reviewing restoration documentation and building detailed, accurate Xactimate estimates and invoices.



If you have never written Xactimate estimates yourself, please do not apply.



If you only have basic Xactimate exposure, please do not apply.



If you need someone to teach you how to write restoration estimates from the beginning, this is not the right position.



We are specifically looking for an **experienced estimator who can contribute quickly and continue becoming an expert in the field.**



**Symbility experience is a major bonus.**



---



# ABOUT ZONA RESTORATION



Zona Restoration is an established restoration company based in the Phoenix, Arizona market.



We handle property damage projects involving:



* Water damage

* Fire and smoke damage

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos abatement

* Reconstruction

* Roofing

* Insurance claims



We have been in business since 2012 and have built our company around doing quality work, taking care of customers, and continually improving how we operate.



We are looking for someone who wants more than a temporary freelance job.



**We want someone who wants to become part of our team, grow with the company, improve their skills, take on more responsibility, and increase their growth and income as their value to the company increases.**



---



# YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



You will work with our restoration team to turn our field documentation into accurate, detailed, defensible estimates and invoices.



Our field team will provide documentation including:



* Photos

* Videos

* Measurements

* Moisture documentation

* Technician notes

* Equipment information

* Scope notes

* Insurance information

* Other supporting documents



You will review that information and build professional estimates and invoices.



You should understand restoration well enough to recognize when documentation supports additional legitimate line items that may have been missed.



We do not want someone who simply enters whatever information is handed to them.



**We want an estimator who understands the work, thinks critically, catches missing items, asks good questions, and produces a complete and defensible scope.**



---



# TYPES OF ESTIMATES YOU MAY WRITE



You should be comfortable working with several types of property damage claims, including:



### Mitigation



* Water mitigation

* Emergency services

* Demolition

* Cleaning

* Contents manipulation

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos abatement



### Reconstruction



* Drywall

* Paint

* Flooring

* Cabinets

* Countertops

* Trim

* Doors

* Framing

* Insulation

* Electrical

* Plumbing

* General reconstruction

* Larger loss reconstruction



### Fire



* Fire damage

* Smoke damage

* Cleaning

* Contents

* Demolition

* Reconstruction

* Large-loss estimating



### Roofing



You may occasionally assist with:



* Roof repairs

* Roof replacements

* Storm damage

* Insurance roofing claims

* Supplements



Roofing experience is preferred but is not required if your restoration estimating experience is strong.



---



# ADJUSTER COMMUNICATION & CLAIM NEGOTIATION



This position is not limited to writing estimates.



You must also be comfortable communicating professionally with insurance adjusters and other claim representatives.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing carrier estimates

* Comparing carrier scopes against our scope

* Identifying missing or incorrect line items

* Preparing supplements

* Providing supporting documentation

* Responding to estimate revisions

* Discussing legitimate scope differences

* Explaining why specific work or line items are necessary

* Following up on outstanding approvals

* Negotiating scope and pricing disagreements

* Moving claims toward resolution and approval



Our goal is not to add unnecessary items to claims.



Our goal is to make sure the estimate accurately reflects the work that was legitimately required or needs to be completed and that our documentation supports our scope.



You must be comfortable professionally defending your estimate.



---



# THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



* Is punctual - If you aren't consistent and cant show up for your shift lets not waste each others time

* Has significant hands-on Xactimate estimating experience

* Can write estimates independently

* Understands restoration terminology and processes

* Understands insurance restoration claims

* Understands mitigation and reconstruction scopes

* Knows how to identify commonly missed legitimate line items

* Understands supporting documentation

* Can review and challenge carrier estimates

* Is comfortable communicating with adjusters

* Writes professional
s

* Communicates clearly with our internal team

* Pays extremely close attention to detail

* Takes ownership of their work

* Meets deadlines

* Does not need constant supervision

* Can manage multiple estimates at the same time

* Asks questions when documentation is incomplete

* Wants to continually improve



We especially want someone who takes pride in becoming **exceptionally good at their craft.**



If you enjoy learning Xactimate, understanding restoration, finding legitimate missing scope items, and building extremely thorough estimates, you're likely an EXCELLENT fit.



---



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have:



* Professional Xactimate experience

* Experience personally writing Xactimate estimates

* Strong knowledge of Xactimate line items

* Restoration and/or insurance estimating experience

* Strong written English & spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Reliable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet



Preferred experience:



* Symbility

* Water mitigation

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos

* Fire restoration

* Reconstruction

* Roofing

* Supplements

* Adjuster negotiations

* Large-loss estimating

* Insurance restoration contractors



---



# HOURS



This is a **full-time remote position.**



You will work primarily during **Phoenix, Arizona business hours.**



You must be available and responsive during your scheduled working hours because you will be working directly with our Arizona team and communicating with insurance representatives.



---



# COMPENSATION



**Starting compensation: $6.00-$14.00 USD per hour, depending heavily on experience and demonstrated ability.**



This is not intended to be a dead-end position.



There will be opportunities for:



* Pay increases

* Performance bonuses

* Increased responsibility

* Professional development

* Leadership opportunities

* Long-term career advancement



We reward people who create value, take ownership, continually improve, and make the team better.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



**Read this section carefully.**



Your application must include ALL of the following.



## 1.
/APPLICATION SUBJECT



The title or subject of your application must contain:



**ESTIMATOR HIRING MANAGER**



If "ESTIMATOR HIRING MANAGER" is not included at the beginning of your reply, your application will not be considered.



---



## 2. ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS



Copy these questions into your application and answer each one.



1. How many years have you personally used Xactimate?



2. On a scale of 1-10, how would you rate your Xactimate ability?



3. What types of estimates have you written? List all that apply:



   * Water mitigation

   * Mold

   * Asbestos

   * Fire

   * Reconstruction

   * Roofing

   * Contents

   * Large loss

   * Other



4. Have you written mitigation invoices from technician photos, notes, drying logs, and equipment documentation?



5. Have you written reconstruction estimates from photos, measurements, Matterport, sketches, or field documentation?



6. How many years of Symbility experience do you have?



7. Have you personally communicated or negotiated scope with insurance adjusters?



8. Describe your experience handling supplements and disagreements with carrier estimates.



9. What are some Xactimate line items or charges you commonly see missed on water mitigation estimates?



10. What are some commonly missed items you look for when reviewing reconstruction estimates?



11. What is the largest estimate you have personally written?



12. Approximately how many estimates can you accurately complete during a normal week?



13. Which estimating or restoration certifications do you currently have, if any?



14. What restoration companies, estimating companies, adjusting firms, or insurance-related companies have you previously worked with?



15. Are you currently working for another company? If yes, explain your current schedule.



16. Are you able to work full-time during Phoenix, Arizona business hours?



17. Why are you looking for a new position?



---



# 3. SUBMIT ESTIMATE SAMPLES



Please submit **2-3 estimates or claims that YOU personally wrote.**



We would prefer to see different types of losses if possible.



Examples:



* Water mitigation invoice

* Reconstruction estimate

* Fire estimate

* Roofing estimate



**If you will feel more comfortable, please remove or redact customer names, addresses, claim numbers, phone numbers, and any other confidential information before submitting them.**



We want to evaluate:



* Estimate organization

* Level of detail

* Line-item selection

* F9 notes

* Scope completeness

* Supporting explanations

* Estimating strategy

* Overall professionalism



Do not submit someone else's work. We will know as soon as we get you to the interview stage



Be prepared to explain the estimates you submit during your interview.



---



# 4. RECORD A 3-5 MINUTE LOOM VIDEO



Send us a Loom video introducing yourself.



Your video should explain:



* Who you are

* Your restoration estimating background

* Your Xactimate experience

* Your Symbility experience, if applicable

* Types of claims you have worked on

* Your experience dealing with adjusters

* Your experience writing supplements

* What you believe separates an average estimator from an excellent estimator

* Why you believe you would be a strong fit for Zona Restoration

* What you want your career to look like over the next 2-3 years



**Please keep the video between 3 and 5 minutes.**



We are not judging video production quality.



We want to understand how you communicate, how well you understand estimating, and whether you would be a good fit working directly with our team.



---



# IMPORTANT



We expect a lot from the person we hire, but we also want to create a position that the right person will want to stay in for years.



We are looking for someone who wants:



* Stability

* Growth

* More responsibility

* Increased income

* A strong team

* A company that is continually improving

* The opportunity to become an expert in their field



If you are an experienced restoration estimator who knows Xactimate extremely well and wants an opportunity to grow with an established restoration company, we want to hear from you.



**Remember:**



* Read the entire posting.

* Put **ESTIMATOR** **HIRING MANAGER** in your application title.

* Answer all 20 questions.

* Submit 2-3 examples of estimates YOU personally created.

* Submit your 3-5 minute Loom video.

* Follow every instruction.



**Incomplete applications will not be considered.**

title: Simple Short Form Video Editor
description:
I'm looking for a creative and experienced video editor who specializes in short-form content for TikTok.



My content focuses on booking travel destinations. I'm looking for someone who understands social media trends, viewer retention, and storytelling.



If you're passionate about creating engaging content that keeps people watching, I'd love to hear from you.



Job Duties



* Edit simple 20-60 second TikTok videos from raw footage.

* Videos will re-use the same footage, just edited in a slightly different way each video.

* Create attention-grabbing hooks within the first 1–3 seconds

* Add text, trending music, and motion where appropriate

* Keep edits fast-paced while maintaining a clean, professional look

* Organize project files and deliver projects on time

* Communicate quickly throughout each project



What I'm Looking For



* Proven experience editing high-quality short-form content

* Strong understanding of viewer retention and pacing

* Excellent storytelling skills

* Strong English comprehension

* Reliable communication and quick response times

* Consistent history of delivering quality work on schedule

* Stay up to date on US TikTok trends

* Understand what makes viewers stop scrolling and keep watching



To Apply



Include these Answers

1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. How long you've been editing professionally.

3. Links to 3 of your best Instagram reels or TikToks.

4. What editing software you use.

5. Your average turnaround time for 3 short travel videos a day

6. write the words "happy travels" so that I know you read this.



I'm looking for someone to work with long-term. If you're dependable, creative, communicative, and enjoy helping creators grow, I'd love to see your work!

title: Meta Appeals Specialist, Fraudulent IP Claim (Bonus on Resolution)
description:
We are a European e-commerce brand. Our Instagram and
 business pages, and the connected ad account, have been restricted because of fraudulent copyright reports filed by a known scam operation that abuses Meta's automated IP reporting system.



We already have a complete evidence dossier: documented proof of the fraud, and a direct precedent where Meta reinstated an account within 24 hours once the real rights holder confirmed in writing that they had never filed the claim.



We need one persistent person to run this case to the finish line.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



File and track appeals and counter-notifications through Meta Account Quality.

Contact Meta support every day, follow up on every open ticket, and escalate wherever an escalation path exists.

Research and reach the official legal contacts of a large Japanese rights holder's European branch, then follow up until we obtain a written reply. We provide the templates and the full dossier.

Keep a clean daily log of every contact, ticket ID, agent name and response in a shared sheet.

Send a short end-of-day report.



COMPENSATION



100 USD per month base.

Plus a bonus, paid immediately once the restrictions are lifted and the removed content is restored.

If the case closes within the first month, that is 100 USD + bonus of 100 USD



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Excellent written English and a professional tone.

Hands-on experience with Meta or
 account restrictions, appeals, disabled ad accounts or page reinstatement.

Extremely persistent. This job is about not giving up after the third automated reply.

Organized. The log has to be kept clean every single day.



HOW TO APPLY



Your application must include both of these, or it will be ignored:



One specific case of a Meta or
 restriction you personally handled: what happened, what you did, and how it ended.

In about 10 lines: how would you approach the legal department of a large Japanese corporation's European office to obtain a written confirmation that they did not authorize a specific third-party report?

title: Funnel Builder (Funnelish + Shopify Integration)
description:
**Funnel Builder – Part-Time | E-Commerce**



We are looking for an experienced **Funnel Builder** to join our growing e-commerce team on a part-time basis, with the opportunity to move into a full-time position in the future.



### About Us



We are a fast-growing e-commerce company currently operating **two established stores in Australia and New Zealand**, and we have recently launched our third store.



Our team already includes **two full-time Funnel Builders**, and we are now looking to add another talented person to the team on a part-time basis.



### What You’ll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be building and improving high-converting funnels using **Funnelish**.



Most of the work involves:



* Rebuilding and translating proven competitor funnels for different markets

* Improving competitor funnels where you see opportunities to increase conversion

* Building advertorials and product pages in Funnelish

* Occasionally creating advertorials from scratch

* Making sure funnels look professional and work perfectly on both desktop and mobile

* Working efficiently while maintaining a high standard of quality



You will usually be expected to complete **1–2 funnels per day**.



### Requirements



* **Funnelish experience is required**

* Minimum **1 year of experience** building e-commerce funnels

* Strong attention to detail

* Good understanding of conversion-focused funnel design

* Able to work independently and meet deadlines

* Good English communication skills

* Experience with advertorial-style funnels is a strong advantage



**Please do not apply if you have never worked with Funnelish before.**



### Working Hours



This is a flexible part-time role.



You can organize your own working hours between **10:00 and 19:00**, as long as deadlines are met and communication with the team is reliable.



The expected workload is approximately **1–2 funnels per day**.



### Compensation



We offer two compensation structures:



**Option 1 – Performance Based**

€20 per completed funnel + **high performance bonuses**



**Option 2 – Fixed Rate**

€25 per completed funnel without performance bonuses



There is significant earning potential for Funnel Builders who consistently deliver high-quality work.



### Trial & Long-Term Opportunity



We will initially select **2 Funnel Builders for a one-week paid trial**.



After the trial week, we plan to select **1 person for a long-term position** within our team.



The position starts part-time, but there is a clear opportunity to move into a **full-time role** as we continue to expand.



### Interested?



Please apply with:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your experience with Funnelish

* How long you have been building e-commerce funnels

* Examples/screenshots/links of funnels or advertorials you have built

* Your current availability



**Important:** Start your application with the word **“FUNNELISH”** so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Automotive Video Editor – Hype Reels + 4WD/Offroad Long-Form | Creative Direction Required
description:
Looking for a strong video editor with automotive experience, based in the Philippines (or overlapping Sydney timezone), for ongoing work.



All content is automotive-focused. We need consistent high-energy “hype reel” style edits and longer-form videos of 4WD / offroading trips. Raw footage will come from multiple camera angles. This is not just technical editing — we need someone who can creatively select the best moments, structure the story, and elevate the footage into polished, engaging content.



What you’ll be editing:

High-energy hype reels (short-form, 15–60 seconds) – frequent, same-day preferred when assets are ready

Long-form 4WD / offroading trip videos (story-driven, multi-angle footage)

Multi-cam footage – selecting the strongest angles, pacing, and sequences

Captions, sound design, basic motion graphics, colour, and audio cleanup as needed

Matching a consistent high-energy automotive style once references and brand guidelines are provided



Requirements:

Proven experience editing automotive content (cars, 4WD, offroading, motorsport, or similar high-energy vehicle footage preferred)

Strong portfolio with recent examples of both short-form hype-style edits and longer multi-cam videos

Able to creatively direct content selection — choose the best moments, build energy and flow, and structure the edit without needing frame-by-frame instructions

Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects is a plus). CapCut acceptable for short-form if the quality is high

Comfortable working with multi-angle raw footage

Excellent English communication and fast response times

Reliable internet and power backup (required for same-day short-form work)

Available for ongoing work (part-time scaling to fuller hours depending on volume)



What I’m looking for:

You understand how to create energy and tension in automotive footage

You can look at a pile of multi-cam clips and know which moments matter

You care about pacing, storytelling, and impact more than just adding effects

You ask smart questions and communicate early if something will be delayed

You’re looking for stable, long-term work rather than one-off gigs



How to apply:

Short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience

Link 3–5 recent samples that best show automotive / high-energy / multi-cam editing (hype reels or trip-style videos preferred)

Tell me your current availability and expected rate (hourly or monthly)

Confirm you are comfortable with creative direction of content selection and can handle same-day short-form when needed



I will only reply to applications that include relevant video samples. A paid test project using real multi-cam footage will be required before any ongoing arrangement.

Looking for someone who can take ownership of the edit and consistently deliver strong automotive content.

title: Lead Follow-Up & Sales Specialist
description:
Lead Follow-Up & Sales Specialist

**Together Design & Build** is looking for a confident, persuasive, and highly organized **Lead Follow-Up & Sales Specialist** to reconnect with potential clients, nurture existing leads, and turn follow-up conversations into booked appointments and sales opportunities.

This is not simply a calling position. We need someone who knows how to build rapport, handle objections, recognize buying signals, and keep conversations moving toward the next step.

### Responsibilities

• Follow up consistently with new and existing leads by phone, text, and

• Re-engage leads who previously received estimates or expressed interest

• Build rapport and maintain professional, natural conversations

• Understand each client's project needs and level of interest

• Handle common objections confidently without sounding pushy

• Encourage qualified leads to schedule or continue with the next step

• Maintain detailed and accurate follow-up notes in the CRM

• Follow assigned follow-up schedules and lead-management processes

• Coordinate with the sales and office team regarding lead status and opportunities

### Requirements

• Strong sales and follow-up skills

• Previous experience in sales, lead nurturing, customer service, appointment setting, or a similar phone-based role

• **Excellent spoken English with clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation**

• Professional, warm, confident, and engaging tone of voice

• Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based homeowners

• Ability to sound natural rather than reading from a script

• Strong objection-handling and closing skills

• Persistent with follow-ups while remaining professional and respectful

### REQUIRED VOICE RECORDING

“Hi, this is [Your Name] with Together Design & Build. I’m just following up regarding the remodeling project you previously discussed with our team. I wanted to see if this is still something you’re considering and if there’s anything we can help clarify for you. We’d be happy to reconnect, review where things were left off, and see what the best next step would be for your project.”

Please do not simply read the script word-for-word in a monotone. We want to hear how you would naturally speak with a real client.

### What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate understands that good follow-up is not about repeatedly asking, “Are you still interested?” It is about creating a conversation, understanding why a client has not moved forward, addressing concerns, and helping them confidently take the next step.

If you have a strong phone presence, enjoy sales, and know how to turn old or undecided leads into opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.

About the Role



As our Executive Residential Real Estate Virtual Assistant, you will provide support across several areas of the business, including:

• Executive and administrative support

• Residential real estate transactions

• MLS and listing management

Required & Preferred Experience

title: Social Media Content Writer / Content Creator
description:
The Ivy Rose Agency is a UK-based creative marketing agency working with a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C clients.



We create strategic, engaging social media content designed to help our clients build their brands, communicate with their audiences and achieve real business objectives.



We're looking for an experienced Social Media Content Writer / Content Creator based in the Philippines to work remotely alongside our UK team.



This is an ongoing freelance opportunity for someone who genuinely understands social media — not simply someone who can write captions.





The Role:



You'll be responsible for turning client briefs, ideas and supplied assets into engaging, platform-specific social media content.



Our UK team manages the direct relationship with our clients. You'll work closely with them via Slack to understand each client's objectives, audience, tone of voice and upcoming priorities, before creating content ready for approval and scheduling.



You'll work across a varied portfolio, so the ability to adapt your writing style is essential. One client may require authoritative B2B thought leadership for LinkedIn, while another may need engaging, trend-led B2C content for Instagram or TikTok.





What You'll Be Doing:

- Writing high-quality social media copy for platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram,
 and TikTok

- Creating content that feels natural and contextual for a UK audience

- Adapting your writing to match different client brands, industries and tones of voice

- Researching relevant topics, industry developments and social media trends to identify content opportunities

- Understanding the difference between simply repurposing content and creating content specifically for each platform

- Writing platform-specific formats such as LinkedIn articles, thought-leadership posts, carousel copy and supporting captions

- Creating unique and engaging captions rather than repeating the text contained within graphics or carousels

- Applying current social media best practices when creating content

- Taking supplied raw video footage and, where required, carrying out basic social-first video editing to create engaging or trend-led posts

- Making amendments following feedback from our UK team

- Scheduling approved content to the relevant social media platforms

- Communicating regularly with our team through Slack





What We're Looking For:



You must have:



- Excellent written English

- The ability to write naturally and confidently for a UK audience

- Professional experience writing social media content

- A strong understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram,
 and TikTok

- An understanding of how content and writing styles should differ between platforms

- The ability to research unfamiliar industries and quickly understand what will interest their audiences

- Excellent attention to detail, spelling and grammar

- The ability to follow brand guidelines and accurately replicate different tones of voice

- Strong communication skills and the confidence to ask questions when a brief isn't clear

- Good organisation and the ability to manage content across multiple clients

- Experience scheduling social media content

- Availability to work and communicate with our team during UK working hours



Ideally, You'll Also Have:

- Basic social media video editing skills

- Experience with tools such as CapCut, Canva or similar

- Experience working within a marketing or social media agency

- Experience creating content for both B2B and B2C brands

- A good understanding of current social media trends and how to decide when a trend is, or isn't, appropriate for a particular brand





An Important Note About AI:



We're happy for our team to use AI tools intelligently as part of their workflow.

However, we're not looking for someone who simply generates captions using ChatGPT and submits them.



We're looking for a writer who can think creatively, research a subject, understand a client's audience and develop genuinely strong content. AI can support that process, but the thinking, judgement and final quality need to come from you.





Working With Us:



This is a remote freelance position working alongside our UK-based team.



You'll communicate primarily through Slack, with our UK team managing direct client communication. You'll therefore need to be responsive and available during agreed UK working hours.



We're looking for someone we can build a strong, ongoing working relationship with and who can become a trusted extension of The Ivy Rose Agency team.





How to Apply:



Please send us:



- A short introduction about yourself and your social media experience

- Examples of social media content you've personally written

- Examples of brands or industries you've created content for

- Details of any video editing experience you have

- The social media scheduling tools/platforms you've previously used

- Your availability during UK working hours

- Your hourly rate and/or preferred monthly freelance rate



Please also include the word “IVY” at the beginning of your application so we know you've read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid content task so we can assess writing quality, creativity, platform knowledge and ability to write for a UK audience.

title: Social Media Marketing
description:
Fan Page & Social Media Assistant



Position: Part-Time, Remote

Compensation: $500 CAD/month + Performance Bonuses

Hours: Approximately 15 hours/week

Trial Period:1 week



About the Role



We're looking for a creative, internet-savvy person to help run and grow a network of music fan pages.



The ideal candidate must understand internet culture and have a natural sense for what makes content funny, relatable, emotional, aesthetic, or shareable.



You should genuinely enjoy **K-dramas, anime, music edits, memes, music, and online fan culture.



## The Goal



The main goal is to **reach new listeners from different angles using the music**.



Instead of simply posting the song and asking people to listen, we want to introduce the music through content people already enjoy.



This could include:



* Memes

* K-drama edits

* Anime edits

* Music edits

* Relatable videos

* Romantic/emotional content

* Aesthetic content

* Fan content

* Creative uses of lyrics and song moments

* Internet trends and formats



The goal is to make people discover the music naturally through content they already enjoy, and turn those viewers into new listeners and fans.



Responsibilities



* Manage 5 fan accounts, each with a different content theme and identity

* Post several times per day across the accounts

* Create content specifically designed around the artist's music and audio

* Find creative ways to use the songs in memes, edits, relatable content, and short-form videos

* Create K-drama edits, anime edits, music edits, and other creative edits

* Turn lyrics and specific moments from songs into shareable content

* Repurpose existing music videos, performances, photos, interviews, and other content

* Create simple edits, memes, clips, and fan-focused content

* Engage with comments and interact with the fan community

* Find and repost relevant fan-created content

* Monitor other fan pages and artists for inspiration

* Experiment with different content styles and formats

* Track which types of posts perform best

* Provide a simple weekly performance report

* Develop new creative ideas for reaching potential listeners



The 5 Accounts



Each account should have its  own personality and content strategy rather than simply reposting the same thing.



 1. Memes & Relatable Content



Relationship memes, funny situations, relatable posts, lyrics, internet humor, and situations people can connect with.



 2. K-Drama Edits



Romantic K-drama scenes, emotional moments, character edits, aesthetic clips, and other K-drama content paired with the music.



 3. Anime Edits



Anime scenes, emotional moments, character relationships, cinematic clips, and creative anime edits using the music.



 4. Aesthetic & Music Edits



Dreamy, cinematic, emotional, and visually appealing edits built specifically around the songs, lyrics, and overall aesthetic.



 5. Fan & Discovery



Fan content, interesting artist moments, lyrics, clips, music discoveries, behind-the-scenes content, and more experimental content designed to introduce new people to the music.



The themes can evolve based on what performs best.



 Requirements



Must have:



* Strong understanding of internet culture

* Very familiar with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Strong understanding of memes and online humor

* Genuine interest in K-dramas and anime

* Enjoys making or watching edits

* Understands online fan culture

* Good sense of humor and creativity

* Good instincts for what makes content shareable

* Reliable and consistent

* Good written English



Bonus:



* Experience running fan pages

* Experience growing social media accounts

* Experience making music, anime, or K-drama edits

* Familiarity with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar editing software

* Experience with K-pop, K-drama, anime, music, or other online fandoms



 What We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to upload posts.



We want someone who can hear a song and immediately think of multiple ways it could be used online.



For example:



"This lyric would make a perfect K-drama edit."



"This part of the song would work as an anime edit."



"This could be a funny meme."



"This song fits this relationship scenario perfectly."



The goal is to constantly find new angles to introduce people to the music.



Success



Success isn't just about how many posts are uploaded.



We'll look at:



* Views and reach

* Shares and saves

* Engagement

* Follower growth

* Fan-generated content

* New listeners

* Which accounts and content formats perform best

* Whether the accounts are reaching audiences who wouldn't otherwise discover the music



 Compensation & Schedule



$500 CAD/month



Approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility in when you work.



Performance Bonuses



There is also potential for **additional bonuses when content performs exceptionally well, particularly when posts reach significant view counts or generate meaningful engagement and new listeners.



The specific bonus structure can be discussed and agreed upon based on performance.



 1-Week Trial



The first week will be a paid trial period for both sides to see if the role is a good fit.



During the trial, we'll look at the quality and consistency of the content, creativity, understanding of internet culture, communication, and overall fit for the role.



If the trial goes well, the position will continue at $500 CAD/month, with the opportunity to earn additional performance bonuses.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Any fan pages or social media accounts you've managed

3. Examples of edits, TikToks, Reels, or Shorts you've created

4. Your favorite song from the artist

5. 3 fan-page content ideas using the music

6. Your availability and time zone



We're looking for someone who loves the internet, understands fan culture, loves memes, anime, K-dramas and edits, and can find creative ways to turn a song into content people want to share.

title: Senior Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description:
OnePet is a portfolio of digitally native pet brands, including Total Vet, CertaPet, and Honest Paws. We help pet owners discover, decide, and purchase trustworthy products and services for their pets.



We're looking for a highly resourceful Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist to own link acquisition and off-site authority building across 3-4 primary domains.



This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, decide how to attack them, and execute - not someone who needs a large team, detailed SOPs, or constant direction.



Buying links can be a tactic. It cannot be your entire strategy.



What You'll Do

Your job is straightforward: build a stronger, more diverse, and more valuable backlink and off-site brand profile that contributes to higher rankings and more organic traffic.

Creative link acquisition: Develop campaigns and angles that give publishers a real reason to link - original data, statistics, surveys, resources, visual assets, tools, awards, rankings, expert contributions, or ideas we haven't thought of yet.

Digital PR & media outreach: Find newsworthy angles, identify journalists and publishers, pitch stories and expertise, and turn those relationships into coverage, links, and brand mentions.

Traditional link building: Execute competitive link-gap analysis, reclamation, broken-link opportunities, unlinked mentions, resource outreach, guest contributions, partnerships, directories, and other proven tactics.

Paid placements: Identify worthwhile opportunities, evaluate quality and risk, negotiate pricing and terms, and determine whether the expected value justifies the cost.

GEO & brand visibility: Pursue relevant brand mentions, citations, and off-site signals that can improve visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other answer engines - not just traditional search.

Experimentation: Continuously test new approaches while maintaining reliable campaigns that produce consistent results.

Not every experiment needs to work. The overall program does.



How You'll Operate

You'll have substantial freedom to determine how you get results. We expect you to understand the backlink profiles of the sites you're responsible for, identify the biggest opportunities, communicate what you're pursuing, and then execute.

Use AI heavily. Automate where it makes sense. Build relationships. Negotiate. Develop assets. Run outreach. Find creative shortcuts. Use whatever legitimate resources and processes help you produce better results.

You will not be micromanaged. In return, you'll be accountable for outcomes.

If an opportunity carries meaningful SEO, reputational, or financial risk, we expect you to recognize it and discuss the risk/reward with us before proceeding. Otherwise, use good judgment and keep moving.



How We'll Measure Success

The primary scorecard starts with high-quality referring domains, links, brand mentions, and citations acquired.

Quality and relevance of referring domains

Number and diversity of links acquired

Brand mentions and AI/answer-engine citations

Growth and quality of our backlink profiles

Cost and value of paid acquisitions

Performance of different campaigns and tactics

The goal is improved rankings, search visibility, and organic traffic.

We'll have lightweight weekly and monthly reporting, and you'll maintain enough structured tracking for us to understand which sources, tactics, and campaigns are producing the best results.



What We're Looking For

We care more about what you've accomplished than how many years you've been doing it.

Acquire high-quality backlinks through multiple strategies - not just paid placements or mass outreach.

Evaluate whether a backlink opportunity is genuinely valuable using data and judgment.

Develop and execute creative link-building campaigns from idea through acquisition.

Conduct effective outreach to journalists, bloggers, publishers, website owners, and partners.

Evaluate and negotiate paid placements rather than simply accepting quoted prices.

Use competitive backlink analysis, reclamation, prospecting, and other core off-page SEO techniques.

Understand GEO/AEO and the growing importance of off-site brand mentions and citations.

Use AI to dramatically increase your research, prospecting, outreach, analysis, and execution capacity.

Run multiple campaigns independently and prioritize your time based on expected impact.

Communicate effectively in English internally and externally.

Know when to experiment, when to scale something that works, and when to stop wasting time on something that doesn't.

We don't care what industry you've worked in. We don't care whether you learned link building at an agency, in-house, independently, or somewhere else.

We care whether you can produce results.



Tools & Resources

Ahrefs

Google Search Console

SEO Gets

Claude company subscription

If another tool or resource will materially improve results, make the case for it.

The same applies to campaign and link-acquisition spend. We don't have a rigid price we're willing to pay for a link. Budget follows value. Find the opportunity, evaluate it intelligently, negotiate it well, and tell us why it's worth the investment.



The Role in One Sentence

Own off-page SEO across several domains, attack link acquisition from multiple angles, use AI and your own resourcefulness to execute at a high level, and be accountable for measurable results.

If that's already how you approach link building, we'd like to hear from you.
