title: Operations Manager – U.S. Healthcare Practice | Remote  Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | U.S. Company | U.S. Business Ho
description:
Operations Manager – U.S. Healthcare Practice | Remote



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | U.S. Company | U.S. Business Hours



About Happy Health & Nutrition



Happy Health & Nutrition (HHN) is a growing U.S.-based nutrition and health coaching company helping people create lasting health transformations through evidence-based nutrition, behavioral change, coaching, and ongoing support.



We are building HHN into a highly organized, scalable healthcare company known for an exceptional client experience, meaningful clinical partnerships, strong systems, and a team that genuinely cares about the people we serve.



At HHN, we believe compassion and accountability belong together.



We care deeply about our clients and about one another. We believe in taking ownership, continuous learning and improvement, doing meaningful work, communicating openly, following through on commitments, learning from mistakes rather than hiding them, improving the system when something does not work, holding high standards while treating people with respect, and helping people live happier, healthier lives.



We are building an A-Team of people who want to grow personally and professionally while contributing to something meaningful.



We are now looking for an experienced Operations Manager who can help turn leadership vision into consistent execution across our people, projects, systems, and client operations.



⸻



This Is NOT a Virtual Assistant Position



Please read this carefully before applying.



We are not looking for someone who waits for the CEO to provide a list of tasks, completes those tasks, and reports them back.



We need someone who can be given a desired outcome and independently determine what needs to happen next.



For example, if the CEO says:



“We need to make sure every client affected by a coach transition has been contacted, understands what is happening, and has a confirmed next appointment.”



We expect the Operations Manager to independently:



* Determine which clients are affected

* Verify what has already happened

* Identify missing or conflicting information

* Determine what still needs to happen

* Coordinate and delegate follow-up

* Establish reasonable deadlines

* Follow up when someone does not respond

* Escalate appropriately

* Verify that the work was actually completed

* Identify clients at risk of disengaging

* Recommend solutions

* Improve the process so the problem is less likely to happen again

* Report the final outcome to leadership



The CEO should not need to determine every next step.



Your role is to turn HHN’s vision into reliable execution so our coaches can focus on exceptional care, our clients feel supported throughout their entire journey, and the company can continue growing without quality being lost as we scale.



⸻



What You Will Own



You will help manage the day-to-day operational execution of HHN, including:



* Team accountability and follow-through

* Client workflow and continuity

* Operational projects and deadlines

* Staff onboarding and offboarding

* Coach transitions and client handoffs

* Project-management systems

* SOP creation, implementation, and improvement

* Making sure SOPs are actually being followed

* Evaluating whether processes are producing the intended outcome

* Maintaining operational dashboards and meaningful KPI reporting

* Identifying operational gaps before they become larger problems

* Following up with team members, contractors, vendors, and partners

* Tracking unresolved issues through completion

* Coordinating administrative team members

* Ensuring important work does not disappear inside
 or chat

* Identifying bottlenecks and recurring problems

* Recommending process improvements

* Helping leadership determine when additional team capacity or new roles are needed

* Bringing leadership solutions and recommendations, not only problems

* Helping HHN build systems that can scale beyond the Founder/CEO



As HHN continues hiring specialized team members, your role should increasingly shift from personally completing every operational task to making sure the right person owns the task and that the desired outcome is achieved.



⸻



What Excellent Performance Looks Like



You may be a strong fit if this sounds like you:



You notice when something does not make sense — and investigate it.



You do not simply send an
 or message and wait indefinitely.



You follow up. You call when appropriate. You establish deadlines. You escalate when necessary. You close loops.



If someone tells you something was completed, you understand when verification is necessary.



If a deadline may be missed, you communicate before the deadline, along with the reason and a revised plan.



If information conflicts, you do not simply report the contradiction to the CEO. You investigate and determine what actually happened.



If something repeatedly goes wrong, you do not only solve it once. You ask:



Why did this happen, and what needs to change so it does not keep happening?



You are comfortable respectfully holding people accountable.



You can distinguish between:



“This requires CEO approval.”



and



“This is an operational decision I am expected to make.”



You understand:



Task completed ≠ Outcome achieved



And when you tell us:



“I’ll take care of it.”



we should be able to trust that the loop will be closed.



⸻



The Person We Are Looking For



You are proactive without being reckless, organized without becoming rigid, kind without avoiding accountability, and confident without needing to control people.



You are curious when something goes wrong. You are comfortable asking difficult questions respectfully. You can create order from complexity, make decisions within your authority, manage several priorities simultaneously, and naturally think several steps ahead.



You care about both people and business outcomes.



You do not seek conflict, but you also do not avoid necessary conversations.



You understand that strong leadership sometimes sounds like:



“I care about you, and this expectation still needs to be met.”



HHN is a high-care, high-accountability environment.



We want someone who can protect both.



⸻



Required Qualifications



Please apply only if you have previous experience in an Operations Manager, Practice Manager, Clinic Manager, Project/Operations Manager, Team Manager, Operations Lead, or similar role where you were responsible for outcomes — not simply administrative task completion.



You should have:



* Previous experience managing people, projects, or operational outcomes

* Experience directly coordinating or supervising team members

* Strong project and deadline-management skills

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong independent judgment and problem-solving ability

* Excellent organization and follow-through

* Experience creating, documenting, and implementing SOPs

* Experience using project-management software

* Experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously

* Comfort having respectful but direct accountability conversations

* Ability to recognize when something requires escalation

* High attention to detail

* Strong confidentiality and professional judgment

* Reliable internet

* Professional remote-work environment

* Ability to work agreed-upon U.S. business hours



Strongly Preferred



Experience in one or more of the following:



* Healthcare

* Medical practices

* Nutrition or wellness companies

* Behavioral health

* Telehealth

* Client or patient service businesses

* HIPAA-regulated environments

* Managing remote teams

* Revenue-cycle or insurance-related operations

* Notion

* Microsoft Teams

* SimplePractice or another EHR/practice-management platform



Healthcare experience is valuable, but strong operational judgment is more important than knowing our exact software on Day 1.



We can teach our systems.



We are specifically looking for someone who already knows how to manage outcomes, priorities, deadlines, and people.



⸻



Compensation & Growth



Starting compensation: $800–$1,000 USD per month, depending on experience, demonstrated operational capability, schedule, and final scope of responsibility.



This is intended to be a long-term growth position.



HHN is growing, and we want the person in this role to grow with the company.



Compensation will be reviewed incrementally as you demonstrate increasing:



* Operational ownership

* Independent judgment

* Reliability

* Team-management capability

* Problem-solving ability

* Accountability leadership

* KPI and reporting competence

* Ability to manage larger areas of HHN operations

* Measurable business outcomes



Compensation growth is based on demonstrated responsibility and outcomes — not simply time in the role.



We will establish clear expectations so you understand what successful advancement requires.



As HHN continues to grow, there may also be opportunities for increased leadership responsibility for a candidate who consistently demonstrates the ability to operate at a higher level.



We do not promise automatic promotions or salary increases.



We do promise that strong performance, increasing responsibility, and meaningful contribution will be recognized.



⸻



This Position May NOT Be Right for You If:



* You prefer receiving detailed step-by-step instructions for most assignments

* You are uncomfortable following up repeatedly when something important remains unresolved

* You avoid difficult conversations even when expectations are not being met

* You prefer completing tasks over taking responsibility for final outcomes

* You regularly wait for your supervisor to determine the next step

* You struggle to prioritize when several things are happening simultaneously

* You consider sending an
 or message the completion of a responsibility even when the desired outcome has not occurred

* You are uncomfortable working in a growing company where systems will continue improving and evolving



There is nothing wrong with those working styles.



They are simply not the working style required for this position.



⸻



How to Apply



Please do not submit only a generic cover letter.



We care significantly more about how you think than how polished your résumé sounds.



At the beginning of your application, write:



I OWN THE OUTCOME



Then submit your résumé and answer the questions below.



Question 1 — Operations Scenario



You are the Operations Manager for a healthcare coaching company.



A coach returns from an extended leave and approximately 12 previous clients are transferred back to her.



Two weeks later, the CEO discovers that the coach saw only two clients during the previous week.



The coach reports that she contacted several clients.



However, some information does not match what the company is hearing directly from clients, and there is no clear central record showing who was contacted, when they were contacted, how many attempts were made, who responded, who has a future appointment, and who may be at risk of leaving the company.



The CEO tells you:



“The desired outcome is that every client has a verified status, no client unintentionally falls through the cracks, and we recover as many client relationships as possible.”



What would you do next?



Please walk us through your approach step by step, including:



1. What you would investigate first

2. What information you would gather

3. Who you would communicate with

4. What you would delegate

5. What deadlines you would establish

6. What you would do if someone did not respond

7. What you would d
 independently versus bring to the CEO

8. How you would verify that the desired outcome was actually achieved

9. What you would change operationally to reduce the likelihood of this happening again



There is no required response length.



We are evaluating how you think, not whether you guess our current process correctly.



Question 2 — Leadership & Culture Scenario



At HHN, we believe that caring deeply about people and maintaining high standards are not opposites.



Tell us about a real situation where someone you worked with was repeatedly not meeting an important expectation.



Please explain what was happening, how you approached the person, what you said or did, how you balanced accountability with respect, what happened afterward, and what you learned.



We are especially interested in understanding how you handle situations where addressing the problem may feel uncomfortable.



Final Question



In 3–5 sentences, answer:



What do you believe is the difference between completing a task and owning an outcome?



Applications that do not include the required questions may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to help build something meaningful, enjoys solving complicated problems, and takes pride in making an organization work better because they are part of it.



If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

- Prior experience drafting or maintaining employee handbooks and HR policy documents

title: Virtual Assistant – Home Care Operations & Recruiting
description:
**Company:** Right at Home (new franchise office serving Akron, Ohio)

**Location:** Remote / Work From Home (Philippines-based)

**Schedule:** [40] hrs/week, Monday–Friday, [8 AM]–[5 PM] U.S. Eastern Time

**Reports To:** Franchise Owner / Agency Leadership



---



## Help Build a Growing Home Care Agency From the Ground Up



Are you an organized, dependable, and proactive virtual assistant who enjoys helping businesses grow?



Right at Home is opening a new office serving the Akron, Ohio community, and we're looking for a talented Virtual Assistant to support our home care operations, caregiver recruiting, scheduling, administration, and customer service.



This is an opportunity to work directly with the Franchise Owner and become an important part of a growing home care agency. You'll help create organized systems, communicate with caregivers and clients, support recruiting efforts, maintain accurate records, and contribute to the daily success of the business.



If you are detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, and excited to support a mission-driven company, we'd love to meet you.



## Why This Opportunity Is Different



We're not simply hiring someone to complete routine administrative tasks — we're building a long-term working relationship.



As an early member of our remote support team, you'll have the opportunity to help establish processes, improve systems, support caregivers, and influence how our agency operates and grows.



Your ideas, reliability, communication, and initiative will matter. As the business expands, this role may evolve to include additional responsibilities, specialized projects, or leadership opportunities based on company needs and individual performance.



## About the Role



The Virtual Assistant will provide remote administrative and operational support for our home care agency. This position will assist with caregiver recruiting and onboarding, scheduling, client and caregiver communication, data entry, documentation, customer service, compliance support, marketing administration, and general business operations.



You will work closely with the Franchise Owner and agency leadership to help ensure that clients receive excellent service and caregivers receive timely, professional support.



## What You'll Do



**Administrative Support**

- Provide day-to-day virtual administrative support.

- Organize digital files, records, and documents.

- Enter and update information accurately in company systems.

- Prepare reports, spreadsheets, checklists, and other administrative materials.

- Manage
 correspondence and follow-up tasks.

- Help maintain calendars, task lists, and internal workflows.

- Assist with special projects as assigned.

- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and efficiency.



**Caregiver Recruiting & Onboarding**

- Review caregiver applications and resumes.

- Contact qualified applicants by phone,
, or text.

- Schedule interviews and follow up with candidates.

- Maintain accurate applicant tracking records.

- Assist with onboarding paperwork and documentation.

- Help coordinate orientation and training activities.

- Maintain organized digital personnel files.

- Support caregiver communication, engagement, and retention efforts.

- Send reminders regarding required documents, training, and appointments.



**Client Services & Scheduling Support**

- Assist with client and caregiver scheduling.

- Communicate professionally with clients, families, caregivers, and referral partners.

- Confirm appointments, shifts, and schedule changes.

- Help track open shifts and caregiver availability.

- Update client and caregiver records.

- Follow up on service questions and administrative concerns.

- Escalate urgent issues or complaints to agency leadership promptly.

- Support client satisfaction and service follow-up efforts.



**Customer Service & Communication**

- Answer or return calls and respond to messages as assigned.

- Provide courteous, professional, and timely communication.

- Maintain a helpful and compassionate tone when speaking with clients, families, and caregivers.

- Document important conversations and follow-up items.

- Ensure messages are routed to the appropriate person.

- Follow established communication procedures and escalation guidelines.



**Compliance & Documentation Support**

- Help maintain accurate and organized records.

- Assist with document collection and tracking.

- Support compliance checklists and internal audits.

- Maintain confidentiality of client, caregiver, and company information.

- Follow company policies and procedures for handling sensitive information.

- Notify agency leadership of missing, incomplete, or inconsistent documentation.



**Marketing & Business Development Support**

- Assist with social media,
, and marketing administration.

- Help prepare newsletters, flyers, presentations, and other materials.

- Maintain contact lists and referral partner information.

- Research community organizations, referral sources, and business opportunities.

- Assist with tracking outreach activities and follow-up tasks.

- Support online reputation and review management efforts as directed.



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first year, you'll help:

- Create organized and reliable administrative systems.

- Keep caregiver recruiting and onboarding activities moving efficiently.

- Maintain accurate records and timely follow-up.

- Support excellent communication with clients, families, and caregivers.

- Reduce missed tasks, scheduling issues, and administrative delays.

- Become a trusted and dependable partner to the Franchise Owner.

- Contribute to the growth and success of the agency.



## Who Will Thrive in This Role



- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Takes initiative and follows through without constant supervision.

- Communicates clearly and professionally in written and spoken English.

- Comfortable working with clients, caregivers, applicants, and business partners.

- Can manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Enjoys learning new software and systems.

- Dependable, responsive, and consistent.

- Can work independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based team.

- Comfortable making phone calls and conducting professional follow-up.

- Enjoys helping others and solving problems.

- Wants to build a long-term working relationship with a growing company.



## Qualifications



- Previous experience as a virtual assistant, administrative assistant, customer service representative, recruiter, scheduler, staffing coordinator, or healthcare support professional preferred.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based clients or companies preferred.

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

- Excellent organizational, time management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong computer skills and comfort using online systems.

- Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets,
, and video conferencing.

- Ability to learn scheduling, recruiting, CRM, and home care software.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection (backup connection a plus).

- Quiet, professional workspace.

- Computer with a working webcam and headset.

- Ability to work during the agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time schedule listed above.

- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information responsibly.



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is helpful, though direct home care experience is not required — training will be provided on our systems, processes, and services:

- Home care or healthcare administration

- Caregiver recruiting

- Staffing or recruiting coordination

- Appointment scheduling

- Customer service

- Medical office administration

- Insurance or benefits administration

- Data entry and recordkeeping

- Social media or digital marketing

- Supporting senior care or disability services



## Our Core Values



Compassion · Integrity · Accountability · Respect · Teamwork · Continuous Improvement · Exceptional Customer Service · Reliability · Confidentiality



## Work Environment & Expectations



This is a remote, independent-contractor position supporting a U.S.-based home care agency. The successful candidate must:

- Be available during the agreed-upon work schedule.

- Respond to messages and assignments in a timely manner.

- Maintain a professional remote work environment.

- Protect confidential client and employee information.

- Follow established procedures and communication standards.

- Provide advance notice regarding planned time off or schedule conflicts.

- Be willing to learn and adapt as the company grows.



Because home care operations can involve time-sensitive scheduling and client needs, reliability and timely communication are essential.



## Please Note



This position is being hired during the startup phase of our agency. Responsibilities may evolve as the business grows and operational needs change. This job description describes the general nature of the position and is not an exhaustive list of duties.



This is an independent contractor engagement (not employment) — the company handles no PH tax withholding or benefits; compensation, payment schedule, and terms are outlined above and finalized during the interview process.



## How to Apply



If you're excited about supporting a growing home care agency, helping build organized systems, and making a meaningful difference in the lives of seniors, adults with disabilities, caregivers, and families, we'd love to hear from you.



**To apply:** Send your application along with:

1. A brief note on your relevant experience (admin, recruiting, scheduling, or healthcare support).

2. Your availability for U.S. Eastern Time hours.

3. Your target monthly rate.



**To confirm you've read this posting in full, please start your application with the word "[Care]"** — applications that skip this step will not be reviewed. This is a common and effective OnlineJobs.ph screening technique for filtering out template/mass applications.



Apply today and become an important part of the remote team helping bring exceptional in-home care to the Akron community.

title: Data Entry  - Tax Preparation
description:
# Part-Time Tax Data Entry Virtual Assistant – TaxSlayer



## Job Overview



We are looking for a **reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with tax preparation/data entry experience** to assist our tax office with entering client information into **TaxSlayer Pro**.



This is a **part-time position for 10 hours per week**, split between **2 working days per week at 5 hours per day**.



You must be available to work during the hours of:



**10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Eastern Time**



on your assigned working days.



This position is primarily focused on **accurate client data entry**, so attention to detail, confidentiality, speed, and accuracy are extremely important.



## Schedule



* Part-Time

* 10 hours per week

* 2 days per week

* 5 hours per day

* Working hours: **10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Eastern Time**

* Exact working days will be established upon hiring

* Additional hours may become available during peak tax season based on workload and performance



## Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be entering client tax information into TaxSlayer accurately and efficiently.



Tasks may include:



* Entering new clients into TaxSlayer

* Entering taxpayer and spouse personal information

* Entering dependent information

* Entering W-2 information

* Entering 1099 income

* Entering Schedule C/business income and expenses

* Entering Social Security income and other tax documents

* Entering banking information

* Entering identification information from driver's licenses/state IDs

* Reviewing documents provided by clients and transferring the information into the correct TaxSlayer fields

* Checking your work for missing or incorrectly entered information

* Updating client records when additional documents are received

* Organizing client information according to our internal procedures

* Following our workflow and data-entry procedures

* Communicating when information is missing, unclear, or does not match

* Maintaining complete confidentiality of all taxpayer information



**You will NOT be responsible for making tax decisions or providing tax advice unless specifically trained and authorized to do so.**



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience working with **TaxSlayer Pro** is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is also helpful:



* TaxSlayer Pro

* Tax preparation

* U.S. individual income tax returns

* Form 1040

* W-2s

* 1099s

* Schedule C

* Dependents and filing statuses

* Tax office administrative work

* Tax document processing

* Data entry involving sensitive financial information



Candidates with experience using another professional tax software may still apply, but please be very specific about the software you have used.



## Requirements



You must:



* Be available **10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Eastern Time** on your assigned working days

* Be available for 10 hours per week

* Have strong attention to detail

* Have excellent data-entry accuracy

* Be comfortable working with numbers

title: Amazon FBA OA Sourcing
description:
Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing Specialist



I’m looking for a reliable, motivated, and experienced Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage (OA) Product Sourcing Specialist to join my team.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who understands how to find profitable products that can actually be sold on Amazon — not just someone who can search for random products.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be finding and researching potential Amazon FBA OA products from legitimate online retailers.



You will:



* Research products from online retail stores

* Find profitable Amazon FBA opportunities

* Analyze Amazon listings and competition

* Use Keepa to analyze price history, sales activity, BSR, and trends

* Evaluate Buy Box history and seller competition

* Check Amazon fees and calculate estimated profit/ROI

* Identify products with healthy sales potential

* Check for price stability and avoid products with risky price drops

* Check seller count and competition

* Verify product/ASIN matches carefully

* Look for products that can potentially be replenished

* Organize profitable leads into a clean spreadsheet

* Clearly explain why each product is worth considering



What I’m Looking For



Experience with Amazon FBA OA is highly preferred.



You should ideally have experience with:



* Keepa

* Amazon Seller Central

* SellerAmp or similar sourcing tools

* Amazon product research

* Online arbitrage

* Profit/ROI calculations

* BSR analysis

* Competition analysis



I’m looking for someone who can think like a seller, not someone who simply follows search results.



If you find a product, I want you to be able to explain:



“Here is the product, here is where I found it, here is the cost, here is the expected Amazon selling price, here is the competition, here is the Keepa data, and here is why I believe this is a good buy.”



The Ideal Person



You are:



* Detail-oriented

* Consistent and dependable

* A fast learner

* Good at researching

* Comfortable working independently

* Honest and transparent

* Familiar with Amazon FBA

* Able to recognize both good and bad opportunities

* Focused on finding quality leads rather than simply producing a large number of leads



I would much rather receive 5 excellent product leads than 30 products that aren’t actually profitable.



Opportunity



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.



As the business grows, there is potential for more hours, increased responsibility, and higher compensation for someone who consistently produces quality results.



I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with the business rather than someone who is simply looking for a short-term job.

title: Low Voltage Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support — Security Systems

Two openings: Tier 1 Support  ·  Tier 2 / Tier 3 Support

About These Roles

We design, deploy, and support security and low voltage systems across commercial, residential, and municipal client sites — video surveillance, access control, intrusion, video monitoring, and the networks that carry all of it.

We are hiring two remote technical support roles. Both configure and troubleshoot live systems. The difference is depth: Tier 1 owns device and platform configuration to standard, and Tier 2/3 owns architecture, networking, escalated troubleshooting, and the technical calls that Tier 1 escalates.

Both roles are fully remote. Configuration, programming, onboarding, and troubleshooting are performed remotely in support of installation teams working on site. Occasional travel may be required for commissioning or complex turnover.

If you are strong on devices but light on networking, apply for Tier 1. 

If you can hold your own on subnetting, VLANs, point-to-point links, and system architecture, apply for Tier 2/3.

Systems and Platforms We Work With

You will not know all of these on day one. We list them so you know what the work actually involves and where your experience lines up.

Cameras and Video Surveillance

Hanwha, Axis, Digital Watchdog, Uniview, and comparable IP camera lines. Fixed, PTZ, multi-sensor, thermal, and LPR applications. Full configuration: addressing, streaming profiles, compression, exposure and image tuning, motion and analytics settings, time sync, firmware, and credential hardening.

Video Management Systems

DW Spectrum, Wisenet WAVE, and comparable VMS platforms. Camera onboarding, user and permission structures, recording schedules, retention and storage configuration, server health, licensing, and playback and export workflows.

Video Monitoring and Central Station

Immix and comparable central station monitoring platforms, plus camera-to-central bridges. Site and account setup, camera mapping, event and alarm rule configuration, arming schedules, video verification paths, and end-to-end signal path testing through to monitoring center presentation.

Video Analytics

AI and rules-based analytics platforms including server-based detection, cloud analytics, and camera-edge analytics. Detection zone and rule configuration, sensitivity tuning, false alarm reduction, and integration into the alarm pipeline.

Access Control

Brivo, PDK, and comparable cloud and on-premise access platforms. Electrified hardware including Dormakaba, ASSA ABLOY, and standard strike, maglock, and mortise applications. Door, reader, credential, schedule, group, and user configuration; controller and panel setup; and integration with video and intrusion.

Intrusion and Burglar Alarm

Ajax and comparable intrusion platforms. Panel programming, zone and partition configuration, device enrollment, user codes and arming schedules, communicator and signal path setup, and central station reporting verification.

Networking and Infrastructure

UniFi and comparable managed switching, routing, and wireless. Cellular routers and gateways, point-to-point and point-to-multipoint wireless links, VPN and remote access architecture, and PoE and power budgeting. Solar and battery-backed mobile surveillance units.

This is what we expect you to own independently at each tier.

Area T1 — Support T2 / T3 — Support Required

Cameras & CCTV Configure cameras to standard: IP, credentials, streams, resolution, framerate, image settings, firmware. Own camera standards, storage and bandwidth sizing, multi-site design validation, and escalated image or stream faults.

Documentation Accurate device records, configuration notes, and clear issue write-ups. Define standards, review others' documentation, and produce root-cause and corrective-action records.



?

Tier 1 — Technical Support Specialist

What You'll Do

• Camera and device configuration. Configure IP cameras and edge devices to our standard — addressing, credentials, streaming profiles, resolution, framerate, bitrate, compression, image settings, motion and analytics, time sync, and firmware.

• CCTV and VMS programming. Add cameras to the VMS, build user and permission structures, set recording schedules and retention, and verify recording and playback.

• Video monitoring onboarding. Build sites and accounts in the monitoring platform, map cameras, configure event and alarm rules and arming schedules, and test that alarms present correctly to the monitoring center.

• Access control configuration. Configure doors, readers, credentials, schedules, groups, and users. Verify door hardware operates correctly and events report accurately.

• Intrusion configuration. Configure zones, partitions, users, arming schedules, and communication paths. Verify signals reach the central station.

• Remote field support. Support installation technicians over phone and video during install, configuration, testing, and turnover.

• Quality control. Verify installed devices and configurations match submittals, device schedules, and project records. Flag discrepancies.

• Documentation. Maintain accurate device records, configuration notes, and clear issue write-ups.

• Escalation. Escalate to Tier 2/3 with what you checked, what you ruled out, and what you think is happening.

Required

• Ability to configure IP cameras independently — addressing, streaming, credentials, and image settings — without step-by-step direction

• Working networking knowledge: IP addressing, VLAN placement, PoE, switch ports, and device reachability

• Methodical troubleshooting — the ability to isolate a fault to a layer rather than guess at it

• Ability to learn new software platforms quickly from documentation and vendor training

• Ability to read and work from drawings, device schedules, risers, and submittals

• Clear written documentation habits

• Ability to direct hands-on work over phone and video that you cannot perform yourself

• Reliable high-speed internet and a work space suitable for remote technical work

Preferred

• Hands-on experience with any of the platforms listed above

• Central station monitoring platform experience (Immix or comparable)

• CompTIA A+ or Network+, or equivalent coursework

• Prior experience in security integration, low voltage, IT support, or alarm industry technical support

Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30. Configure and commission cameras to standard across the manufacturers we use. Learn our naming conventions, device schedule format, and documentation standards.

Days 31–60. Independently onboard sites to the video monitoring platform and configure access control and intrusion systems on assigned projects.

Days 61–90. Own device configuration and platform onboarding for assigned projects end to end, escalating only what genuinely needs Tier 2/3.

?

Tier 2 / Tier 3 — Systems Support Engineer

This is the escalation point. When Tier 1 has exhausted what they can check, when a system is behaving in a way nobody can explain, or when a design decision needs to be made before install, this role owns it.

What You'll Do

• Escalated troubleshooting. Own faults that cross device, network, platform, and vendor boundaries. Drive them to a documented root cause rather than a workaround.

• Network architecture and configuration. Design and configure VLANs, subnets, routing, firewall rules, port forwarding, VPN tunnels, and remote access paths for security systems on customer and standalone networks.

• Point-to-point wireless. Design, align, and configure P2P and point-to-multipoint links at the radio level — raw configuration, channel and frequency planning, link budget, interference mitigation, and throughput validation.

• System design validation. Review designs, device schedules, risers, and submittals before install. Catch bandwidth, storage, power, and integration problems on paper instead of in the field.

• Integration architecture. Own integrations between video, access control, intrusion, analytics, and monitoring platforms — API, relay, and event-based.

• Security practices. Apply and enforce hardening standards: segmentation, least-privilege access, credential management, certificate and encryption handling, and secure remote access.

• Vendor escalation. Push vendor and manufacturer issues to resolution with specific findings, reproduction steps, and documented next steps.

• Technical direction. Serve as the escalation path and technical mentor for Tier 1. Review their findings and determine corrective action.

• Standards. Help build and improve configuration standards, documentation requirements, and quality control gates.

Required

• Strong hands-on experience across access control, CCTV, intrusion, and video monitoring systems

• Solid networking: subnetting, VLAN and trunk configuration, routing, DHCP and DNS, firewall rules and port forwarding, VPN, PoE budgeting, and bandwidth planning

• Point-to-point wireless experience at the configuration level — not just “we installed a link,” but aligning, tuning, and troubleshooting one

• Ability to troubleshoot across hardware, software, network, and vendor platform layers and isolate root cause

• Ability to read, review, and challenge drawings, submittals, risers, and device schedules

• Ability to work independently with minimal oversight and strong judgment on when to resolve versus escalate

• Strong documentation: issue logs, root-cause records, corrective actions, and risk summaries

• Ability to mentor and give clear technical direction to junior staff and field technicians remotely

• Reliable high-speed internet and a work space suitable for remote technical work

Desired

• Network security practices: segmentation strategy, least-privilege design, hardening standards, certificate handling, and secure remote access architecture

• CompTIA Network+ or Security+, CCNA, or equivalent certification

• Manufacturer certifications in access control, video, intrusion, or networking

• Experience with cellular gateways, VPN hub-and-spoke deployments, or standalone/off-grid system connectivity

• Scripting, API, or automation experience

• Prior experience as a lead technician, systems engineer, field engineer, or senior technical support engineer

What Success Looks Like

• Escalations come back with a root cause, not a reboot

• Design problems are caught on paper, before they cost a truck roll

• Networks are built to a standard instead of assembled per site

• Tier 1 gets better because there is a real escalation path

• Leadership stops having to personally solve every technical problem



Why These Roles

You'll own real systems, not tickets. The work spans device hardware, networking, platform configuration, and integration architecture across live client sites — with a direct line to the person setting technical direction. Both roles are fully remote, with real technical ownership and a defined path forward: Tier 1 into Tier 2/3, and Tier 2/3 into senior systems engineering.

Employee personal information

Terminations or potential terminations

Management discussions

HR investigations

Internal HR communications

Keep HR documents, accounts, passwords, systems, and communications secure.

Confirm with the HRBP before sharing information whenever you are unsure whether someone is authorized to receive it.



Immediately report any a
 or suspected disclosure of confidential information to the HRBP.



Unauthorized disclosure of confidential HR or company information will be considered a serious violation of company policy and will result in immediate disciplinary action, up to and including termination, subject to applicable law and company policy.



Required Skills And Qualities:



The successful candidate should demonstrate:

Strong organization and attention to detail.

Professional communication with candidates and employees.

Strong follow-through and ability to keep multiple activities moving at the same time.

Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive information.

Ability to follow established HR processes and instructions consistently.

Strong scheduling and coordination skills.

Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.

Reliability and accountability.

Professionalism when handling difficult or sensitive situations.

Comfort working with
, spreadsheets, shared documents, calendars, HR systems, and other business software.



Qualifications:

Experience coordinating interviews, onboarding, or employee documentation is an advantage.

Degree or education in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field is preferred but not required when supported by relevant experience.

Strong written and spoken English.

Ability to work with confidential information professionally and responsibly.



What Success Looks Like:



A successful HR Coordinator:



Keeps recruitment and onboarding activities organized and on schedule.

Responds to candidates and internal teams promptly and professionally.

Ensures offer letters, agreements, and required documents are completed correctly.

Runs organized and consistent onboarding sessions.

Keeps the HRBP informed without requiring constant follow-up.

Maintains accurate and organized employee and candidate records.

Notices missing information or incomplete processes before they become problems.

Handles sensitive information with complete discretion.

Understands that access to HR information does not mean permission to share it.

Can be trusted by employees, management, and the HRBP with confidential information at all times.



Role Expectations:



The HR Coordinator is expected to be proactive, responsive, organized, and dependable. The individual should take ownership of assigned activities, follow through until completion, communicate delays or problems early, and ask the HRBP for direction when a situation falls outside established procedures.

title: Sales Development Consultant
description:
PropZap — Building the Future of Real Estate in North America



PropZap is building a next-generation real estate platform designed to expand across North America.

We are pioneers in how modern real estate companies should be built — powered by strong systems, smart technology, data-driven decision-making, and operational efficiency.



We're building with intention.

With structure.

With technology at the core.

With performance that compounds over time.



Our goal is to create a brand that sets the standard. A company that leads. A platform built to scale intelligently and sustainably across markets.



And for the right person, this isn't just a job inside that company.

It's a front-row seat to its growth.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Role: Sales Development Consultant

Location: Remote

Shift: Aligned with Canada MST

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: To Be Discussed, plus bonuses on closed deals



We believe great people build great companies. If you can consistently turn qualified leads into happy, ready clients, we are willing to offer premium compensation, plus bonuses when your clients close. Strong performers who show up and follow through will be rewarded at the top end of the market.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Why This Role Is a Big Opportunity for You



Most roles like this bury you in cold outreach and rejection before you ever get to do the part you're actually good at. Here, you're not selling anyone on an idea — every inbound lead has already chosen PropZap before you even pick up the phone. That means your time and energy go toward actually helping people, not convincing them.



This role also isn't a dead end. It's one of the most important seats in the company — every client's journey passes through you first, which means your work directly shapes whether the business grows. And PropZap has real plans to expand into new markets across North America — being part of this team now means being part of building the systems and standards that carry us there.



That kind of visibility and impact is rare this early in a role, and it comes with a real path forward: as the team grows, this becomes a Team Lead position, overseeing other consultants instead of just working your own list.



And because your work is tied so directly to results, your compensation reflects that — premium pay, plus bonuses when your clients actually close. This is a ground-floor seat inside a company built to scale, and the people who join early and perform will be rewarded at the top end of the market.



--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Be Doing



- Build genuine rapport with every client from the very first conversation, so they feel supported and confident right away

- Meet inbound leads who've already booked a scheduled consultation and were already qualified by an appointment setter before they ever reach you — they know who we are, they're expecting your call, and there's no cold pitch involved

- Reach out to past leads who inquired before but went quiet — real outbound work, but reintroducing a genuine opportunity to someone who's already shown interest, not cold-calling a total stranger

- Guide them toward getting pre-approved, whether through their own broker or ours

- Help them create an account on our proprietary home search platform

- Walk them through setting their price range, preferred areas, and property criteria so their search actually matches what they want

- Show them how to book their own showings through our platform, coordinating with them along the way

- Follow up consistently on where they're at with their pre-approval, their search, and showings — checking in until they're ready for the next step

- Hand them off to their agent once pre-approval is complete and they're set up on the platform — clean and complete, with nothing left for the agent to chase down

- Keep our proprietary system updated with every conversation and status change, so nothing falls through the cracks

- Give every client a smooth, seamless experience from their very first call through to the moment they're ready to be connected to an agent



NOTE: Responsibilities in this role may evolve over time based on the company's needs as we grow.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Who This Is Perfect For



- Someone who's naturally good at building rapport quickly, and can make a client feel confident and taken care of from the very first call

- Someone who's comfortable coordinating several moving pieces for one client at a time — pre-approval, search setup, showings — without losing track of any of them

- Someone who's tech-savvy and picks up new software quickly, since you'll be working across both our client-facing platform and our own internal system

- Someone who's a genuine team player — happy to support agents, ask for help when needed, and pitch in wherever the team needs it as we grow together

- Someone who wants real stability with real upside, not just another grind

- Someone who takes pride in their own numbers and doesn't need to be micromanaged to hit them

- Experience in sales, appointment setting, lead qualification, or account management

- Strong, friendly phone presence

- Comfortable working inside software tools and digital platforms

- Organized enough to follow up consistently without being reminded

- Real estate experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — basic familiarity with how buying or selling works is enough



--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Gain



- Premium compensation, plus bonuses when your clients close

- Long-term stability inside a company built for where real estate is heading, not where it's been

- Real tools and a real process behind you — our proprietary platform and internal system are built specifically to support this role, so you're never guessing

- A genuine team around you — people who support each other and grow together as the company scales

- A clear path toward a Team Lead role as the team grows

- The chance to grow with the company as we expand into new markets across North America



Imagine being two or three years into a company that's expanded across multiple markets — knowing you were there building real relationships with clients from day one, right alongside a team that grew right along with you.



--------------------------------------------------------------

How to Apply



Send the following to: 



- A short voice recording explaining why you're the best fit for this role (required)

- Resume (required)

- Portfolio (preferred)

- Expected monthly compensation in CAD (required)

- Any DISC test result (if available)



Subject Line: Sales Development Consultant – Your Name



--------------------------------------------------------------

If you're someone who genuinely enjoys building relationships, guiding people through a process, and wants to be the reason a business scales — this might be the role you've been waiting for.

description:
# Social Media Content Assistant | Instagram Reels & Canva



Southern Anesthesia Seminars is looking for a reliable, creative, and detail-oriented **Social Media Content Assistant** to help us consistently publish engaging content on Instagram and
.



We provide continuing education experiences for Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs), including destination conferences, Disney cruises, Walt Disney World events, hands-on anesthesia workshops, and virtual education.



This is primarily an **execution role, not a strategy role**.



Our owner will create the weekly content plan, including the topic, hook, messaging direction, caption ideas, and a description of the footage needed. Your job will be to take that plan and turn it into polished social media content that is ready to publish.



## Responsibilities



* Review the weekly social media content plan

* Locate the appropriate video footage and photos inside our provided folders based on written descriptions

* Select the strongest clips to match each Reel or post

* Create and edit Instagram Reels, preferably using Instagram’s native editing tools

* Add on-screen text, hooks, captions, transitions, and appropriate trending audio

* Create simple graphics and carousel posts in Canva when needed

* Write or polish captions using the direction provided

* Schedule and publish content to Instagram and

* Repurpose appropriate content between platforms

* Follow our brand guidelines, templates, and preferred Reel styles

* Keep upcoming and completed content organized

* Make minor revisions when requested

* Check published posts for spelling, formatting, or other obvious errors



We currently publish approximately **7 pieces of content per week**.



## Finding Video Footage



You will not always be given the exact video clip to use.



Instead, you may receive instructions such as:



* Find footage of guests boarding a Disney cruise ship

* Find clips from a hands-on ultrasound workshop

* Find footage of families enjoying one of our conference events

* Find clips showing an airway demonstration

* Find Disney parks or cruise footage that fits a specific topic



You will be given access to organized video and photo folders and a reference guide explaining common procedures, activities, and terminology.



You do **not** need a healthcare or anesthesia background, but you must be comfortable carefully following descriptions and learning how to recognize the types of footage we use.



## What We Provide



* Weekly content plan and strategy

* Topics, hooks, and messaging direction

* Video and photo library

* Brand guidelines

* Canva templates

* Examples of previous posts

* Instructions for common Reel techniques

* Reference sheet explaining medical procedures and common footage

* Access to necessary platforms

* Clear feedback and expectations



## Skills We Are Looking For



* Experience creating Instagram Reels

* Strong knowledge of Instagram’s native Reel editing tools

* Good understanding of hooks, pacing, text placement, and trending audio

* Canva experience

* Experience with Instagram and

* Good visual judgment

* Ability to choose strong video clips from a larger media library

* Excellent attention to detail

* Good written English

* Ability to follow instructions accurately

* Reliable communication

* Ability to work independently without needing constant direction

* Organized and able to meet weekly deadlines



Experience with travel, healthcare, education, conferences, or lifestyle brands is a plus but not required.



## Hours



Approximately **5–7 hours per week** to start.



Hours may increase as our business and social media needs grow.



## Pay



**$5–$7 USD per hour**, depending on experience and skill level.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can become familiar with our brand and content library.



## To Apply



Please include:

About A Kind Heart



A Kind Heart Healthcare Services is a Washington State-based healthcare company. We provide home care, home health, and healthcare staffing services by combining person-centered care, disciplined operational systems, innovative technology, and genuine human connection. Guided by compassion, integrity, and excellence, we are committed to delivering "Care, Beyond Compare."



About the Position



A Kind Heart Healthcare Services is looking for two highly motivated, confident, persistent, and results-driven Client Acquisition & Intake Specialists.



This person will manage prospective client inquiries received through our website chatbot, phone calls,
s, referrals, and other communication channels. The specialist will also proactively identify and contact potential clients, healthcare facilities, community partners, and referral sources. This is not a passive customer-service position; we need someone assertive who is comfortable taking initiative, following up consistently, overcoming hesitation, and professionally guiding prospective clients toward the next step.



Key Responsibilities



• Inquiry Management: Respond promptly to all inquiries (chatbot, phone,
, etc.) and maintain communication until the lead converts, declines, or is formally closed.

• Lead Generation: Proactively search for new leads through online research, healthcare networks, and referral partners. Conduct outbound outreach via calls and

title: VETERAN Expired Listing Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - US Real Estate (Hiring 1-2)
description:
ABOUT US

McCaw Property Management is a residential property management and brokerage company in the Fort Worth / North Texas area. We are launching an outbound calling program targeting owners of expired and withdrawn MLS listings in our market, and we're hiring 1-2 veteran callers to run it.



THE ROLE

You will call owners whose homes did not sell and steer qualified conversations to one of three outcomes: (1) lease the home with our professional property management, (2) relist it for sale with us, or (3) a direct purchase offer on select properties. You qualify the owner and set phone appointments for two people on our team, Daniel and Pam, who take those meetings. You confirm every appointment and log everything in Follow Up Boss.



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

This is NOT a role we will train from scratch. We want people who have already run successful expired-listing campaigns for real estate agents, investors, or property managers - and who arrive knowing how the machine works when it works: the data, the dialer, the script, the confirmation cadence that gets owners to actually show up. You will help us stand this program up, not just dial. If you have never called expired listings specifically, please do not apply.



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years US real estate cold calling, with at least 1 year calling EXPIRED/WITHDRAWN listings specifically

- Hands-on experience with expired-lead platforms (Vulcan7, REDX, Mojo, or similar) - you know how the data and dialers work

- Follow Up Boss experience strongly preferred (it's our CRM)

- Real numbers you can speak to: dials/day, contact rate, appointments set and HELD per week

- Clear, confident spoken English; comfortable with US homeowners who have been called by 20 agents already

- Available Monday-Friday during US Central business hours

- Fast, reliable internet with power and internet backup

- Full-time preferred; strong part-time veterans considered



COMPENSATION

Competitive hourly rate (tell us your expectation) PLUS a per-held-appointment bonus. This starts as a paid 30-day trial with clear KPIs agreed up front. If the numbers are there, it becomes a long-term role - we want this machine running for years, and we'd rather keep proven people than restart.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly - applications missing any item will not be read)

1. Put the word TURNKEY as the first line of your application.

2. Voice sample (60-90 seconds, Vocaroo link is fine): a mock cold-call opener. Scenario: you're calling a Dallas-Fort Worth homeowner whose listing expired last week after 90 days on the market. Introduce McCaw Property Management, acknowledge the home didn't sell, pivot to renting it out with professional management as one of three options, and ask for the appointment. No polished script reading - we want to hear a live call.

3. Describe, briefly and specifically, the most successful expired-listing campaign you personally ran: who it was for, what data/dialer/CRM stack you used, your dials per day, contact rate, appointments set and held per week, and what made it work.

4. Tell us: your hourly rate expectation, the hours you can commit (US Central), your internet speed, and your backup setup.

5. If you were building our campaign from day one, what data source and dialer would you pick to pair with Follow Up Boss, and why?

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…

- You are a self-starter.

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!

title: Cost Accounting & Inventory Analyst
description:
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable working with large

amounts of financial and inventory data. This position requires someone who can identify discrepancies,

research problems, and work with multiple departments to resolve issues.



This position will work closely with Accounting, Purchasing, Sales, Warehouse, and Operations to ensure

inventory records are accurate, products are purchased at appropriate costs, vendor invoices are properly

recorded, and inventory transactions are reflected accurately in the accounting system.



We are looking for a self-starter, willing to learn on the job, and take ownership and pride over your work.

The ideal candidate is comfortable with learning and using new technology and has some bookkeeping or

accounting experience and is comfortable working remotely. This requires having high-speed and reliable

home internet. We’re looking for someone ready to learn and grow professionally and wants a career (not

just a job). We can train you on a lot of things, but here are our non-negotiables:



 Reliable, high-speed home internet, since this is a 100% remote role.

 Prior bookkeeping or accounting experience.

 Comfortable learning and using new technology/software on the job.

 This is a career move for you, not a short-term gig — we’re looking for someone who wants to

grow with us long-term.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities

 Research discrepancies between purchasing costs, inventory costs, and accounting records

 Assist with maintaining accurate product costs within the ERP/accounting system.

 Prepare recurring purchasing, inventory, and cost accounting reports.

Qualifications

title: Remote Sales & Enrollment Rep — Dance Studio (Part Time to Full Time Opportunity)
description:
IF SALES CONVERSATIONS ENERGIZE YOU AND YOU HATE LETTING A LEAD GO COLD, THIS ROLE WAS BUILT FOR YOU.



We are a dance studio that has built something real in our community. What we do goes far beyond teaching dance. We build confidence, friendships, leadership, and skills that stay with people for life. Every family that reaches out to us is already looking for that. Your job is to make sure they find it, and to bring more people into what we are building.



We are hiring one person to own this role. Not manage it. Own it.





WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is a part time, remote sales role. The heart of it is outbound outreach to warm leads, real people who have already expressed interest in the studio. Your job is to be the first voice they hear, build genuine connection quickly, and guide them toward enrollment through real conversations.



When lead flow is strong, you are following up. When there is downtime, you are prospecting, going out and finding new families through social media, community groups, and online platforms. You are not waiting for things to come to you. You are making them happen.



You will also support the studio with weekly
s to leads and occasionally contribute to social media content. These are a small part of the role, but they are consistent and they count.



This role has a real growth path. If you are consistently converting leads and bringing new families into the studio, the hours are there to grow with you. The right person will not stay part time for long.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Contact new leads immediately when they come in. Speed is a real advantage in enrollment. First contact almost always wins.



- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured cadence.



- Manage your pipeline and know where every lead stands at all times. Log your activity and report daily.



- Prospect for new leads during downtime through social media, community groups, and online platforms.



- Write weekly
s to leads and support social media content as needed.



- Show up as a true team player. The studio owner may occasionally bring you into tasks outside your core scope. If it supports the studio's growth, you are in. That flexibility and willingness to contribute is something we value deeply in whoever joins this team.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



These are our priorities, in order:



- Phone presence above everything else. You need to sound calm, natural, and confident on every call. Not scripted. Not stiff. The kind of person who can hold a real conversation, earn trust quickly, and move it forward without forcing anything. If that description fits you, you are already ahead of most applicants.



- Fluent in spoken and written English at a C1 level or higher. This will be assessed.



- Experienced in sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment based roles.



- Organized and reliable. You manage your leads, report your activity, and stay on top of follow ups without needing reminders.



- Self directed and comfortable working independently.



- Energized by conversations and motivated by real results.



- Familiar with CRM tools or lead tracking systems. Helpful but not required.



A background or interest in dance is a nice bonus. It is absolutely not required.





SCHEDULE



- 20 hours per week, spread across 7 days.



- The bulk of your hours fall on weekdays.



- Weekends are light, typically 1 to 3 hours, focused on inbound leads only. No outbound on weekends.



- Hours are scheduled within a window of 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM Pacific Time. Your actual schedule within that window is set with the studio owner and may shift by season. It will always be discussed and agreed on in advance.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid bi weekly via Wise.



This starts as a part time role. If you are consistently bringing new families into the studio, even a handful a month, there is a genuine path to full time. We want to give more hours to someone who is making the most of the ones they have. Results open doors here.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Every family that contacts this studio is already hoping for something meaningful. A place where their child grows. A community they can belong to. Your follow up, your voice, your consistency, that is what turns their interest into a yes. The right person in this role does not just fill a position. They change outcomes for real families.





TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short introduction. Tell us about a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a real difference.



Include "Blue Spider" in your subject line or message title. We read every application that includes it. Think of it as the first small sign that you are someone who reads carefully and follows through, two things that matter a lot in this role.

title: Courtroom Footage Researcher / Clip Sourcer ( Long term)
description:
Courtroom Footage Researcher / Clip Sourcer



We are building a YouTube channel focused on **courtroom compilations** featuring dramatic, interesting, and high-retention moments from real court proceedings.



We are looking for a researcher who can consistently find and source **high-quality courtroom footage** for our videos.



 Your Role



For each video topic we provide, such as:



**“8 Defendants Who Instantly Regretted Disrespecting the Judge”**



You will research and find **10–15 strong courtroom moments** that fit the theme.



For every case, provide:



* Defendant/case name

* Short summary of what happened

* Original/full courtroom footage link

* Exact timestamps of the best moments

* Court, judge, and location when available

* Charges and final outcome/sentence

* Reliable news/article sources for context

* Approximate usable footage length

* Backup footage/source when available

* Short explanation of why the clip fits the video



 Most Important Requirement



We need **actual courtroom footage**, not simply articles about something that happened in court.



You should prioritize original sources such as:



* Court livestreams and archives

* Official court/government channels

* Full hearings

* Trial streams

* Sentencing hearings

* Local news footage

* Other legitimate original sources



You may use channels such as Law&Crime or Court TV to **discover cases**, but whenever possible, you should trace the footage back to the best/original source rather than simply giving us another compilation channel.



Types of Moments We're Looking For



Examples include:



* Defendants shocked by their sentences

* Judges losing patience

* Courtroom outbursts

* Defendants disrespecting judges

* Defendants crying or begging

* Defendants laughing before sentencing

* Contempt of court

* Bond being revoked

* Sovereign citizen arguments

* Emotional victim-impact statements

* Defendants attacking attorneys or courtroom staff

* Unexpected confessions or admissions

* Killers reacting to life sentences

* Defendants caught lying in court



Goal



We want to build a large internal Courtroom Clip Database containing hundreds of strong moments that can later be organized into themed 20–30 minute YouTube compilations.



The ideal researcher is someone who is excellent at internet research, can watch long court proceedings to find short high-value moments, pays close attention to detail, and can consistently uncover footage that other channels haven't overused.

title: Junior SEO & GEO Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a growing cabinetry and custom millwork company based in San Jose, California. We work with homeowners, designers, contractors, builders, and commercial clients across the San Francisco Bay Area.



We are looking for a **Junior SEO & GEO Specialist** to help us improve and maintain our online visibility across Google Search, Google Maps, Google Business Profile, and emerging AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.



This is an entry-level / junior position.



We are not looking for a senior SEO strategist. We are looking for someone who has a good understanding of basic SEO, is comfortable working with websites and digital tools, and most importantly is reliable, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.



You will receive direction on overall marketing priorities and will be responsible for consistently executing, monitoring results, and improving our online presence over time.



What You’ll Do:



Website SEO



* Review and optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and image alt text

* Perform basic keyword research using tools such as SEMrush or similar platforms

* Help organize keywords by service, product, location, and search intent

* Optimize existing website pages based on target keywords

* Improve internal linking between important pages

* Identify missing, duplicate, or poorly optimized metadata

* Help monitor indexing and website SEO health

* Assist with basic technical SEO issues when needed

* Keep website information, product pages, project pages, and other content updated



Content & Website Updates



* Publish and update blog posts, project pages, service pages, FAQs, and other website content

* Optimize new content using SEO best practices

* Research relevant content topics based on keyword opportunities and customer search behavior

* Update older content when opportunities for improvement are identified

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with research, outlines, editing, and content optimization

* Make sure website content is clear, accurate, organized, and useful to both users and search engines



Local SEO & Google Business Profile



A major part of this position will be maintaining and improving our local search presence.



Responsibilities include:



* Maintain and optimize our Google Business Profile

* Create and publish regular Google Business Profile posts

* Upload new project photos, showroom photos, products, and business updates

* Monitor and professionally respond to Google reviews

* Keep services, business descriptions, hours, contact information, and other GBP information accurate

* Monitor Google Maps visibility and local keyword rankings

* Help maintain consistent business information across online directories

* Identify relevant local directories and citation opportunities

* Monitor local competitors and their Google Maps / Google Business Profile activity

* Identify opportunities to improve our visibility for local searches



SEO & GEO Reporting



You will regularly use data to understand what is working and what needs improvement.



You will:



* Monitor keyword rankings

* Review Google Search Console performance

* Review basic GA4 website traffic reports

* Monitor Google Business Profile performance

* Track organic traffic, impressions, clicks, rankings, and local visibility

* Use SEMrush or similar SEO tools to identify website issues and opportunities

* Use tools such as **OtterlyAI** or similar platforms to monitor our visibility in AI-generated search results

* Track whether our company and competitors appear in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI search platforms

* Prepare simple weekly and monthly reports

* Identify basic opportunities or problems from the data

* Make ongoing optimizations based on results and established marketing strategy





Tools You May Work With



Experience with some of the following is preferred:



* SEMrush

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics / GA4

* Google Business Profile

* Google Maps

* OtterlyAI or other GEO / AI visibility tools

* ChatGPT

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* WordPress or other CMS platforms

* Google Sheets / Excel

* Canva





What We’re Looking For



We care more about your **attitude, reliability, and ability to learn** than the number of years on your resume.



You should be:



* Reliable and consistent

* Detail-oriented

* Organized

* Curious and willing to learn

* Comfortable learning new software and AI tools

* Able to follow instructions and documented processes

* Able to work independently once a task has been explained

* Proactive about identifying problems instead of waiting for someone to tell you everything

* Comfortable working with numbers and basic performance reports

* Able to communicate clearly in written and spoken English

* Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Responsible about deadlines and recurring weekly tasks



Qualifications



Ideal candidates may have:



* 1–2 years of SEO or digital marketing experience

* Internship, freelance, school, or personal project experience is welcome

* Basic understanding of on-page SEO

* Basic understanding of keyword research

* Basic understanding of Local SEO

* Experience with Google Business Profile is strongly preferred

* Familiarity with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Ubersuggest, or similar SEO tools

* Familiarity with Google Search Console and GA4

* Basic understanding of how AI tools such as ChatGPT and Google AI search are changing online search



Recent graduates with strong hands-on skills and personal projects are encouraged to apply.



Nice to Have



These are helpful but **not required**:



* WordPress experience

* Basic website editing skills

* Basic HTML knowledge

* Canva

* Schema markup knowledge

* Citation / directory management

* Basic backlink research

* Experience with OtterlyAI

* Experience with Local SEO

* Experience with home improvement, construction, interior design, architecture, cabinetry, or related industries



There will be opportunities for compensation growth as you develop your skills, take on more responsibility, and demonstrate results.



Schedule



* Part-time remote position, about 25 hours/ week.

* Some overlap with Pacific Time business hours may occasionally be required for meetings and communication

* Most SEO and content work can be completed independently according to agreed deadlines



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. A **1–2 minute Loom video** introducing yourself in English

4. Any SEO, website, Google Business Profile, content, or digital marketing projects you have worked on — school projects and personal projects are welcome



Please also answer these questions:



**1. What SEO tools have you used before?**



**2. What tasks have you done inside Google Business Profile?**



**3. If a website page has impressions on Google but very few clicks, what are 2–3 things you would check first?**



**4. What do you know about GEO or optimizing a business to appear in AI search results such as ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews?**

It is completely okay if you are still learning GEO. We want to understand how you think.



**5. Tell us about one software, tool, or skill you taught yourself recently. How did you learn it?**



We are looking for someone who wants to **build real skills and grow with the company long-term**, not someone who is simply looking to complete a list of repetitive tasks.



If you are hardworking, curious, organized, and enjoy learning how search and AI are changing digital marketing, we would love to hear from you.
