title: Sales & Patient Acquisition Lead — $1,000+/month Potential (US Hours)
description:
PLEASE READ FIRST — do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

Applications sent through this site are not reviewed. To be considered, you must apply through our own form here: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a

It takes about 10 minutes and includes a short voice recording.



Hi, I'm Dr. Abrar Al-Shaer, PhD, RD, LDN: a registered dietitian nutritionist and herbalist in the United States. I run Precision Women's Care, an integrative practice where we help women get to the root of their health issues — PCOS, fertility, hormones, gut health, perimenopause — and feel like themselves again.



We're a small, close team, fully remote, and we care a great deal about the women who come to us.



Women find us, reach out, and genuinely want help — and then some of them quietly slip away because nobody followed up well enough. I'm looking for someone to own our front door: the leads, the phone, the follow-up, and the conversation that turns an interested woman into a patient.



This is a sales role, and it's also the first voice a woman hears from our practice. Both have to be true at once.



About the pay, before anything else. Your base is $7/hour, but this role is built so your income follows your results, not the clock. You earn a bonus on every patient and member you bring in, so $1,000+ a month is well within reach if you convert well. Do this properly and you should out-earn the hourly rate comfortably.



What you'll do

- Follow up quickly with every woman who reaches out, and guide her toward booking

- Have the real conversation: what we offer, what it costs, and what's holding her back

- Turn interested women into patients and members

- Keep following up with the ones who say "let me think about it" — this is where most of the value lives

- Answer and return calls on our practice phone during US hours

- Schedule patient follow-ups and make sure nothing sits unanswered



Who I'm looking for



Near-native English comes first, and it isn't negotiable. You'll be on the phone with American women talking about deeply personal things. You need to sound warm, natural, and completely at ease — able to hear hesitation in someone's voice and respond to it. Not scripted. Not stiff.



- You've actually sold something and closed it. Health, wellness, coaching, or memberships is a real plus

- You're comfortable with money. You can say a price out loud and then stay quiet

- You're warm, not pushy. Hard-closing will damage the trust our patients place in us

- You run yourself. You'll own the follow-up. Nobody will chase you

- You can work a consistent 4-hour block each weekday, on US Eastern time

- This role is open to women only. Our patients are women discussing fertility and hormones, and they've told us plainly that they're more comfortable speaking with another woman



The details

- Pay: $7/hour base, plus a bonus on every patient and member you bring in. A strong month lands around $1,000+ per month

- Hours: 20 per week to start — the same 4-hour block each weekday, US Eastern

- Growth: 4-week paid fellowship ? 3 months part-time ? full-time based on performance

- We provide: our practice phone system, Notion, and Toggl



How to apply

1. Application and voice recording: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a.

2. Interview. A real conversation, with some role-play.

3. Fellowship. A paid 4 weeks working alongside us. That's how we both find out if this is right.



If you're wonderful on the phone and you want your work to genuinely change how a woman feels in her own body, I'd love to hear from you.



— Abrar

title: Front-End Web Developer (Elementor)
description:

Our client-facing platform runs on PrestaShop using Element Flow, a page builder built on Elementor. If you know Elementor well, you already know most of what you need — you will not need deep PrestaShop knowledge.

- 3–5 years building sites in Elementor

- Reliable with good English communication skills

- WordPress theme and plugin familiarity beyond Elementor itself

- Reading designs from Figma

- PrestaShop or Element Flow experience



Part-time to start, roughly 20 hours per week. This is intended to grow into a full-time role for the right person.



₱25,000–35,000 per month for part-time hours, depending on experience. Employment is through our local partner in the Philippines, with proper payroll.

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial task: We will have a short interview where we will describe the task to you. We will then send you one mockup, and you build it. Paid at your normal rate regardless of whether we move forward.

# Roofing Claims & Xactimate Estimating Virtual Assistant



**Company:** Apex Adjusters

**Schedule:** U.S. Business Hours

**Position:** Full-Time

**Experience Level:** Experienced / Skilled



## About Apex Adjusters



Apex Adjusters is a growing public adjusting company specializing in residential property and roofing insurance claims.



We are looking for a **highly experienced Roofing Claims & Xactimate Virtual Assistant** who can take ownership of the estimating and administrative side of our claims process.



**This is NOT a general VA position. Xactimate experience is REQUIRED.**



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience creating roofing estimates in Xactimate, understands insurance claims, and is comfortable communicating directly with insurance adjusters.



## Key Responsibilities



### Xactimate Estimating — REQUIRED



* Create detailed and accurate roofing estimates using **Xactimate**.

* Build estimates based on inspection reports, roof measurements, photos, videos, and scopes of work.

* Select appropriate Xactimate line items and quantities.

* Review estimates for accuracy, completeness, and missing scope.

* Identify additional damage and necessary line items.

* Revise estimates based on adjuster feedback and additional documentation.

* Prepare and submit supplements.

* Compare carrier estimates against our estimates and identify discrepancies.

* Ensure estimates are professionally organized and properly documented.

* Make corrections and revisions independently when necessary.



### Insurance Claims



* Assist with managing residential property insurance claims from inspection through settlement.

* Prepare and organize claim documentation.

* Review inspection reports, photos, measurements, estimates, and other supporting documentation.

* Track claim status and outstanding items.

* Assist with supplements, revisions, and additional documentation.

* Maintain organized digital claim files.

* Keep accurate notes and records for every claim.



### Insurance Adjuster Communication



* Communicate directly with insurance adjusters via **
**.

* Follow up with adjusters regarding estimates, supplements, inspections, and claim status.

* Discuss estimate discrepancies and scope differences professionally.

* Request updates on pending claims.

* Coordinate inspections and re-inspections when necessary.

* Respond to adjuster requests for additional documentation.

* Maintain professional and persistent follow-up until outstanding issues are resolved.



### Administrative & Follow-Up



* Track multiple open claims and deadlines.

* Follow up on outstanding tasks without needing constant supervision.

* Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, and claim tracking systems.

* Organize photos, reports, measurements, estimates, correspondence, and other claim documents.

* Communicate with contractors and homeowners when needed.

* Help ensure every claim continues moving forward.

* Provide general administrative support related to claims and estimating.



## REQUIRED Qualifications



**Applicants must meet the following requirements:**



* **Proficient in Xactimate — REQUIRED.**

* Demonstrated experience creating **roofing estimates in Xactimate**.

* Experience with insurance property claims.

* Experience with supplements and estimate revisions.

* Understanding of roofing terminology and construction.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Excellent communication skills.

* Comfortable speaking directly with insurance adjusters.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Excellent organization and follow-up skills.

* Able to manage multiple claims simultaneously.

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

* Available to work during U.S. business hours.



## Strongly Preferred



Experience with:



* Residential roofing claims

* Storm damage claims

* Wind and hail claims

* Public adjusting

* Insurance supplements

* Carrier estimate comparison

* Roof measurements

* Property damage estimating

* Construction estimating

* Insurance carrier portals

* CRM systems



## The Type of Person We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who can **think independently and take ownership of the claims process.**



You should be able to receive a claim file, review the available information, identify what needs to be done, create or revise the estimate, communicate with the adjuster, and follow up until the next step is completed.



We do **not** want someone who simply waits for instructions.



You should be:



* Proactive

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Organized

* Persistent with follow-up

* Professional on the phone

* Comfortable communicating with insurance professionals

* Able to prioritize multiple claims

* Comfortable working independently



## Xactimate Experience Verification



**Applicants may be required to complete an Xactimate skills test or provide a sample of previous estimating work.**



Please do not apply if you have only basic or limited exposure to Xactimate.



We are specifically looking for someone who can **independently create professional roofing estimates in Xactimate.**

Online ESL English Teacher 

Job Type 

Full-time / Part-time (Long-term Cooperation)

Work Location

Job Overview 

We are an online English education company focusing on providing high-quality one-on-one English courses for Chinese children, teenagers and adult learners. We are now recruiting a large number of professional Filipino online ESL teachers. Teachers are required to conduct online oral English teaching, pronunciation correction and situational English training according to standardized teaching courses, create a lively and interactive classroom atmosphere, and help students improve their oral English ability and learning interest steadily.

Job Responsibilities 

1. Deliver high-quality 1-on-1 online English lessons for Chinese students of all ages, including daily oral English, situational conversation, pronunciation correction, basic grammar and listening training.

2. Strictly follow the company’s unified curriculum standards, teaching process and classroom norms to complete daily teaching tasks.

3. Be responsible for pre-class preparation, in-class interactive teaching, after-class homework checking, learning feedback and student learning record updating.

4. Adapt to the learning characteristics of Chinese students, use patient and lively teaching methods to guide students to speak actively and improve classroom participation.

5. Accept fixed shift arrangement, guarantee stable attendance, actively cooperate with pre-job training, teaching evaluation and curriculum optimization work.

6. Properly handle student learning problems, maintain good teacher-student relationship and ensure high student satisfaction and retention rate.

Job Requirements 

1. Must be pure Filipino nationality, currently residing in the Philippines with a fixed residence.

2. Bachelor’s degree or above, major in English, Education or Linguistics is preferred.

3. Possess 120-hour TEFL/TESOL certification or valid Philippine professional teacher license (verifiable officially).

4. Neutral and clear English accent, no strong local dialect, suitable for Chinese students’ listening habits.

5. At least 1 year of online ESL teaching experience, experienced in teaching Chinese students is highly preferred.

6. Equipped with independent quiet teaching environment, stable fiber network (50Mbps+), HD webcam and noise-canceling microphone.

7. Patient, outgoing, responsible, good at classroom interaction; able to adapt to Chinese peak class time.

8. No bad teaching records, no criminal record, abide by company teaching management rules.

Working Time 

1. Priority shift: 18:00-23:00 Beijing Time (Daily peak hours)

2. Full weekend working hours available

3. Full-time teachers need to complete fixed daily class hours; part-time teachers can arrange classes flexibly according to schedule

Salary & Benefits

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to Founder / CEO



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Australian Business Hours



About the Role



I’m an Australian entrepreneur operating multiple growing businesses across education, retail, eCommerce, software and the barbering industry.



I’m looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with me as the Founder/CEO and become a key part of our business operations.



This is not a basic Virtual Assistant role.



I’m looking for someone highly organised, proactive, commercially minded and confident enough to take ownership of responsibilities without needing constant instructions.



Your job is to help me operate at a higher level by protecting my time, keeping me organised, coordinating with my teams and making sure important tasks actually get completed.



You will become the central point between me and different people across our businesses.



The right person will eventually know what needs to happen before I need to ask.



⸻



Your Core Responsibilities



1. Executive Calendar Management



You will take ownership of my calendar and schedule.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing my daily and weekly calendar

* Scheduling internal and external meetings

* Rescheduling appointments when required

* Preventing scheduling conflicts

* Coordinating meetings across different team members

* Protecting blocks of time for important work

* Making sure I have enough travel/preparation time between commitments

* Reminding me of important meetings and deadlines

* Making sure meetings have a clear purpose before being added to my calendar



You should be comfortable managing a busy founder’s schedule and making sensible decisions about priorities.



⸻



2.
 & Inbox Management



You will help manage and organise my inbox.



This includes:



* Reviewing incoming
s

* Identifying urgent or important messages

* Organising and categorising
s

* Drafting responses for my approval

* Responding to routine
s where authorised

* Following up unanswered
s

* Making sure important conversations don’t get forgotten

* Unsubscribing and removing unnecessary inbox clutter

* Keeping my inbox organised



The goal is that I should not need to spend hours every day processing
.



⸻



3. Daily Founder Organisation



Every morning, I want a clear understanding of what requires my attention.



You will prepare a daily executive summary including:



Today’s Priorities



The most important things I need to complete.



Today’s Meetings



What meetings I have and anything I need to know beforehand.



Waiting on Others



Tasks or information we are waiting for from employees, suppliers or external partners.



Needs Approval



Anything that requires a decision from me.



Important Updates



Anything across the businesses that I should know about.



You will also help ensure unfinished priorities don’t disappear.



⸻



4. Task & Project Management



You will maintain a central system for my tasks and commitments.



Responsibilities include:



* Turning conversations and voice notes into actionable tasks

* Assigning tasks to the correct team member

* Recording deadlines

* Following up outstanding tasks

* Maintaining project/task management software

* Tracking commitments made during meetings

* Escalating overdue or important items

* Preparing weekly outstanding-task reports



If I say:



“We need to get this done.”



I want you to make sure it becomes a tracked task with an owner and deadline rather than disappearing into a conversation.



⸻



5. Team Accountability & Follow-Up



A major part of your position will be following up with people on my behalf.



You may communicate with:



* Managers

* Sales teams

* Marketing teams

* Contractors

* Accountants

* Bookkeepers

* Developers

* Suppliers

* Agencies

* Business partners



You will:



* Request updates

* Chase overdue work

* Collect reports

* Confirm deadlines

* Schedule meetings

* Document commitments

* Escalate issues when required



You must be comfortable professionally holding people accountable.



⸻



6. Meeting Management



For important meetings, you will help with:



Before meetings:



* Prepare agenda

* Collect relevant documents

* Gather KPIs/information

* Identify outstanding actions from previous meetings



During/after meetings:



* Take or organise meeting notes

* Extract decisions

* Create action items

* Assign owners

* Add deadlines

* Follow up until actions are completed



Meetings should create action, not just conversation.



⸻



7. Business Reporting & KPI Collection



You will help me maintain visibility across multiple businesses.



You may be responsible for collecting and organising information including:



* Weekly revenue

* Sales performance

* Leads generated

* Conversion rates

* Marketing performance

* Staffing information

* Outstanding projects

* Business expenses

* Operational issues

* Customer/student metrics



You are not expected to be an accountant.



Your responsibility is to make sure the correct information reaches me in a clear and organised format.



⸻



8. Recruitment & HR Administration



You will assist with recruitment as our companies grow.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating and posting job advertisements

* Organising applicants

* Initial candidate screening

* Shortlisting candidates

* Scheduling interviews

* Sending interview reminders

* Coordinating reference checks

* Preparing onboarding documentation

* Maintaining employee records

* Following up required paperwork



⸻



9. Research



You should be comfortable conducting detailed online research.



Examples include:



* Competitor research

* Supplier research

* Software comparisons

* Recruitment research

* Market research

* Pricing comparisons

* Business opportunities

* Potential partnerships

* Travel research

* Product research



I don’t just want links.



I want information summarised clearly so I can make a decision quickly.



⸻



10. Finance & Administration Support



You may assist with:



* Organising invoices

* Organising receipts

* Preparing documents for accountants/bookkeepers

* Following up invoices

* Maintaining expense records

* Gathering financial reports

* Liaising with accountants

* Tracking subscriptions and renewals

* Organising financial documents



You will not initially have unrestricted authority to move company funds or make major financial decisions.



⸻



11. Travel & Personal Administration



From time to time, you may also assist with personal executive administration.



Examples include:



* Flight research

* Hotel research

* Travel itineraries

* Restaurant reservations

* Appointment scheduling

* Event bookings

* Reminders

* Renewals

* Personal purchases/research



The purpose is to remove low-value administrative work from my schedule so I can focus on growing the companies.



⸻



What I’m Looking For



You should be:



* Extremely organised

* Reliable

* Proactive

* Detail-oriented

* Confident

* Resourceful

* Fast-moving

* Comfortable with responsibility

* Excellent at written English

* A strong communicator

* Comfortable working directly with a Founder/CEO

* Able to manage multiple priorities

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable following people up

* Good at identifying problems before they become bigger problems



Most importantly:



I don’t want someone who waits all day for instructions.



If you notice something hasn’t been completed, follow it up.



If a deadline is approaching, remind the relevant person.



If something doesn’t make sense, ask.



If you can solve something without unnecessarily involving me, solve it.



If something requires my decision, give me the information I need to make that decision quickly.



⸻



What Success Looks Like



After several months working together:



* My calendar is organised.

* My inbox is under control.

* I know my priorities every morning.

* Important tasks aren’t forgotten.

* Team members are being followed up.

* Meetings result in documented actions.

* Reports arrive before I need to ask for them.

* Documents are organised.

* Deadlines are being tracked.

* I spend significantly less time on administration.

* I have better visibility across my businesses.



Ultimately, your job is to give me back time and increase the speed at which our companies operate.



⸻



Software & Tools



Experience with some of the following is beneficial:



* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* Google Calendar

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Office

* Slack

* ClickUp / Asana / Monday / Notion

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* CRM platforms

* Canva



You don’t need experience with every platform.



You do need to be technologically confident and capable of learning new software quickly.



⸻



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



You must be comfortable working hours that substantially overlap with Melbourne, Australia business hours (AEST/AEDT).



Exact working hours will be discussed with the successful candidate.



⸻



Salary



Up to ₱100,000 PHP per month depending on experience and capability.



We are prepared to pay well for an exceptional candidate.



There will also be opportunities for:



* Performance bonuses

* Salary progression

* Increased responsibility

* Long-term career development



For the right person, this is intended to be a long-term position, not a short-term VA contract.



As the businesses grow, I want this role to grow with them.



⸻



Career Opportunity



There is significant opportunity for advancement.



Someone exceptional could progress from:



Executive Assistant



→ Senior Executive Assistant



→ Executive Operations Manager



→ Chief of Staff / Operations Leadership



I value people who take ownership, develop their capabilities and want to grow alongside the businesses they work with.



⸻



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant experience.

3. An example of a time you proactively solved a problem for an executive or business owner without being asked.

4. The software/platforms you are confident using.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

6. Your availability to start.

7. A short 60–90 second video introduction explaining why you believe you would be excellent in this role.



Important Application Instruction



At the very beginning of your application, write:



“READY TO EXECUTE”



Applications that don’t include this phrase will not be considered.



We receive a large number of applications and attention to detail is extremely important for this position.



If you’re ambitious, organised, highly accountable and want the opportunity to become the right hand to an entrepreneur building multiple companies, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Pinterest & SEO specialist
description:
Pinterest SEO + Blog Content Specialist

Tylar Brooke Photography | Part-Time / Freelance | Remote



Tylar Brooke Photography is looking for a creative, organized, SEO-minded person to help grow our online presence through Pinterest and strategic blog content.



Our website is hosted on Showit with a WordPress blog, so experience working within Showit and WordPress is highly preferred.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that Pinterest is more than a social platform. It’s a search engine, and we want to use it intentionally to drive traffic to our website, improve Google rankings, and get our work in front of couples searching for wedding photographers in Florida, Virginia, and destination locations.



What You’ll Be Doing

Pinterest Management

Create and schedule Pinterest pins consistently each week

Design pins using our existing photography and brand assets

Write SEO-optimized Pinterest titles and descriptions

Conduct Pinterest keyword research based on what our ideal clients are actively searching

Organize and optimize Pinterest boards for searchability

Pin new blog posts, galleries, weddings, engagements, travel content, and educational content

Repurpose older website content into fresh pins

Create multiple pin variations from high-performing content

Monitor Pinterest analytics and adjust strategy based on performance

Identify trending searches, locations, venues, styles, and wedding-related topics we should capitalize on

Maintain a consistent visual aesthetic that aligns with the TBP brand

Blogging + Website SEO

Write, format, and publish SEO-focused blog posts directly through our WordPress blog

Work comfortably within our Showit + WordPress website setup

Use galleries and information provided by TBP to create valuable, search-friendly content

Research keywords and search intent before writing

Optimize blog titles, headings, image alt text, meta descriptions, URLs, and internal links

Write venue-specific and location-specific posts designed to rank on Google

Create content targeting markets we want to grow, especially:



Southwest Florida

Naples

Sarasota

Tampa

Destination weddings + elopements

Virginia + DC when strategically relevant

Turn real weddings and sessions into searchable, valuable blog content rather than simple gallery recaps

Identify opportunities for new blog topics based on SEO research

Update and improve older blog posts when beneficial

Understand how SEO changes made within WordPress interact with the overall Showit website

Connect blog strategy with Pinterest so the two platforms actively drive traffic to one another

What We’re Looking For

You don’t necessarily need to be a photographer, but you do need to understand visual brands and SEO-driven content.



The ideal person:



Has experience with Pinterest SEO, Google SEO, blogging, or content marketing

Has experience with WordPress

Showit experience is highly preferred

Understands keyword research and search intent

Is comfortable publishing and formatting blog posts independently

Has strong writing skills without sounding robotic or overly SEO-heavy

Has an eye for design and understands elevated photography/wedding brands

Can learn and maintain the Tylar Brooke Photography voice

Is comfortable with Canva

Understands basic website and on-page SEO

Is extremely organized and consistent

Pays attention to details

Can analyze what’s working instead of simply posting content to check a box

Bonus if you have experience specifically with photographers, wedding vendors, destination wedding SEO, Showit websites, and WordPress blogs

What Success Looks Like

We’re not looking for someone to simply “keep Pinterest active.”



The goal of this position is to:



Increase website traffic → improve search rankings → reach couples in our target markets → generate qualified photography inquiries.



We want someone who can look at our existing content and think strategically about how we can get more mileage out of it.



Example Responsibilities Each Month

Depending on the agreed-upon workload, this could include:



Keyword + content research

Consistent Pinterest scheduling

Creating multiple pins from each new gallery/blog

Writing, formatting, and publishing SEO blog posts in WordPress

Optimizing existing blog content

Reviewing Pinterest and website analytics

Identifying new SEO opportunities for the Showit website

Providing a short monthly update on traffic, rankings, top-performing pins/posts, and opportunities for the following month

To Apply

Please send:



A little about yourself and your experience

Examples of Pinterest accounts, blogs, or websites you’ve worked on

Any SEO results or growth you’ve helped achieve

Whether you have experience with Showit and WordPress

Your availability

Your preferred monthly rate or hourly rate

The tools/platforms you’re comfortable working with

Bonus: Tell me one thing you would immediately look at or change when taking over a photographer’s Pinterest or blog SEO.



We’re looking for someone who wants to take ownership of this side of the business and help us build a strong, long-term organic traffic strategy as Tylar Brooke Photography expands into new markets.

title: Senior SEO & AI Visibility Strategist
description:
Senior SEO & AI Visibility Strategist

Are you passionate about driving growth through SEO, AI search, and innovative web solutions?



Do you have a proven track record of not just reporting on results, but proactively finding what we should do next?



If this sounds like you, we have the perfect opportunity.



This role is for someone ready to make a big impact in a growing organization. You’ll lead the charge in improving organic growth, search rankings, AI visibility, website performance, and ultimately qualified leads for our clients.



This is not a role where you wait for a task list.



We’re looking for someone who can look at a client’s website, competitors, data, and market and tell us what we should be doing next.



You’ll work alongside a dynamic marketing, design, and development team while owning SEO and AI visibility strategy across multiple client accounts.



You’ll be working across SEO, AEO/GEO, backlinking, content, local search, website optimization, and emerging AI search strategies. The role is intentionally built to evolve as search evolves.



Role & Responsibilities

Own the ongoing execution, optimization, and delivery of SEO, Local SEO, and AI search strategies for a portfolio of 30+ client accounts, ensuring every client receives consistent, proactive attention, measurable progress, and strategic recommendations on a recurring basis.



To accomplish this, you will be responsible for the following:



SEO Strategy & Management

Perform comprehensive keyword, search intent, competitor, and opportunity research.



Conduct regular technical SEO audits and implement or coordinate fixes.



Optimize titles, metadata, headers, internal linking, site architecture, indexing, and crawlability.



Develop topical authority strategies across service pages, landing pages, blogs, FAQs, and other content.



Implement structured data and advanced schema markup.



Identify opportunities to refresh, expand, consolidate, redirect, or improve existing content.



Track organic traffic, rankings, qualified leads, conversions, and share of search.



Continuously adjust strategy based on performance, competition, algorithm changes, and business goals.



AI Search Visibility, AEO & GEO

Search is changing quickly, and we want someone who is excited to help us stay ahead of it.



Develop strategies to increase client visibility across Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Bing Copilot, Claude, and emerging AI search experiences.



Implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies.



Improve entity signals, semantic relevance, structured data, content architecture, and brand authority.



Monitor where clients and competitors appear, get cited, or are recommended within AI-generated answers.



Identify important questions and searches where clients should be visible but currently are not.



Develop content and authority strategies designed to improve both traditional search and AI visibility.



Stay ahead of changes in how AI platforms discover, interpret, cite, and recommend businesses.



Experiment with emerging strategies and tools while measuring whether they actually create business value.



Backlinks, Authority & Digital PR

Build and maintain high-quality backlink and authority strategies.



Identify competitor backlink gaps and new link opportunities.



Develop campaigns around editorial links, digital PR, industry citations, partnerships, directories, and relevant placements.



Identify and reclaim broken links and unlinked brand mentions.



Prioritize relevance and authority over simply generating backlink volume.



Look for creative opportunities to strengthen client authority beyond traditional link-building tactics.



Local SEO & Google Business Profile

Create, audit, and optimize Google Business Profiles.



Optimize categories, services, products, descriptions, photos, attributes, hours, and business information.



Develop GBP content and posting strategies.



Monitor reviews, rankings, competitor activity, and unauthorized profile changes.



Conduct citation and NAP audits and manage directory campaigns.



Optimize Bing Business and other relevant local search properties.



Develop local strategies for multi-location businesses and individual provider profiles.



Proactively identify opportunities to improve local rankings, visibility, calls, leads, and conversions.



Website Development & Optimization

Ensure websites are fast, secure, technically healthy, and mobile-friendly.



Implement changes in WordPress and Elementor.



Improve Core Web Vitals, page speed, navigation, and user experience.



Monitor uptime, troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with developers and hosting providers.



Maintain plugins, themes, integrations, redirects, sitemaps, and technical configurations.



Identify website improvements that can increase both organic traffic and conversions.



Work proactively with our development team when larger technical changes are required.



Content & Conversion Optimization

Collaborate with marketing and copywriting teams to create SEO and AI-friendly content.



Develop content clusters, pillar pages, FAQs, service pages, location pages, and supporting content.



Identify content gaps and new opportunities based on competitors, search behavior, and AI visibility.



Recommend improvements to calls-to-action, landing pages, forms, and conversion paths.



Utilize A/B testing, analytics, heatmaps, and user behavior when appropriate to improve conversion rates.



Think beyond traffic. Help us determine how organic visibility can produce more qualified business opportunities.



Performance Tracking & Proactive Strategy

Reporting is only part of the job. We expect you to tell us what we should do next.



Monitor performance through GA4, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other platforms.



Track traditional SEO performance alongside AI visibility and authority growth.



Provide monthly reporting with clear insights, not just numbers.



Identify new opportunities, risks, competitor movement, and quick wins every month.



Maintain a rolling 90-day strategy for each client.



Provide a 3–6 month forecast of priorities, expected opportunities, risks, and recommended initiatives.



Clearly communicate:



What happened



What we learned



What we're doing next



Why we're doing it



Proactively bring recommendations to the team rather than waiting for someone to request them.



Collaboration & Innovation

Work closely with marketing, design, development, paid media, and copywriting teams.



Bring proactive ideas and recommendations to the team without waiting to be asked.



Stay current on Google algorithm changes, AI search developments, SEO best practices, and emerging tools.



Test new strategies and technologies when they can create measurable client value.



Manage freelancers or contractors when needed to ensure deliverables and timelines are met.



Help improve our internal SEO processes, systems, reporting, and service offerings as we scale.



Necessary Skills & Qualifications

4+ years of proven SEO experience, preferably managing multiple agency clients.



Demonstrated success growing organic visibility, qualified traffic, leads, and conversions.



Strong understanding of technical SEO, Local SEO, content strategy, backlinking, and authority building.



Working knowledge of AEO, GEO, entity SEO, AI search visibility, and emerging search behavior.



Proficiency with WordPress, GA4, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog.



Experience working with WordPress and Elementor.



Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, schema, and basic JavaScript.



Ability to turn data into proactive recommendations and long-term strategy.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple client strategies and priorities simultaneously.



Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and opportunities evolve.



A proactive ownership mentality.



We should not have to ask you what we should be doing next.



How We Measure Success

We care about rankings, but rankings alone aren't the goal.



Success includes:



Qualified organic traffic and lead growth



Organic conversions and measurable business impact



Search visibility and market share



AI search visibility, citations, and recommendations



Topical and brand authority



High-quality backlinks and mentions



Local and Google Business Profile performance



Website health and conversion improvements



Progress against 90-day strategies and 3–6 month forecasts



Consistently bringing new ideas and opportunities to clients



Ultimately, we want our clients to feel that we are thinking about their business before they have to ask us to.



The Mindset We're Looking For

We're not looking for someone who simply wants to execute tasks.



We're looking for someone who wants to help build something exceptional.



We are growing quickly, and we're investing heavily in becoming a leader in SEO, Local SEO, and AI search.



That means we're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape processes, improve our services, introduce new ideas, and help define what great looks like as we continue to scale.



We don't want someone who waits for a checklist.



We want someone who:



Takes ownership.



Finds opportunities.



Challenges existing strategies when necessary.



Tests new ideas.



Thinks strategically about our clients' businesses.



Proactively leads the charge.



The question we want you constantly asking is:



“If this were my business, what would I do next?”



If you love figuring out what's next, staying ahead of SEO and AI search, testing new ideas, and turning those ideas into measurable growth, we want to hear from you.



Work Hours & Availability

This is a remote position, but you must be available and actively working during U.S. business hours.



Our standard working hours are:



8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT), Monday through Friday



You do not need to live in the United States, but you must be able to consistently work these hours, collaborate with our U.S.-based team in real time, attend meetings, and be responsive during the workday.



Please make sure this schedule works for you before applying.



How to Apply

We care about initiative, communication, and attention to detail, so there is one important part of the application:



Send Us a Personalized Video

Please send us a personalized 2–3 minute video created specifically for this application.



At the beginning of the video, address our team directly so we know this isn't a generic or recycled application video.



Then answer these three questions:



1. Why this role?

Why do you want this position, and why do you believe you would be a great fit for our team specifically?



2. What's a result you've personally driven?

Tell us about one SEO result you're most proud of. Explain what you personally did and, whenever possible, include the measurable result.



3. What do you see coming next?

SEO and AI search are changing quickly. What are you doing right now to stay ahead, and what is one strategy or opportunity you think most agencies are currently missing?



Keep it natural.



We care much more about how you think, communicate, and solve problems than production quality.



Send Your Application To

Send your application here: 



Use the subject line:



“Hire Me – SEO & AI Visibility Strategist”



Please include:



Your personalized 2–3 minute video



Your resume or LinkedIn profile



1–2 examples of SEO results, case studies, or work you personally contributed to



Please do not send a generic introduction video. The personalized video is an important part of our application process.



If you're excited about owning strategy, finding opportunities before someone asks, and helping define what great SEO and AI visibility looks like moving forward, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Support Experts Needed
description:
We are now hiring Customer Support Experts to assist our customers over the phone.



This is a full-time position with long-term growth potential.



Customers will call us for assistance with various online tasks, such as:



- Checking their email accounts

- Purchasing items they need

- Signing up for services

- Logging into or managing their accounts

- Checking or signing up for credit score reports

- Conducting general online searches



All tasks we handle can be completed online, so candidates should be comfortable navigating websites and online tools.



Requirements:



- Fluent English communication skills

- Good attention to detail and problem-solving skills

- Reliable and fast internet connection

- Quiet and professional workspace

- Full availability for a full-time position

- Must be based in the Philippines

- Previous phone-based BPO customer support experience is strongly preferred, especially experience handling customer calls in a fast-paced environment



We are looking for dependable professionals who can communicate well with customers, follow processes, and provide consistent support. Candidates with strong BPO experience and a proven work history are encouraged to apply.



PAY & EARNING STRUCTURE



- Base rate starts at $4.50 per hour.

- Agents usually work 10 hours per day including the paid breaks, and we allow more hours if someone wants to earn more.

- During busy times, we also pay time-and-a-half overtime, which will be calculated as your current rate multiplied by 1.5, when we need additional coverage.

- Good performers can earn a monthly bonus between $80 and $150.

- There is a $50 monthly attendance bonus for consistent on-time performance.

- Every 6 months, we evaluate performance and agents can receive up to an extra $0.50 per hour added to their rate if they are doing well.



With base hours plus bonuses and performance increases, a strong performer can earn up to around $1,100 per month.



HIRING PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will complete a quiz that typically takes about one hour.



Candidates who pass the quiz will proceed to two live mock calls or skill assessments:



- The first assessment usually takes around 20 minutes.

- The second assessment is more comprehensive and typically takes about one hour.



After successfully completing the assessments, selected candidates will proceed with orientation and training.



Please note that our assessments are designed to evaluate communication skills, accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to handle customer interactions effectively.



Please apply only if you are fully available for a full-time position.



When You Apply*



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many hours are you available daily, and on which days of the week?

2. How soon are you ready to start?



Lastly, please include a link to a Vocaroo audio recording (minimum 45 seconds) where you briefly introduce yourself. Tell us a bit about your background, relevant experience, and one hobby you genuinely enjoy. This is a voice account and you will be supporting customers, so it's essential that you send a high-quality voice recording.



Thanks,

Alfred

title: WANTED! A Detail Obsessed Remote TikTok Video Editor
description:
# WANTED! A Detail Obsessed Remote TikTok Video Editor



When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: "I actually read the instructions"



## Who we are



We run a growing TikTok Shop affiliate content brand built around wellness and beauty for women over 50. Our audience is real women navigating body changes, health, and confidence, and our content speaks directly to them with honesty and warmth, never gimmicks. We are building toward 5,000 followers and a steady rhythm of daily posting, and we need a sharp, reliable editor to help us keep that machine running every single day.



## What we're looking for



We need a remote video editor who can turn raw clips into polished, scroll stopping TikToks on a daily schedule. You will not be filming or writing scripts. We supply the raw footage and creative direction. Your job is to cut it, pace it, and package it so it is ready to post.



This role has two very different editing modes each day, and you need to be comfortable switching between them quickly.



## Job description



**Key responsibilities**



* Edit 1 short follow style video daily using our provided b roll, following our SOP. These are quick, 6 to 8 second final videos and should take you about 10 minutes each.

* Edit 1 TikTok Shop video daily. We supply the raw footage and overlay images. You will assemble, pace, and polish it. These take about 20 to 30 minutes each.

* Research and pull TikTok inspiration videos in our niche to help guide the style, pacing, and trends for our Shop videos, and organize them for our review.

* Deliver all 3 finished videos daily into a shared folder, ready for us to post, by a consistent daily deadline.

* Keep finished videos organized and clearly labeled so nothing gets lost or posted out of order.

* Flag anything unclear in the footage or direction right away instead of guessing.



**Qualifications, skills, and experience**



* Strong, demonstrable TikTok editing skills, ideally with CapCut.

* An eye for pacing, trends, and what actually stops the scroll on TikTok.

* Comfortable doing quick turnaround short edits and more detailed longer edits in the same day.

* Organized and dependable. You do not need to be told twice where a file goes.

* Able to research trends independently and bring back useful inspiration, not just anything that shows up first.

* Good written English for quick daily check ins.



## Rate and schedule



Because our video lengths and editing time vary quite a bit day to day, we are not setting a flat per video rate. Instead, tell us your rate expectations when you apply, and how you would structure it (hourly, daily, or another way that makes sense to you) given the workload described above.



Expected daily workload is about 1 to 2 hours total across all 3 videos.



Schedule is flexible and we will work out the specific days together with the right hire. This is not necessarily a strict 7 day a week commitment, but consistency matters a lot here, so we need someone who can commit to a steady, dependable cadence once we agree on it.



**Growth opportunities**



* As we hit our follower and monetization goals, there is room to take on more editing volume and a higher rate.

* Reliable, high quality editors who understand our style will be first in line as we expand content output.



## Successful editor personality profile



The people who do best in this role tend to be calm, organized, and quietly meticulous. You take pride in a clean cut and a well timed beat drop. You do not need constant direction once you understand the style, and you notice small details, like a mistimed caption or an awkward cut, before anyone has to point them out. You are dependable enough that we do not have to wonder if the folder will be ready in the morning.



**Important personality traits**



* Detail oriented

* Self directed

* Reliable

* Calm under a daily deadline



**What energizes you**



* Clean, satisfying edits

* Consistent daily rhythm

* Being trusted to run with a style guide

* Small wins that add up over time



## Make sure you're comfortable with



Remote working. This is a work from home position. If you do not have a quiet space with reliable power and internet, this is not the right fit.



Daily deadlines. This is not a batch it once a week role. We need 3 finished videos every single day, on time, without reminders.



Switching gears quickly. You will move between a 10 minute quick edit and a 20 to 30 minute detailed edit in the same session.



Working from raw, sometimes imperfect footage. We are not professional videographers. You will need to make good footage out of what we give you, not wait for perfect clips.



## Our values



**Honesty.** If something in the footage will not work, tell us early. If a deadline is at risk, say so before it is missed, not after.



**Ownership.** We would rather you flag a problem and propose a fix than wait to be told what to do.



**Consistency.** Showing up every day, on time, with quality work is more important to us than occasional brilliance with gaps in between.



## To apply



If you're interested, please submit the following:



* A link to your portfolio or sample edits, ideally TikTok style content

* Your rate expectations and how you would structure them (hourly, daily, or otherwise) for the workload described above

* How many hours a day you can realistically commit, and which days of the week work for you

* Your answer to this question: what is the fastest turnaround you have ever done on a short form video, and what was it for?

* Your answer to this question: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?



Submissions should go to: 



## Thank you



We're looking for someone exceptional to help us grow something we care a lot about. If you love clean edits, a steady daily rhythm, and being trusted to run with a style once you learn it, we would love to hear from you.



If anything about the role or the instructions is not clear, do not hesitate to reach out. We are happy to answer questions.



Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

title: Amazon Seller Central & PPC Advertising Specialist
description:
Job Type: Full-Time or Part-Time

Department: E-Commerce / Digital Marketing

Reports To: E-Commerce / Digital Marketing Manager



About the Role



Tarp Supply Inc. is seeking an experienced, results-driven Amazon Seller Central & PPC Advertising Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale our Amazon business and advertising campaigns.



This is a hands-on position for an individual who has direct experience working inside Amazon Seller Central and managing Amazon PPC advertising for an e-commerce brand.



The ideal candidate understands that successful Amazon advertising is not simply about increasing impressions, clicks, or sales. The goal is to generate profitable revenue, improve organic and paid visibility, control ACOS and TACOS, increase conversion rates, and grow the Amazon channel sustainably.



The successful candidate will take ownership of Amazon advertising performance while working closely with our e-commerce, marketing, sales, inventory, and management teams.



Key Responsibilities

1. Amazon PPC Advertising Management

Create, manage, optimize, and scale Amazon PPC campaigns.

Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

Build and optimize automatic and manual campaigns.

Develop keyword, product-targeting, category-targeting, and competitor-targeting strategies.

Conduct extensive Amazon keyword and competitor research.

Identify high-intent, high-converting search terms.

Regularly analyze Amazon Search Term Reports.

Add negative keywords and negative product targets to reduce wasted advertising spend.

Optimize keyword match types, including broad, phrase, and exact match.

Manage bids, placements, budgets, and bidding strategies.

Optimize Top of Search, Product Pages, and other placement opportunities.

Develop branded and non-branded campaign strategies.

Develop competitor-conquesting campaigns when appropriate.

Identify profitable campaigns and scale them responsibly.

Reduce or eliminate spending on underperforming keywords, products, and campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven adjustments.

2. Amazon Seller Central Management

Work directly and independently inside Amazon Seller Central.

Monitor account health and identify issues requiring attention.

Manage and optimize product listings.

Review listing suppressions, errors, and other Seller Central issues.

Monitor inventory and coordinate advertising decisions with product availability.

Understand and work with both FBA and FBM operations.

Monitor Buy Box performance and identify potential issues.

Review Amazon business reports and performance data.

Manage variations and parent-child product relationships when necessary.

Assist with Amazon case management and Seller Support issues related to listings and advertising.

Maintain organized records of Seller Central and advertising activities.

3. Listing & Conversion Optimization

Optimize Amazon product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, search terms, and other listing elements.

Conduct Amazon SEO and keyword research.

Improve keyword indexing and organic search visibility.

Recommend improvements to product images and infographics.

Optimize A+ Content where applicable.

Work with Brand Store and branded content where applicable.

Analyze product detail-page conversion rates.

Identify reasons customers may not be converting after clicking an advertisement.

Conduct appropriate testing of listing content, images, titles, and other elements.

Coordinate advertising strategy with listing optimization to improve overall conversion performance.

4. Keyword & Competitor Research

Conduct ongoing Amazon keyword research.

Identify high-volume and high-purchase-intent keywords.

Analyze competitor listings, pricing, reviews, positioning, and advertising strategies.

Identify keyword gaps and new advertising opportunities.

Analyze competitors appearing in Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands placements.

Identify relevant competitor ASINs for product-targeting campaigns.

Monitor changes in competitive positioning and recommend appropriate actions.

5. Advertising Profitability & Optimization



The Amazon PPC Specialist will be expected to monitor and improve key metrics, including:



Amazon Advertising Sales

ACOS – Advertising Cost of Sales

TACOS – Total Advertising Cost of Sales

ROAS – Return on Advertising Spend

Conversion Rate

Cost Per Click (CPC)

Click-Through Rate (CTR)

Orders

Revenue

Organic Sales

Paid Sales

Advertising Spend

Product-level profitability



The candidate must understand the difference between increasing Amazon sales and increasing profitable Amazon sales.



Advertising decisions should consider product cost, Amazon fees, fulfillment costs, shipping costs, margins, inventory, and overall profitability whenever appropriate.



6. Campaign Scaling

Identify profitable campaigns, keywords, ASINs, and products that can support additional advertising investment.

Develop strategies for scaling campaigns without allowing ACOS or TACOS to become unprofitable.

Allocate budgets based on performance and business priorities.

Support new-product launches with appropriate PPC strategies.

Develop strategies for established products and best sellers.

Adjust campaigns based on inventory availability and seasonality.

Develop promotional advertising strategies for major Amazon shopping periods and other seasonal opportunities.

7. Reporting & Analysis

Prepare clear weekly and monthly Amazon PPC performance reports.

Report advertising spend, sales, ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, conversion rate, orders, and other important KPIs.

Identify top-performing and underperforming campaigns.

Identify top-performing keywords and search terms.

Identify wasted advertising spend.

Provide clear recommendations and action plans.

Maintain change logs and document major campaign optimizations.

Explain not only what happened, but also why it happened and what should be done next.

Required Qualifications

Proven hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.

Proven experience managing Amazon PPC advertising campaigns.

Strong experience with Sponsored Products.

Experience with Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display.

Strong understanding of Amazon automatic and manual campaign structures.

Advanced Amazon keyword and search-term research skills.

Strong understanding of negative keywords and negative targeting.

Experience managing bids, placements, budgets, and match types.

Strong understanding of ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates.

Experience optimizing Amazon product listings.

Understanding of Amazon SEO and organic ranking.

Experience analyzing Amazon Business Reports and advertising reports.

Understanding of FBA and FBM.

Ability to analyze large amounts of data and convert findings into actionable strategies.

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly desirable:



Experience managing Amazon PPC for established e-commerce brands.

Experience managing large Amazon product catalogs and multiple SKUs.

Experience with industrial, construction, home improvement, outdoor, trucking, agricultural, or related products.

Experience with Amazon Brand Registry.

Experience with Amazon A+ Content.

Experience with Amazon Brand Store management.

Experience with Amazon FBA.

Experience with Amazon bulk operations and advertising reports.

Experience using Amazon PPC and keyword research tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, Pacvue, Perpetua, Quartile, or similar platforms.

Experience with Amazon Attribution and other advanced measurement tools.

Experience analyzing product-level contribution margins and profitability.

Experience launching new products on Amazon.

What We Are Looking For



We are looking for an individual who is:



Highly analytical

Data-driven

Results-oriented

Detail-oriented

Proactive

Organized

Accountable

Comfortable working independently

Focused on profitability rather than vanity metrics



The successful candidate should naturally ask questions such as:



Which campaigns are actually profitable?

Which keywords generate the most profitable sales?

Which search terms are wasting our advertising budget?

Which products should receive more advertising investment?

Which campaigns have high ACOS, and why?

Is TACOS improving as organic sales increase?

Which competitor ASINs should we target?

Which products have strong traffic but poor conversion rates?

Are our listings preventing our PPC campaigns from converting?

Are we advertising products that are low on inventory?

How can we increase Amazon sales without sacrificing profitability?

How can PPC help improve organic ranking over time?

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated primarily based on measurable business outcomes, including:



Amazon advertising revenue

Total Amazon revenue growth

ACOS

TACOS

ROAS

Conversion rate

Advertising-attributed orders

Organic sales growth

PPC sales growth

Advertising efficiency

Reduction in wasted ad spend

Product-level profitability

Keyword ranking improvements

Listing conversion improvements

Efficient management of advertising budgets



Performance will not be judged primarily by impressions, clicks, or traffic.



Candidate Experience Verification



Candidates selected for an interview should be prepared to discuss 2–3 Amazon Seller Central accounts or brands they have personally managed.



We would like candidates to explain:



Approximate monthly Amazon revenue managed

Approximate monthly Amazon advertising spend managed

Number of ASINs/SKUs managed

FBA and/or FBM experience

Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display experience

Typical ACOS and TACOS performance

Success in This Role



Success means building and managing an Amazon advertising program that produces profitable, sustainable revenue growth.



The goal is not simply to spend more money or generate more clicks. The goal is to use Amazon Seller Central, PPC advertising, listing optimization, keyword strategy, and performance data together to:



Increase profitable sales, improve advertising efficiency, strengthen organic visibility, acquire new customers, and grow Tarp Supply Inc.'s Amazon business over the long term.



If you have strong hands-on Amazon Seller Central and Amazon PPC experience and know how to turn Amazon advertising spend into measurable and profitable sales growth, we would like to hear from you.

title: Web Designer, E-Commerce Developer & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled Web Designer, E-Commerce Developer and Digital Marketing Specialist to build, manage and promote a combination of professional business websites, lead-generation websites, landing pages and advanced e-commerce platforms.



Some assignments will involve straightforward informational websites, while others will require supplier-data integrations, automated inventory updates, custom e-commerce functionality and AI-assisted front-end and backend management.



This is not a position for someone whose experience is limited to installing templates, changing colors, using drag-and-drop builders or creating basic Canva graphics. We need someone who can determine the right solution for each project and produce professional, original, conversion-focused websites.



Types of Websites: Professional Business Websites

Informational and service-based business websites

Lead-generation websites

Landing pages and promotional pages

Appointment and consultation-booking websites

Contact forms and CRM integrations

Mobile-responsive WordPress or comparable CMS websites

Local business and professional-service websites

Basic online stores and payment integrations

Advanced E-Commerce Websites

Full e-commerce stores with large product catalogs

External supplier API and product-feed integrations

Automated product, pricing and inventory synchronization

Dropshipping and supplier-order routing

Fulfillment and shipment-tracking integrations

AI-assisted product and website management

Custom applications, workflows and third-party integrations

Advanced technical SEO and marketing systems



Not every website will require advanced custom development. The candidate must know when to use an efficient, established solution and when a project requires custom development or automation.



Primary Responsibilities

Plan, design, develop and launch professional websites for multiple businesses and industries.

Create original, polished and brand-specific website layouts.

Build websites that are fast, secure, responsive and easy to navigate.

Develop service pages, landing pages, product pages, forms, booking systems and checkout experiences.

Configure domains, hosting, SSL certificates, business
 connections, analytics and tracking.

Integrate websites with CRMs,
 platforms, payment processors, scheduling tools and third-party applications.

Maintain existing websites, correct errors and improve performance.

Document website settings, integrations, automations and operating procedures.

Recommend the most efficient platform and development approach for each project.

Provide realistic project timelines and communicate problems before they delay a launch.

E-Commerce and Supplier Integration



For advanced projects, the candidate should be able to:



Connect supplier systems using APIs, webhooks, XML, CSV, JSON, SFTP or approved data-extraction methods.

Import and organize large supplier product catalogs.

Automatically update SKUs, prices, images, descriptions, variants and inventory levels.

Identify and remove discontinued or unavailable products.

Prevent duplicate products, incorrect prices, stale inventory and overselling.

Create daily or real-time synchronization when supported by the supplier.

Automate order routing, fulfillment updates, shipment tracking, cancellations and returns.

Build alerts for failed feeds, missing data, unusual pricing changes and synchronization errors.

Develop rollback and recovery procedures when an integration fails.

Confirm that supplier data, product descriptions and images may legally be used.

Professional Design and Graphics



We require more than template-style design or basic Canva experience.



The candidate should be capable of:



Creating original website graphics, promotional images, banners and advertisements.

Designing custom page layouts instead of relying entirely on prebuilt templates.

Producing graphics that look professional, credible and specific to the business.

Applying strong typography, spacing, color theory, visual hierarchy and brand consistency.

Using professional tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma or comparable software.

Editing, resizing, compressing and optimizing images without sacrificing quality.

Creating designs that do not resemble generic AI-generated advertisements or commonly reused social-media templates.

Maintaining a consistent visual identity across websites, advertisements, social media and marketing campaigns.



Canva may be used when appropriate, but it should not be the candidate’s primary or only design skill.



Digital Marketing and Website Promotion



Marketing experience is required. The candidate must understand that building the website is only one part of the assignment.



Responsibilities may include:



Creating an appropriate website marketing and launch strategy.

Performing on-page and technical SEO.

Optimizing service pages, product pages, categories, collections and landing pages.

Setting up Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager.

Configuring conversion tracking, advertising pixels and remarketing audiences.

Managing Google Merchant Center and product feeds.

Supporting Google Shopping, Meta/Facebook and Instagram advertising.

Creating landing pages and promotional campaigns.

Setting up
 and SMS marketing automations.

Developing abandoned-cart, customer follow-up and re-engagement campaigns.

Implementing upsells, cross-sells, related products and promotional offers.

Conducting A/B tests and conversion-rate optimization.

Reviewing traffic, conversions, sales and customer behavior.

Recommending improvements based on measurable results—not assumptions.

Supporting local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization when applicable.

AI and Automation



The candidate should understand how to use AI responsibly to reduce repetitive work while maintaining appropriate human oversight.



AI and automation may be used to:



Assist with product descriptions, categories, tags and SEO metadata.

Create image-alt text and structured product information.

Support website search, product recommendations and customer assistance.

Monitor supplier feeds, prices and inventory.

Automate customer follow-ups and routine marketing activities.

Detect unusual orders, pricing conflicts and failed integrations.

Flag low-confidence content before it is published.

Escalate important exceptions to management.



The candidate must implement approval rules, alerts, activity logs, spending controls and recovery procedures. We are not seeking someone who will allow AI to publish sensitive information, incorrect prices or inaccurate inventory without safeguards.



Required Technical Skills

Advanced WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify or comparable platforms

HTML, CSS and JavaScript

Experience with PHP, Python, TypeScript or another backend language

REST and GraphQL APIs

Webhooks and third-party integrations

XML, CSV, JSON and structured product feeds

SQL databases and product-data management

n8n, Make, Zapier or custom workflow automation

OpenAI or comparable AI integrations

Payment-gateway and secure-checkout integration

Dropshipping, fulfillment, warehouse or 3PL integrations

Technical SEO and structured data/schema

Website security, backups and access controls

Git, staging environments and controlled deployments

Error logging, system monitoring and troubleshooting

Website speed and Core Web Vitals optimization

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate:



Has a strong portfolio of original website and graphic-design work.

Can build both streamlined business websites and advanced e-commerce systems.

Understands design, development, automation and marketing.

Has completed at least one supplier-feed, API or inventory-synchronization project.

Can explain their personal contribution to each portfolio project.

Understands how websites support lead generation, sales and business growth.

Can work independently without constant instructions.

Communicates clearly and provides regular progress updates.

Tests work carefully before publishing it.

Documents systems so another qualified professional can maintain them.

Is honest about what they know and what they would need to research.

Compensation



Compensation and responsibilities will be reviewed after the first 60–90 days based on actual performance.



Please submit the following with your response:



A short introduction written in your own words.

Links to at least three websites you personally designed or developed.

At least one professional business or lead-generation website.

At least one e-commerce website.

A description of exactly what you personally completed on each project.

Examples of original graphics or promotional assets you created.

An explanation of the professional design programs you use.

Details about any supplier API, product-feed or inventory-synchronization project you completed.

Examples of digital-marketing campaigns you helped implement and their measurable results.

Your experience with SEO, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, paid advertising and
/SMS marketing.

The website platforms, programming languages, AI tools and automation systems you use.

Your availability, preferred working hours and requested hourly rate.

An explanation of how you would prevent incorrect supplier prices or inventory quantities from automatically appearing on a live website.



Your estimated timeline for completing:

A five-page professional business website

A standard e-commerce website

An advanced supplier-integrated e-commerce website



Generic applications, unexplained portfolio links, fully AI-generated responses, Canva-only portfolios and portfolios consisting primarily of modified templates will not be considered.
