title: Business Operations & Marketing Manager — Local Service Company
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based junk removal/local service company looking for a highly capable **Business Operations & Marketing Manager** to become a key part of our company.



This is **NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who can eventually become the owner's **right-hand person** and help keep the business organized, marketed, followed up and moving forward every day.



You will begin with clearly defined systems and responsibilities, but as you learn the company, we want you to become someone who can identify problems and opportunities without waiting for the owner to tell you everything that needs to be done.



## YOUR ROLE



Your responsibilities will cover several parts of the business.



### BUSINESS OPERATIONS



You will help:



* Keep daily business tasks organized

* Monitor open leads and opportunities

* Help manage scheduling and appointments

* Keep customer information organized

* Make sure leads receive proper follow-up

* Monitor jobs moving through our CRM/pipeline

* Identify leads or customers that are being missed

* Maintain business trackers and systems

* Help organize estimates and customer information

* Assist with customer communication

* Monitor important business KPIs

* Prepare weekly performance reports

* Identify problems that need the owner's attention

* Help create and improve business processes

* Make sure assigned work actually gets completed



The goal is for you to eventually understand the business well enough to recognize what needs attention before the owner has to ask.



### MARKETING



You will also help operate our marketing system, including:



* Local SEO

* Website updates

* WordPress / website builder

* Google Search Console

* Google Business Profile

* On-page SEO

* Internal linking

* City and service page optimization

* Keyword/ranking tracking

* Review management

* Competitor research

* Citation and backlink research

* Local partnership outreach

*
 and Instagram

* YouTube / short-form content

* Canva and/or CapCut

* Repurposing raw job photos and videos

*
/Meta advertising support

* Marketing performance tracking



We already have a detailed SEO and marketing strategy being built.



We are **not hiring someone to throw away the existing strategy and start over.**



Your job will be to learn the system, execute it, help improve it and document results.



### CRM & LEAD MANAGEMENT



We use GoHighLevel as part of our business.



You may help with:



* New lead management

* Pipeline organization

* Lead follow-up

* Picture requests

* Appointment/booking workflows

* Missed lead follow-up

* Customer communication

* Review requests

* Lead source tracking

* Reactivation campaigns

* Basic workflow management



GoHighLevel experience is a major advantage, but we can train the right person.



## AI WILL BE PART OF YOUR JOB



We use ChatGPT heavily throughout the business.



You will have access to documented company information, operating procedures and marketing strategy.



ChatGPT will help walk you through unfamiliar tasks, research, marketing work and processes.



However, you are responsible for checking your work.



We do NOT want someone who blindly copies AI-generated answers.



We want someone who knows how to use AI to become **faster and more capable.**



## ACCOUNTABILITY



We care about results, not vague activity reports.



For example, we do NOT want:



> "Worked on SEO today."



We want:



> "Updated the Ringgold service page, added 4 internal links, researched 8 local backlink prospects, contacted 5 businesses and recorded everything in the tracker."



Completed work should include evidence whenever possible.



This may include:



* URLs

* Screenshots

* Tracker updates

* Published content

* Outreach records

* Lead results

* Advertising results

* Ranking changes



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should be:



* Highly organized

* Dependable

* Comfortable taking responsibility

* A strong problem solver

* Detail-oriented

* Able to follow systems

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable communicating with customers

* Comfortable learning new software

* Comfortable using ChatGPT

* Comfortable with Google Sheets

* Good at online research

* Strong in written English

* Able to recognize when something needs attention

* Interested in a long-term position



Previous experience managing operations for a U.S. local service business is a **major advantage**.



Experience with any of the following is also valuable:



* GoHighLevel

* Local SEO

* WordPress

* Google Business Profile

* Google Search Console

*
/Instagram marketing

* Meta Ads Manager

* Canva

* CapCut

* CRM management

* Customer service

* Appointment scheduling



You do NOT need to be an expert in every one of these.



We care more about finding someone intelligent, dependable and capable of learning quickly.



## WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



Please do not apply if you:



* Need constant supervision

* Frequently disappear during working hours

* Apply to jobs without reading the instructions

* Cannot follow documented processes

* Are uncomfortable being accountable for results

* Make major business or marketing changes without approval

* Submit work without checking it

* Cannot communicate when there is a problem

* Want only simple repetitive VA tasks



This position will have real responsibility.



## HOURS



**Full-Time — approximately 40 hours per week**



Our company operates in the United States on **Eastern Time**.



You do not necessarily need to work the entire U.S. daytime schedule, but regular overlap with our operating hours will be required.



## COMPENSATION



**$800–$1,100 USD per month depending on experience and demonstrated ability.**



There will be an initial evaluation period.



Someone who proves they can take significant responsibility off the owner's plate will have opportunities for increased compensation, responsibility and long-term growth.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



**RED TRUCK**



Applications that do not begin with RED TRUCK will not be considered.



Then answer ALL of the following:



**1.** Tell me about a business you previously helped operate or manage. What were you personally responsible for?



**2.** Have you worked for a U.S. local service business before? If yes, explain the business and your responsibilities.



**3.** What experience do you have managing leads, customers, appointments or a CRM?



**4.** Have you used GoHighLevel? If yes, explain what you have personally done inside it.



**5.** Tell me about your SEO experience. What SEO work have you personally performed?



**6.** Have you used Google Search Console or Google Business Profile? Explain how.



**7.** What experience do you have with
, Instagram, YouTube or content creation?



**8.** Have you used Meta Ads Manager? If yes, what were you responsible for?



**9.** How do you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your work? Give a real example.



**10.** Give an example of a problem you noticed at a previous job BEFORE your manager asked you to fix it. What did you do?



**11.** Provide links, screenshots or examples of previous work when possible.



**12.** What hours can you work and how much overlap can you provide with U.S. Eastern Time?



**13.** What monthly salary are you requesting?



## FINAL SCENARIO



Imagine you begin work Monday morning and notice:



* 7 new leads came in over the weekend

* 3 leads have not received a response

* Tomorrow's schedule has an open time slot

* A customer completed a job but was never asked for a Google review

* A
 ad has spent significantly more than normal without generating a lead

* Two marketing tasks from last week were never completed



**Explain what you would do and in what order.**



There isn't one perfect answer.



We want to see how you **think, prioritize and take responsibility.**



## HIRING PROCESS



We are hiring quickly.



Strong applicants will receive a short practical test based on real tasks you would perform in this position.



Top candidates will have a brief interview.



The right candidate can **start immediately.**



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into an important long-term position within the company.

title: Video Editor for 5 Minute VSLs (Direct Response)

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator
description:
Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Social Media Content Creator



ROLE SUMMARY



This is a highly focused, part-time content creation and social media management role supporting two distinct brands:



1. A travel-focused YouTube channel

2. The Instagram account for a new podcast brand



The primary skill needed for this role is strong video editing and content creation, particularly for YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube content.



The ideal candidate should also have strong visual judgment, understand social media content strategy, and be able to adapt their creative approach to two very different brands.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. Administrative work,
 management, unrelated social media accounts, and other business tasks are outside the scope of this position.



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Starting rate: $5 USD per hour



Maximum: 8 hours per week



There is a hard weekly cap of 8 hours unless additional hours are approved in advance.



There is potential to increase the rate to $6-$7 per hour for a candidate who demonstrates exceptional editing, content judgment, and brand execution through the paid test and actual work.



This is a part-time, ongoing opportunity based on performance.



The candidate must accurately track their working time and work efficiently within the allotted weekly hours.



TOOLS AND ACCESS



The business will provide:



* SocialPilot access

* Canva access, if needed

* Approved brand materials and brand guidelines

* Access to source content and footage

* YouTube Studio access at the appropriate manager permission level



The contractor must provide their own video editing tools and software, such as CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing platform.



The contractor is responsible for maintaining their own computer, reliable internet connection, editing software, and any other equipment necessary to perform the role.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 1: TRAVEL YOUTUBE CHANNEL



CONTENT STRATEGY



Before beginning regular content production, develop a proposed YouTube content strategy based on:



* Existing travel footage

* Available long-form videos

* Previous trips and destinations

* Target audience

* Channel positioning

* Opportunities for Shorts

* Opportunities for long-form content

* YouTube Community content

* Relevant content themes and recurring series

* Recommended posting cadence

* Opportunities to repurpose existing content



The strategy should identify what content should be created first and explain why.



Regular content production should not begin until the initial strategy has been reviewed and approved.



YOUTUBE SHORTS



Review existing travel footage and identify moments with strong potential for short-form content.



Responsibilities include:



* Selecting strong clips or stories

* Developing hooks

* Editing high-retention YouTube Shorts

* Adding appropriate text, captions, transitions, music, graphics, and visual elements

* Maintaining good pacing

* Writing titles and descriptions

* Recommending appropriate calls to action

* Scheduling approved content through SocialPilot



Content should feel intentional and platform-native rather than overly templated.



LONG-FORM YOUTUBE CONTENT



Create or repurpose long-form YouTube content from available source material, including:



* Travel footage

* Existing YouTube videos

* Recorded meetings

* Webinars

* Presentations

* Educational content

* Other approved recordings



Responsibilities may include:



* Identifying the strongest content

* Structuring the story or educational narrative

* Removing unnecessary portions

* Improving pacing

* Adding B-roll where appropriate

* Adding text or graphics

* Creating clean transitions

* Adding intros and outros when appropriate

* Creating or recommending thumbnails

* Writing titles and descriptions



YOUTUBE COMMUNITY



Create and publish YouTube Community content such as:



* Questions

* Polls

* Travel photos

* Conversation starters

* Travel recommendations

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Promotional posts tied to new videos



YOUTUBE ENGAGEMENT



Monitor routine audience engagement and:



* Respond to appropriate comments in the established brand voice

* Like or acknowledge relevant comments

* Identify useful audience questions

* Flag sensitive, unusual, negative, partnership, sales, or business-related inquiries for review



The contractor should not make commitments on behalf of the business without approval.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY 2: PODCAST INSTAGRAM



The podcast has a separate editor who will edit full podcast episodes and produce video clips.



This role is not responsible for editing full podcast episodes from raw footage.



Instead, this person will take approved podcast clips and package them appropriately for Instagram.



PODCAST REELS



For finished clips provided by the podcast editor:



* Create branded Reel covers

* Ensure the visual presentation follows the podcast brand guidelines

* Write compelling captions

* Add appropriate calls to action

* Schedule content through SocialPilot

* Maintain consistency across the Instagram feed



PODCAST CAROUSELS



Identify ideas from podcast clips or related episode material that can be turned into standalone educational or thought-provoking carousel posts.



Examples may include:



* Key lessons

* Quotes

* Frameworks

* Questions

* Mindset shifts

* Lists

* Episode takeaways

* Discussion-provoking ideas



Create the carousel in Canva using the approved podcast visual identity.



The candidate must be able to distinguish between the travel brand and podcast brand.



The same templates, visual style, editing approach, and tone should not simply be reused across both brands.



FIRST 30-DAY DELIVERABLES



The first month will function as both an onboarding period and a working trial.



WEEK 1: STRATEGY AND BRAND FAMILIARIZATION



Complete the following:



* Review the existing travel content library

* Review the travel YouTube channel

* Review the podcast brand guidelines

* Review the existing podcast Instagram presence, if applicable

* Become familiar with SocialPilot

* Become familiar with Canva templates and brand assets



Deliver a concise 30-60 day content strategy.



The Travel YouTube strategy should include:



* Recommended target audience

* 3-5 primary content pillars

* Recommended Shorts strategy

* Recommended long-form strategy

* Community post strategy

* Proposed recurring content series

* Suggested posting cadence

* At least 10 initial content ideas

title: Staff Accountant
description:
WHAT TO EXPECT



Wonderist Agency is a full-service marketing agency that supports 1,200+ dentists around the country. We pride ourselves on ditching the old fashioned marketing model of stock photos and templated sites. We strive to tell our clients’ stories with bespoke brands, impactful photo and video shoots, and stunning website design (Here is a great example of our work: 
)



We’re a team of over 90+ passionate marketers with our headquarters nestled in sunny San Diego. We are walking distance from local hangouts, bars, and the famed Liberty Station. While many companies simply check the required boxes when it comes to culture, a well-balanced team and positive office culture has been the core of our success from the start. We are a social team at heart, and that is one constant that hasn’t changed with all the movement this economy and industry has seen. We have embraced a hybrid work model where local team members come in at least two days a week. This allows us to work from home and have flexibility, without altogether forgoing the excitement and moments of collaboration and inspiration you can only get from in-person time. Not to mention, we also genuinely enjoy spending time together and socializing.



We celebrate new ideas and prioritize a culture of trust and respect where team members can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named: San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in: 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies in: 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and 2026, San Diego Business Journal’s Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024. Inc Best Workplaces list in: 2024, 2025, and 2026, and Inc. 5000 for the last 7 years (
)!

If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



JOB DESCRIPTION



The Staff Accountant keeps Wonderist’s day-to-day accounting operations accurate, current, and organized. This role owns the core transactional accounting work that keeps the books clean and month-end close on track, including accounts payable, employee reimbursements, bank feed management, AR support, recording payroll in QuickBooks Online, and the recurring close-related entries like deferred revenue and prepaid expenses.

This is a hands-on accounting seat, not a systems or management role, but it is not a purely manual one either. The right person is detail-oriented, comfortable with a recurring rhythm of daily and monthly tasks, and takes pride in accurate, well-documented books. You’ll work closely with the Controller and finance team, use AI tools to build and sharpen the processes behind your own work, and pitch in on special projects as the agency’s needs evolve.

The right candidate is organized, dependable, and genuinely enjoys the mechanics of accounting: coding transactions correctly, keeping accounts reconciled, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. Just as important, this person must be able to innovate and do. They should be comfortable identifying where AI and automation can remove manual busywork, and just as comfortable rolling up their sleeves to execute the accounting work itself.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily / Ongoing



●    Process accounts payable, including entering and coding vendor bills, obtaining approvals, and preparing payments on schedule.

●    Review and process employee reimbursement requests, confirming proper documentation, coding, and policy compliance before payment.

●    Manage bank feeds in QuickBooks Online, categorizing transactions, clearing exceptions, and keeping feeds current so reconciliations stay accurate.

●    Support accounts receivable, including applying payments, assisting with invoicing questions, and helping resolve unapplied payments or discrepancies.

●    Respond to internal questions about bills, reimbursements, coding, or payment status.

●    Flag unusual transactions, missing documentation, or coding issues to the Controller before they become bigger problems.



Monthly



●    Record payroll entries in QuickBooks Online, ensuring wages, taxes, benefits, and deductions are coded accurately and tie out to payroll provider reports.

●    Prepare and post deferred revenue entries, ensuring revenue is recognized in the correct period as services are delivered.

●    Prepare and post prepaid expense entries, amortizing prepaid balances on schedule and maintaining supporting schedules.

●    Reconcile assigned bank, credit card, and balance sheet accounts, researching and resolving open items promptly.

●    Support month-end close by preparing assigned journal entries and ensuring AP, AR, and payroll activity is fully recorded before close.

●    Maintain clean, organized supporting documentation for all recurring entries and reconciliations.

As Needed

●    Support special projects as assigned, which may include process cleanup, audit support, system testing, or ad hoc analysis.

●    Assist the Controller with other accounting tasks during busy periods, transitions, or process improvements.

●    Use AI tools to create, test, and improve accounting processes, templates, and checklists, reducing manual work without sacrificing accuracy.

●    Identify repetitive or error-prone tasks in AP, AR, reconciliations, or close, and propose or build a better way to do them.

Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Accounting Fundamentals

●    Solid understanding of debits, credits, and basic GAAP concepts.

●    Comfortable with accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.

●    Understands the mechanics of accruals, prepaids, and deferred revenue.

●    Experience recording or supporting payroll journal entries.



Accuracy & Organization



●    Detail-oriented with a strong eye for catching errors before they compound.

●    Able to manage recurring monthly deadlines without missing steps.

●    Keeps clean, well-labeled supporting documentation.

●    Comfortable following (and improving) checklists and procedures.



Communication & Collaboration



●    Clear, proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than letting them sit.

●    Comfortable asking clarifying questions when something looks off.

●    Works well with the Controller and broader team, and welcomes feedback.



Innovation & Execution



●    Comfortable using AI tools to build, test, and refine accounting processes, not just to answer questions.

●    Able to spot a manual, repetitive, or error-prone task and take initiative to improve it.

●    Balances innovation with follow-through: proposes a better process, then actually builds and runs it.

●    Open to process changes as the finance function grows and improves.



Adaptability



●    Comfortable in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

●    Willing to pitch in on special projects outside the core role.



PERSONALITY MUSTS



Our perfect fit is someone who is a problem solver who understands the difference between “yes, and…” and “yes, but…”. You should be a hungry, scrappy personality with a positive attitude and aims to deliver. Working in the client service industry can mean going the extra mile, and we need someone who is always willing to rise to the occasion and strives to put forward accurate, dependable work. Someone who is detailed and organized, driven, and comes ready to play every day. Confidence, self-discipline, and a congenial, curious mind are things we love and admire.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS



●    5+ years of accounting experience, including AP, AR, or bank reconciliation responsibilities. Candidates with less than 5 years of experience need not apply.

●    Solid understanding of basic accounting principles and debit/credit fundamentals.

●    Experience with QuickBooks Online is required.

●    Experience recording or supporting payroll entries.

●    Comfort with recurring monthly close tasks such as prepaids, accruals, or deferred revenue.

●    Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

●    Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

●    Ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines and maintain accuracy under time pressure.

●    Comfort working in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

●    Experience in using AI or automation tools to improve accounting processes.



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)



●    Experience in a marketing agency, professional services business, or other recurring revenue environment.

●    Experience with 
, PandaDoc, Rippling, or similar platforms.

●    Experience supporting month-end close for a growing company.

●    Coursework or a degree in accounting or finance.

●    Interest in growing into a more senior accounting or Junior Controller-track role over time.



This is a Full-Time Salaried position. This role is structured as an EOR agreement with Rippling EOR and Wonderist Agency.

Working hours are expected to overlap with US pacific time and that is factored into the compensation range.

title: Graphic Designer for Personalized Products (Canva) - Long Term, Part Time to Full Time
description:
Hi! I run a online shop selling personalized physical party products. Printed paper goods and drinkware that customers personalize with their own names, dates and text.

I am looking for one person to help me with two things:



1. Order processing (the daily work)



When an order comes in, you open the design template and personalize it. Names, dates, text, colors, font choices, exactly as the customer ordered. Most orders are simple edits, nothing complicated. What matters most is accuracy: correct spelling, correct colors, correct placement, correct file setup. A typo on a printed order costs me money and a bad review.



2. Design support



This is a mix of creative and practical work:



• Adjusting and adapting existing designs into new versions 

• Placing designs into mockup templates I have already made 

• Preparing listing photos for my shop 

• Creating new designs and design variations when we launch new products



So it is not all big creative work. A good part of it is careful, consistent production work. I need someone who is happy doing both.



What I am looking for:



• Strong Canva skills (this is my main tool, please tell me your level honestly) 

• Good eye for typography, spacing and layout. Clean, modern, elegant celebration style 

• Excellent attention to detail and correct English spelling 

• Understands print files: correct sizes, 300 DPI, bleed, PNG and PDF export 

• Reliable, and communicates clearly. If something in an order is unclear, you ask me instead of guessing

Start your message with the word CONFETTI so I know you read this fully.

Which design tools you use, and how many years with each.

title: ROCKSTAR Cold Caller Wanted — Earn Up To ₱45,000/month — US Company — Night Shift
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR A ROCKSTAR ON THE PHONE.



Not someone who reads a script. Someone who can pick up the phone, get past a

receptionist, and have a real conversation with a busy American builder.



If that is you, keep reading. If it is not, this will waste your time.



WHO WE ARE



We are a licensed insulation contractor in Los Angeles, California. We install

insulation in new homes. Business is growing and we need people to open doors

for us.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Call construction companies from a list we hand you. No hunting for leads.

- Get to the person who d
 on subcontractors

- Book a 15 minute call for our estimator

- Log what happened



You are not selling insulation. You are booking the meeting. That is it.



THE MONEY



- ₱7,000 per week base, for 40 hours

- ₱850 for EVERY appointment that actually happens

- NO CAP. We do not limit what you can earn.



Book 4 in a week, you earn ₱10,400.

Book 8 in a week, you earn ₱13,800.

Our best callers should be clearing ₱45,000 a month.



We pay every Friday. On time. No excuses, no delays.



THE PART MOST PEOPLE CANNOT HANDLE



This is a night shift. 10pm to 6am Philippine time, Monday to Friday.



We cannot change it. American builders are only at their desks during their

working day, and that is the middle of your night. If you cannot commit to

those hours every week, please do not apply. You will burn out and we will

both have wasted our time.



But if you can handle it, most people cannot, and that is exactly why this

pays what it pays.



WHAT YOU NEED



- English clear enough that a busy American builder understands you instantly

- Real outbound calling experience. This is not an entry level role.

- Thick skin. You will hear no far more often than yes.

- A headset with a microphone. Not a phone speaker.

- Reliable internet, a quiet room, and a backup plan when the power cuts.



HOW THE HIRING WORKS, AND WHY IT IS FAIR



We are taking SIX people onto a two week PAID trial.



Everyone gets the same script, the same hours, and the same quality of leads.

Nobody gets an easier list. At the end we keep the people booking the most

appointments and they stay with us long term.



Everyone gets paid for the trial. Nobody works for free here.



If you are genuinely good on the phone, this is the best kind of process,

because you are judged on what you do, not on how nice your CV looks.



HOW TO APPLY



 me directly: 



Subject line: COZY2026 Night Caller



Answer these in order, numbered. Keep it short.



1. Your name and WhatsApp number

2. How many years have you done outbound calling?

3. Have you called businesses in the United States before? Yes or no

4. Have you worked a night shift for more than three months? Yes or no

5. Can you commit to 10pm to 6am, Monday to Friday, for at least six months?

   Yes or no

6. Your internet speed from speedtest.net

7. Do you have backup internet or power? Yes or no

8. A builder says "I already have an insulation guy." What do you say next?

   Give me your exact words.

9. What weekly pay are you looking for in pesos?



ATTACH A 60 SECOND VOICE RECORDING



Say your name, then read this out loud:



"Hi, my name is NAME calling from Cozy Comfort Insulation in Los Angeles.

Could I speak with whoever handles your insulation subcontractors?"



Then tell me in your own words why you would be good at this job.



No recording, no reply. We are hiring a voice. We have to hear it.



READY TO TALK? BOOK YOUR INTERVIEW NOW



If you are confident you are the right person, do not wait for us to get back

to you. Book your interview slot directly here:







Pick a time that works for you. Still send your answers and your recording

title: Financial Advisor / FP&A Analyst – Construction (Reporting to the CFO)
description:
Fractional CFO (Remote)

Mazzamuto Construction / Bella Casa Cabinets



About Us

Mazzamuto Construction is a U.S.-based general contractor focused on residential remodeling and light commercial work. We also operate Bella Casa Cabinets, which designs, sells, and installs custom and semi-custom cabinetry. Combined revenue is approximately $3–4 million. We are looking for strong financial leadership to improve reporting, control spending, and support better decision-making. a plus would someone who has worked with Buildertrend construction software, Gusto Payroll, and Quickbooks software.



The Role

We are hiring a Fractional CFO to work alongside our CFO. This is a hands-on role focused on building reliable financial reports, improving visibility into the numbers, and helping the company make smarter spending and growth decisions. The right person will bring a strong, objective voice on where we should spend, where we should cut back, and how we stay on track with our financial goals.     Build clear, useful financial reports and dashboards the leadership team can actually use

    Create and maintain rolling cash flow forecasts

    Improve job costing and WIP (Work in Progress) reporting

    Analyze profitability by job and by segment (Construction vs. Cabinets)

    Identify overspending and recommend specific cuts or reallocation of resources

    Help set and track financial goals

    Strengthen budgeting, forecasting, and month-end processes

    Support better day-to-day financial decision-making



What We’re Looking For



    Strong background as a CFO, Controller, or senior finance leader

    Experience with construction, remodeling, or project-based businesses is a plus

    Ability to build practical reports and explain the numbers clearly

    Willingness to give direct, honest recommendations on spending (what to stop, what to cut, and what to fund)

    Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with the existing team

Engagement Details



    Fractional / part-time to start (typically 10–40 hours per week)

    Opportunity to grow into a larger role based on results

    Fully remote

    Competitive compensation based on experience

Basic computer and scheduling software proficiency

Successful candidates are:



Dependable

Professional

Compassionate

Organized

Responsive

Coachable

Comfortable working within structured systems and protocols

title: Python + AI Automation Developer - Claude-Assisted Development
description:
Remote | Philippines | Part-Time / Project-Based Initially | Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for a technically strong Python / AI Automation Developer to help us finish and operate an existing conversation-intelligence platform.



This is not a general VA position, and it is not a greenfield software project.



The core Python application and AI evaluation engine are already built and working. We need someone who can step into the existing codebase, understand the architecture, use Claude/Claude Code effectively, complete the remaining integrations and automation, test/debug the system, and help us get it into production.



What We're Building



Callsistance analyzes recorded sales calls and automatically produces coaching intelligence for sales teams.



The completed pipeline will:



**Receive call recording → Transcribe → AI evaluation → Generate PDFs → Create timestamped audio clips → Human QC/approval → Assemble manager/rep digests →
 delivery**



The core transcription and multi-pass AI evaluation system is already functioning.



What You'll Help Us Complete



Remaining work includes:



* Integrating existing AI evaluation JSON with our locked PDF templates

* Automating PDF generation

* Generating timestamped audio clips from call recordings

* Uploading audio/report assets to cloud storage

* Creating clickable audio links inside PDFs

* Client-specific branding and white-label routing

* Building a human report review/approval queue

* Creating manager daily digest
s

* Creating salesperson-specific daily digests

* Generating salesperson-specific coaching PDFs

* Automating intake and processing

* Deploying and monitoring the completed pipeline

* End-to-end testing and debugging

* Connecting VoIP systems through APIs/webhooks after the core pipeline is proven



Current Technology



You do not need prior experience with every service.



Our current stack includes:



* Python

* Anthropic / Claude

* Deepgram

* REST APIs and webhooks

* Git/GitHub

* Railway

* Cloudflare R2

* SendGrid

* Google APIs

* JSON

* HTML/CSS PDF generation

* VoIP APIs



Experience with FastAPI, Docker, cloud deployment, AI/LLM APIs, or automation systems is also valuable.



Claude Is Part of the Development Process



This is important:



We intentionally use Claude heavily to develop the application.



We are not looking for someone who believes every line of code needs to be written manually.



We also are not looking for someone who simply asks AI to write code and assumes the result is correct.



We want someone who can:



* Give Claude strong technical instructions

* Understand the code and architecture well enough to work with it

* Run and test AI-generated code

* Read logs and errors

* Diagnose failures

* Modify code directly when appropriate

* Recognize when Claude's solution is wrong

* Iterate until the required result actually works



If you already use Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools for software development, we want to hear about it.



Who We're Looking For



You should be strong in:



* Python

* API integration

* REST APIs

* Webhooks

* Debugging

* Git/GitHub

* Automation

* Working with an existing codebase

* AI-assisted software development



You should also:



* Communicate clearly in English

* Follow detailed specifications

* Test your own work before submitting it

* Document meaningful changes

* Be comfortable explaining technical problems to non-programmer founders

* Know when to ask a question rather than making an unapproved architecture change



We care more about demonstrated ability than degrees or certifications.



Project Structure & Compensation



We expect the initial build to be structured primarily as fixed-price milestones rather than hourly billing.



Examples include:



1. PDF integration

2. Automated report generation

3. Audio clip generation

4. Client branding/routing

5. Review/approval workflow

6. Salesperson-level reports and digests

7. Automated intake

8. Manager + salesperson digest delivery

9. Full pipeline integration/testing

10. VoIP API integrations



We have a detailed written technical scope and acceptance criteria that will be shared with qualified candidates.



We will agree on milestone pricing before work begins.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are not looking only for someone to finish a project and disappear.



If we work well together, we would like this person to potentially become our ongoing technical operations resource for the company.



Future work could include:



* Pipeline monitoring

* Troubleshooting

* Client onboarding/configuration

* New VoIP integrations

* Blueprint/config updates

* Report QC support

* API maintenance

* Automation improvements

* Continued Claude-assisted development

* New product features



The initial project is a good opportunity for both sides to determine whether there is a long-term fit.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer all 7 questions below.



Generic applications that do not answer the questions will not be considered.



1. Tell us about the most relevant Python application or automation you've built. What did it do?



2. Describe an API/webhook integration you personally built or maintained. Which systems did you connect?



3. Which AI coding tools do you currently use (Claude Code, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) and how do you use them during development?



4. Tell us about a time AI generated code that did not work correctly. How did you determine what was wrong and fix it?



5. What experience do you have deploying or maintaining Python applications in production? Which cloud/deployment platforms have you used?



6. Please provide a GitHub, portfolio, or example of relevant work if available.



7. After reading this listing, what part of this project do you believe would be the most technically challenging, and why?



Finally, please include:



* Your normal availability

* Your preferred working hours in Philippine Time

* Your current hourly rate for reference, even though the initial project will primarily use fixed-price milestones



Important: Start your application with the word **CANDLE** so we know you read the entire listing.

title: PPC / Google Ads Specialist
description:
Job Summary: 



Tarp Supply Inc. is seeking a results-driven PPC / Google Ads Specialist to build, manage, optimize, and scale our paid search and shopping campaigns, with a strong focus on profitable e-commerce revenue, qualified commercial leads, customer acquisition, and advertising ROI/ROAS.



The ideal candidate understands that successful PPC is about much more than generating impressions and clicks. You must be able to identify high-intent buyers, optimize product feeds and Shopping campaigns, control wasted ad spend, accurately track purchases and leads, analyze profitability, and continuously improve campaign performance based on reliable data.

You will work closely with our e-commerce, marketing, sales, and management teams to grow online sales through Google Search, Google Shopping, Performance Max, and other appropriate paid advertising channels.

For commercial, wholesale, bulk-order, and custom-tarp campaigns, you will also be responsible for generating and tracking qualified leads, phone calls, quote requests, and other high-value conversions.

Key Responsibilities



Google Ads Campaign Management

• Create, manage, optimize, and scale Google Ads campaigns.

• Build and manage high-performing Google Search, Google Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns.

• Manage campaigns for both e-commerce purchases and B2B lead generation.

• Conduct extensive keyword, competitor, product, and market research.

• Identify high-intent commercial and transactional keywords that attract qualified buyers.

• Develop campaign structures around product categories, materials, applications, customer intent, margins, and business priorities.

• Regularly review search terms and maintain comprehensive negative-keyword lists.

• Write, test, and optimize compelling ad copy, headlines, descriptions, assets, and extensions.

• Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience signals, geographic targeting, and device performance.

• Identify and eliminate wasted advertising spend.

• Develop strategies to scale successful campaigns while maintaining profitability.

• Monitor competitor advertising strategies, positioning, pricing, and promotional activity.

• Ensure campaigns comply with Google Ads policies and current best practices.



Google Shopping & Merchant Center

• Manage and optimize Google Merchant Center and Google Shopping campaigns.

• Monitor product-feed health, disapprovals, warnings, and policy issues.

• Optimize product titles, descriptions, product types, Google product categories, images, pricing, and other feed attributes.

• Work with Shopify product data and product feeds to improve Shopping visibility and conversion performance.

• Segment products based on category, margin, price, seasonality, performance, and business priorities.

• Identify high-performing and underperforming SKUs.

• Develop strategies to improve Shopping and Performance Max profitability.

• Ensure accurate synchronization between Shopify, Google Merchant Center, and Google Ads.



Conversion Tracking & Attribution

• Set up, maintain, test, and audit accurate conversion tracking.

• Track e-commerce purchases, revenue, phone calls, forms, quote requests, custom-tarp inquiries, wholesale inquiries, and other valuable actions.

• Work with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads, Shopify, and Google Merchant Center.

• Ensure purchase values and transaction data are accurately passed into advertising and analytics platforms.

• Implement and maintain Enhanced Conversions and other appropriate first-party measurement solutions.

• Analyze attribution to determine which campaigns, keywords, search terms, ads, products, and channels generate the most profitable customers.

• Identify tracking discrepancies and ensure campaign data is accurate, reliable, and actionable.

• Understand the customer journey from ad click through website visit, purchase, quote request, or other conversion.



Campaign Optimization & Performance

• Monitor and improve:

o ROAS

o Revenue

o Conversion value

o Cost per acquisition (CPA)

o Cost per qualified lead

o Conversion rate

o Average order value

o Customer acquisition cost

o Shopping and product-level profitability

• Analyze campaign, keyword, search-term, audience, device, geographic, and product performance.

• Evaluate lead quality for custom, wholesale, bulk-order, and commercial campaigns.

• Conduct structured A/B testing across ads, landing pages, offers, keywords, audiences, and campaign strategies.

• Review landing pages and product pages and provide recommendations to improve conversion rates.

• Identify friction points within the e-commerce purchase funnel.

• Analyze where shoppers abandon the customer journey and recommend improvements.

• Coordinate PPC strategies with promotions, seasonal demand, inventory availability, product launches, and business priorities.

• Continuously optimize campaigns based on profitability, conversion quality, customer behavior, and ROI.



Budget Management & Scaling

• Manage daily, weekly, and monthly advertising budgets responsibly.

• Allocate budgets toward the campaigns, products, keywords, and audiences producing the strongest business results.

• Identify opportunities to increase spending profitably.

• Reduce or eliminate spending on campaigns that consistently fail to meet performance objectives.

• Develop scalable PPC strategies without sacrificing profitability or customer quality.

• Provide budget forecasts and recommendations based on historical and current performance.



Reporting & Strategy

• Provide clear weekly and monthly PPC performance reports.

• Report on revenue, ROAS, spend, conversions, CPA, qualified leads, conversion rates, and other key business metrics.

• Clearly communicate campaign results, challenges, opportunities, testing results, and recommended next steps.

• Explain not only what happened, but also why it happened and what should be done next.

• Develop strategies to improve online sales, customer acquisition, lead quality, conversion rates, and advertising profitability.

• Use performance data to make informed decisions about budgets, bidding, targeting, keywords, products, audiences, ad messaging, and campaign structure.

• Maintain organized records of campaign changes, experiments, results, and learnings.



Required Skills & Qualifications

• Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

• Demonstrated experience managing e-commerce PPC campaigns.

• Strong experience with Google Search campaigns.

• Experience with Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns.

• Hands-on experience with Google Merchant Center.

• Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

• Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM).

• Strong understanding of e-commerce conversion tracking and attribution.

• Experience with Shopify or comparable e-commerce platforms.

• Advanced keyword, search-term, and negative-keyword research skills.

• Understanding of product-feed optimization and Shopping campaign structure.

• Experience with landing-page and product-page conversion optimization.

• Experience conducting A/B tests and analyzing results.

• Strong campaign analytics and reporting skills.

• Understanding of customer journeys, sales funnels, conversion rates, and lead qualification.

• Ability to analyze large amounts of performance data and turn insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns, products, and budgets simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but not required:

• Google Ads certifications.

• Google Analytics certification.

• Experience managing PPC for companies with large product catalogs.

• Experience managing thousands of SKUs.

• Experience with B2B and B2C e-commerce.

• Experience with industrial, construction, trucking, agriculture, home improvement, outdoor, or related product categories.

• Experience with feed-management or feed-optimization platforms.

• Experience with Microsoft Advertising/Bing Ads.

• Experience with remarketing and customer-match strategies.

• Familiarity with SEO, CRO, and e-commerce merchandising.

• Experience working with call tracking and offline conversion imports.

• Understanding of customer lifetime value (LTV), new-customer acquisition, and profitability-based bidding.



The right candidate will take ownership of PPC performance and continuously identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and advertising efficiency.



Key Performance Metrics

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable business outcomes, including:

• Google Ads revenue

• ROAS

• Conversion value

• Online purchases

• Cost per acquisition (CPA)

• Customer acquisition cost (CAC)

• Conversion rate

• Average order value (AOV)

• New customers acquired

• Qualified commercial and wholesale leads

• Cost per qualified lead

• Custom-tarp and quote requests

• Product and Shopping campaign performance

• Advertising profitability

• Efficient use of advertising budget

• Accuracy of conversion tracking and reporting



Performance will not be judged primarily by impressions, clicks, traffic, or other vanity metrics.



Success in This Role



Success means building and continuously improving a paid advertising program that produces measurable, profitable business growth.



The goal is not simply to increase impressions, clicks, or website traffic. The goal is to:



Turn high-intent Google searches into customers, revenue, qualified commercial opportunities, and long-term profitable growth.



The successful PPC Specialist will understand the relationship between advertising spend, product selection, customer intent, website conversion rates, average order value, customer acquisition cost, and profitability.

If you are passionate about PPC, enjoy working with data, understand e-commerce, and know how to turn paid search and Shopping traffic into measurable revenue, we would like to hear from you.

 if a campaign is actually working?

title: Maintenance / Guest Issue Resolution Representative
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are looking for an extremely hardworking, persistent, and resourceful Issue Resolution Representative who takes ownership of difficult property problems and drives them all the way to resolution.



This is not a position where success means sending a message to a contractor and waiting for a response. Success means the problem actually gets fixed.



A major part of this role is taking on long-term and recurring issues that may have already been open for weeks or months. We expect significantly more effort to go into these difficult issues—researching the history, contacting multiple contractors, negotiating costs, finding alternative solutions, following up relentlessly, and determining the root cause so the same problem doesn’t continue happening.



About the Company

Luxury Lodging is a fast-growing short-term rental property management company overseeing 300+ homes across the United States. Our team is performance-driven. We manage day-to-day operations, including pricing, guest support, maintenance, onboarding, and owner success. We’re hiring someone sharp and reliable to help with essential operational tasks.



This is NOT a short-term or temporary role! We are looking for someone who wants to commit long-term and grow with the company. This position requires consistency, accountability, and the ability to handle challenges calmly and professionally. If you are actively job hunting, frequently changing roles, or looking for a stepping-stone position, this role will not be the right fit. Please apply ONLY if you are seeking a stable, long-term opportunity and are prepared to take ownership of the role through both smooth and challenging situations!



⸻



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Own Issues Until They Are Solved

- Take complete ownership of maintenance and operational issues from beginning to end.

- Give extra attention and effort to long-standing and recurring problems.

- Investigate why previous attempts failed instead of simply repeating the same solution.

- Identify and address the root cause, not just the immediate symptom.

- Follow up persistently without needing reminders from management.

- Find another path forward when a contractor, owner, or vendor is delaying resolution.

- Verify that repairs were completed properly before closing an issue.

- Reopen and escalate issues immediately when a supposed solution does not work.



2. Contractor Management & Negotiation

- Find and communicate with contractors, handymen, plumbers, electricians, HVAC technicians, cleaners, and other vendors.

- Obtain competing quotes when appropriate.

- Negotiate contractor pricing instead of automatically accepting the first quote.

- Ask contractors to explain expensive repairs and provide pricing breakdowns.

- Negotiate discounts, warranties, free callbacks, and corrections for incomplete or unsuccessful work.

- Find alternative contractors when pricing, availability, or quality is unacceptable.

- Balance cost, quality, and speed when d
 how to resolve an issue.



⸻



WORK ETHIC & PERSISTENCE

We want someone who naturally thinks: “What else can I do to get this solved?”

not: “I sent the message, so I’ve done my part.”



The ideal candidate:

- Has an exceptional work ethic.

- Is persistent and difficult to discourage.

- Takes personal responsibility for results.

- Makes repeated calls and follow-ups when necessary.

- Searches for alternatives instead of waiting.

- Is comfortable pushing contractors professionally.

- Can manage many open issues without losing track of them.

- Is willing to spend considerably more effort on complicated long-term problems.

- Thinks creatively when the obvious solution isn’t working.

- Works independently without needing constant supervision.



⸻



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



Instead of: “I contacted the contractor yesterday. I’m waiting for them to respond.”

We want:

“The original contractor didn’t respond, so I called again, texted them, contacted three alternatives, received two quotes, negotiated the best option down, scheduled the repair, followed up after completion, and verified that the underlying problem was actually fixed.”



-----



CORE PRINCIPLE

Own the problem until it is solved.

- If the contractor doesn’t answer, find another contractor.

- If the quote is too expensive, negotiate or find alternatives.

- If a repair fails, determine why.

- If an issue keeps returning, investigate the root cause.

- If something has been unresolved for months, increase the effort rather than accepting that it is difficult to solve.



⸻



TO APPLY, 

1. PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING QUESTIONS IN VOCAROO/GOOGLE DRIVE FILE: 

- You inherit a property issue that has been happening repeatedly for three months. Multiple contractors have already attempted repairs, we’ve spent significant money, and the problem keeps returning. The owner is frustrated. You now completely own this issue. Walk me through exactly what you would do until you’re confident the problem is permanently resolved.

- A contractor tells you a repair will cost $1,200, but based on your research you believe a reasonable price is around $700. We need the repair completed quickly. Walk me through exactly how you would handle the contractor and negotiate this.”

2. Submit your answer to this question below in your cover letter/application and the title should contain the word short term rental:

- A guest checks in at 5 PM and an important repair needs to happen beforehand. Your contractor promised to arrive at noon. It’s now 2 PM, they haven’t arrived, and they’re not answering. What exactly do you do?”

3. Attach your resume

• Via a Google Drive link or similar (make sure it's set to public)



⸻



THE STANDARD:

We’re looking for someone who believes: “If it’s my issue, I’m responsible for finding a way to solve it.”



Effort, persistence, negotiation, resourcefulness, and actual resolution matter significantly more than simply completing tasks.

title: Business Growth & Operations VA
description:
Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the manufacturer of My Moss, our line of sea moss gel products sold online and through retail stores across the United States.

We are hiring a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Wholesale Account Growth & Sales Operations VA to help us manage wholesale accounts, reactivate dormant retailers, research new retail opportunities, maintain clean CRM data, track follow-ups, support basic invoice/payment tracking, and make sure important opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

This is not a commission sales role.

This is not a basic data-entry VA role.

This is not a bookkeeping or accounting role.

The core of this role is follow-up, research, organization, communication, accurate tracking, and proactive problem-solving.

Success means fewer lost accounts, better follow-up, cleaner data, stronger wholesale prospecting, and better execution across our growth team.

Main Responsibilities

1. Wholesale Account Retention & Reactivation

A major focus will be helping us understand why some retail accounts stopped ordering and helping us reconnect with them.

You may:

* Identify inactive or dormant retail accounts

* Review order history and account notes

* Research updated buyers or purchasing contacts

* Contact former retailers by
 and occasional phone follow-up

* Determine why ordering stopped

* Track follow-ups, account status, and next actions

* Identify accounts that may be recoverable

* Escalate important issues or opportunities

* Track reorders from reactivation efforts

The goal is simple: retailers should not disappear without us understanding why.

2. Retail Account Health & CRM Management

You will help keep account information clean and make sure follow-ups happen.

You may:

* Monitor last-order dates and reorder patterns

* Flag overdue or at-risk accounts

* Update account statuses and notes

* Maintain CRM or spreadsheet records

* Track next actions and follow-up dates

* Create simple account status reports

We believe every active opportunity should have a clear next action.

3. Wholesale Prospecting & Buyer Research

You will research qualified new retailers that may be a good fit for My Moss.

Examples include health food stores, natural grocers, supplement stores, wellness stores, juice bars, co-ops, specialty markets, and regional chains.

You may research:

* Company website and location

* Number of stores

* Buyer or purchasing contact

*
, phone, and LinkedIn

* Products currently carried

* Competing brands

* Why the retailer may be a good fit

* Priority level and recommended next action

We value quality, verified prospects over large scraped lists.

4. Sales Operations, Invoices & Reporting

You may assist with basic sales operations and financial tracking.

This may include:

* Tracking unpaid wholesale invoices

* Following up on past-due invoices using approved communication

* Maintaining accounts receivable trackers

* Organizing payment status information

* Tracking refunds, credits, and account adjustments

* Preparing simple wholesale sales summaries

* Flagging unusual discrepancies or missing payments

This is not an accounting role. You will not make tax decisions, perform advanced bookkeeping, move company funds, or make financial decisions without approval.

5. Growth Support & Research

You may also support our SEO/GEO and Creator Acquisition specialists with execution, research, tracking, and organization.

This may include:

* Competitive research

* Customer review analysis

* Online sales support

* SEO research support

* Creator acquisition tracking

* Outreach list building

* Market research

* Organizing customer questions, complaints, objections, and product requests

* Maintaining creator, prospect, or outreach trackers

* Collecting and organizing useful market or customer intelligence

You will support these specialists, not replace their strategy or ownership.

We do not just want links and screenshots. You should be able to explain:

* What changed?

* Why does it matter?

* Is there anything we should act on?

AI Is an Important Part of This Role

We expect you to use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar platforms to work faster and more effectively.

You may use AI for:

* Research

* Prospect qualification

* Summarizing information

* Drafting follow-ups

* Competitive analysis

* Categorizing feedback

* Spreadsheet analysis

* Preparing reports

* Organizing data

* Identifying patterns and opportunities

However, you must verify AI-generated information.

We do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes AI output.

Strong candidates should know when AI may be wrong, incomplete, outdated, or hallucinating information and should know how to verify important facts.

Communication Requirements

Strong written English is required.

This role may also involve occasional calls to U.S.-based retailers to:

* Confirm buyer information

* Follow up on existing accounts

* Ask basic account questions

* Gather information

* Follow up on overdue invoices when appropriate

This is not a cold-calling sales position.

You do not need an American accent, but you must speak clearly, confidently, and professionally.

You May Be a Strong Fit If You Are:

* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Resourceful

* Persistent with follow-up

* Strong at online research

* Comfortable with spreadsheets and CRMs

* Strong in written English

* Comfortable speaking English professionally

* Comfortable using AI tools

* Able to verify information instead of guessing

* Proactive instead of waiting for every instruction

* Comfortable working with basic financial data

* Able to spot patterns, problems, and missed opportunities

Experience with B2B outreach, account management, lead generation, sales support, CRM systems, accounts receivable, e-commerce, U.S. retail, health/wellness, food/beverage brands, or wholesale operations is a plus.

This Role Is Not a Fit If You:

* Only want simple assigned tasks

* Do not like follow-up

* Are uncomfortable contacting businesses

* Are uncomfortable with spreadsheets or CRM work

* Rely on AI without checking facts

* Are disorganized with details

* Need constant reminders to follow up

* Prefer to wait for instructions instead of identifying what needs attention

Schedule

This is a remote position.

Because you may communicate with businesses in the United States, you should be available for some working hours that overlap with U.S. Central Time.

Exact schedule will be discussed with selected candidates.

Compensation

Compensation depends on experience, communication ability, research skills, AI proficiency, and availability.

There is opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation for someone who performs well.

How to Apply

Start your application with:

NR GROWTH

Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be reviewed.

Please answer:

1. Describe your experience with virtual assistance, B2B outreach, account management, lead generation, CRM systems, e-commerce, wholesale, or financial operations support.

2. What AI tools do you use, and how do you use them in your work? Give specific examples.

3. How would you research the correct buyer or purchasing contact for a U.S. retail company?

4. If a retailer previously ordered from us but has not ordered in six months, what steps would you take?

5. If you
ed a buyer twice and received no response, what would you do next?

6. Describe any experience tracking invoices, payments, accounts receivable, sales reports, or basic financial data.

7. Which CRM, spreadsheet, lead-generation, financial, or research tools have you used?

8. Are you comfortable making occasional calls to U.S.-based businesses?

9. Provide your current availability, preferred working hours, and earliest possible start date.

10. Include a 60–90 second video introduction explaining your relevant experience and why you would be a good fit.

Please speak naturally and do not read from a script.

Paid Practical Test

Strong applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical test before a final hiring decision is made.

The test will be based on the actual responsibilities of this position, including research, buyer/contact verification, dormant account reactivation, CRM organization, invoice/payment tracking, written communication, AI-assisted research, growth support, and business judgment.

AI use will be allowed and expected during the test, but candidates will be evaluated on how well they verify information, apply judgment, and improve AI-generated work rather than simply copying it.

We want to see how you research, think, prioritize, verify information, organize work, communicate, and solve realistic business problems.

• 6:00 AM–7:00 PM Manila time

• 12 paid hours per day / 72 paid hours per week

• Sunday is the weekly rest day

• Reliable attendance and full availability throughout the scheduled shift are essential



COMPENSATION

• PHP 110,000–120,000 per month, depending on directly relevant experience and demonstrated skill

• Compensation reflects the experience required and the extended work schedule



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Coordinate and dispatch drivers, trucks, loads, pickups, and deliveries

• Monitor routes, ETAs, appointments, and load status throughout the shift

• Communicate professionally with drivers, customers, brokers, and company management by phone,
, and messaging

• Provide prompt updates and accurate information to customers

• Respond quickly to delays, breakdowns, missed appointments, route changes, and other time-sensitive issues

• Prioritize multiple active situations while remaining calm and organized

• Update the TMS, CRM, dispatch software, spreadsheets, and internal records accurately and in real time

• Help improve dispatch procedures, communication, and customer experience

7. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Saturday, 6:00 AM–7:00 PM Manila time



Applications missing the voice recording or schedule confirmation will not be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a live spoken-English interview and a practical dispatch/logistics scenario.

s. They will identify the right organizations and decision-makers, understand why each prospect may benefit from ARTiSTORY, and use ChatGPT and sales technology to deliver relevant, carefully personalized engagement at scale.

title: Marketing / Social Media VA — Video Editor
description:
Marketing / Social Media VA — Video Editor

Role: Marketing / Social Media VA

Work Setup: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation: $5–$8/hour 



About the Role

We are looking for a reliable Marketing / Social Media VA with strong video editing skills to support the

production of podcast, interview, and social media content.

You will take raw long-form recordings and turn them into polished, publish-ready episodes, while also

creating engaging short-form clips for social media and marketing. This role is ideal for someone who is

detail-oriented, consistent with deadlines, and comfortable working independently in an asynchronous

environment.



Key Responsibilities

Edit raw podcast and interview recordings into polished, publish-ready long-form episodes.

Remove dead air, unnecessary sections, awkward pauses, and other distracting footage.

Trim and clean up intros and outros.

Improve and clean audio quality where needed.

Create 3–5 short-form video clips from each long-form episode for social media and marketing use.

Add captions/subtitles to videos intended for YouTube and social media.

Prepare the complete video for YouTube publishing, including appropriate formatting and

presentation.



Create compelling YouTube thumbnails for each episode.

Upload or deliver finished content to the client's website, CMS, or designated platform.

Organize and properly hand off completed files through Google Drive/Google Suite or other

designated systems.



Communicate through Slack and promptly flag any audio, video, technical, or content issues.

Maintain a consistent weekly production schedule and meet agreed turnaround times.

Help reduce the client's personal editing workload by independently handling the end-to-end editing

process.



Essential Qualifications

Proven experience editing long-form videos, podcasts, interviews, or similar content.

Strong ability to identify and remove dead air, unnecessary sections, and awkward pauses.

Experience cleaning up and improving audio quality.

Ability to turn long-form recordings into engaging short-form social media clips.

Experience adding captions/subtitles to video content.

Ability to create or prepare YouTube thumbnails.

Comfortable working asynchronously using Slack and Google Suite/Google Drive.

Highly reliable and able to consistently meet recurring weekly deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience using Riverside.fm.

Experience uploading or publishing video content to a website or CMS.

Basic understanding of AI tools, AI workflows, or automation tools.

Previous experience creating content for a coaching, consulting, B2B, or professional services

brand.

Experience editing content specifically for YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, or other social

platforms.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this role will be measured by:

48–72 hour turnaround: Deliver each completed long-form episode within 48–72 hours of receiving

the raw recording.

Consistent weekly output: Produce publish-ready long-form episodes and accompanying short

form clips every week.

3–5 short-form clips per episode: Create 3–5 usable social media clips from each long-form

recording.

YouTube-ready content: Deliver fully edited videos with captions and supporting assets required for

publishing.

Thumbnail completion: Provide a suitable YouTube thumbnail for each episode.

Quality: Deliver clean, polished, publish-ready content with minimal revisions required.

Issue identification: Proactively flag audio, video, or content issues rather than allowing problems

to reach the publishing stage.

Time savings: Reduce the client's current 1–2 hours of editing time per episode to effectively

zero through reliable end-to-end ownership of the editing workflow.



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who can take a raw podcast or interview recording, understand what needs

to be cleaned up, and independently turn it into a complete content package:

Raw Recording → Edited Long-Form Episode → Captioned YouTube Video → YouTube Thumbnail → 3–5

Short-Form Clips → Ready for Publishing

You should be comfortable owning the process from receiving the raw footage to delivering final, publish

ready assets.

2



How to Apply

Please provide:

Your resume or relevant work experience.

A portfolio showcasing long-form podcast/interview editing.

Examples of short-form clips created from long-form content.

Examples of YouTube videos and thumbnails, if available.

Your experience with Riverside.fm, AI/automation tools, and CMS platforms, if applicable.

Your availability and expected weekly capacity

title: Real Estate Closing Coordinator (U.S. Residential)
description:
About AIK Property Group



AIK Property Group is a residential real estate development company based in New York. We acquire, renovate, and sell homes while working closely with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, nonprofit organizations, and housing grant agencies.



We're looking for an experienced Real Estate Closing Coordinator who can take ownership of the transaction process and ensure every deal moves efficiently from contract execution to a successful closing.



We're seeking someone who already understands U.S. residential real estate transactions and can demonstrate that experience.



---



Your Mission



Your job is simple:



Keep every transaction moving toward closing.



You'll be responsible for coordinating multiple active transactions, anticipating issues before they become delays, following up relentlessly, and ensuring every party involved remains accountable.



You should always know:



* Which transactions are on track.

* Which transactions are at risk.

* What documents or approvals are outstanding.

* Who is responsible for the next action.

* What needs to happen today to move every file forward.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership—not someone who waits for instructions.



---



Key Responsibilities



* Coordinate residential real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

* Manage multiple active transactions while maintaining accuracy and organization.

* Maintain transaction timelines and monitor all critical deadlines.

* Coordinate with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, contractors, grant administrators, and internal team members.

* Collect, organize, review, and track all required transaction documentation.

* Proactively identify and resolve issues that could delay closing.

* Maintain complete and organized transaction records.

* Provide accurate and timely updates on every active transaction.

* Ensure every transaction continues progressing until funding and closing are complete.



---



# What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of:



* U.S. residential real estate transactions

* Contract-to-close coordination

* Title and attorney coordination

* Lender communication and requirements

* Closing timelines and deadlines

* Document collection and compliance

* Managing multiple transactions simultaneously



You should also be comfortable learning and working within AIK Property Group's systems, including the **Greater Capital Association of REALTORS® (GCAR)** platform and other transaction management tools used by our team.



---



# Minimum Qualifications



* Minimum **3 years of experience** coordinating U.S. residential real estate transactions.

* Proven ability to successfully manage multiple active transactions simultaneously.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.

* Highly dependable, responsive, and detail-oriented.

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.



---



# Application Requirements



We value demonstrated experience over résumé claims.



To be considered, your application must include all of the following:



* Updated résumé.

* Brief cover letter summarizing your real estate closing experience.

* Supporting evidence that demonstrates your transaction coordination experience.



Applications submitted without supporting evidence will not be reviewed.



---



# Interview Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in a Transaction Case Review



During this session, you will be asked to share your screen and walk us through a completed transaction that you coordinated (using a redacted file or recreated workflow if necessary).



This is not intended to test memorization. We want to understand how you think, communicate, solve problems, and manage real-world transactions.



---



# What Success Looks Like



A successful Closing Coordinator:



* Keeps transactions moving without constant supervision.

* Anticipates issues before they become closing delays.

* Maintains proactive communication with every stakeholder.

* Keeps organized and accurate transaction files.

* Meets deadlines consistently.

* Takes ownership of every transaction from contract to closing.



When someone asks about the status of a file, you already know the answer.



---



# Who Will Thrive in This Role



You'll be a great fit if you are:



* Proactive.

* Organized.

* Reliable.

* Detail-oriented.

* Accountable.

* Calm under pressure.

* Comfortable making decisions and taking ownership.

* Committed to delivering successful closings—not simply completing assigned tasks.



---



# How to Apply



Please
 your application to:







**Required
 Subject Format**



**Closing Coordinator – F. LAST NAME**



**Example:** `Closing Coordinator – J. DELA CRUZ`



Applications that do not follow the required subject format or do not include the requested supporting documentation may not be considered.



---



Our Hiring Philosophy



At AIK Property Group, we hire based on capability, ownership, reliability, and demonstrated experience—not résumé claims alone.



If you're someone who takes pride in keeping transactions organized, solving problems before they become obstacles, and ensuring every closing reaches the finish line, we'd love to hear from you.
