title: Full-Time Cold Caller – U.S. Vacant Land Real Estate
description:
We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a professional, motivated, full-time Cold Caller to join our growing team.



Your primary responsibility will be calling owners of vacant land from targeted lists, following our provided script, identifying motivated sellers, collecting specific information, and submitting qualified leads through our CRM webform.



This is a long-term position for the right person. We are looking for someone dependable, coachable, naturally warm and friendly on the phone, and interested in growing with our company. The right caller should make property owners feel comfortable and respected—not sound robotic, aggressive, or pushy.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make high-volume outbound calls to U.S. vacant-land owners

- Follow our provided cold-calling script consistently

- Speak professionally and confidently with property owners

- Identify owners interested in selling

- Ask all required qualification questions

- Gather seller price expectations, negotiability, timeline, motivation, and property information

- Enter qualified leads accurately into our CRM webform

- Keep seller names, phone numbers, property information, and notes accurate and organized

- Meet daily activity and qualified-lead goals

- Communicate with management regarding performance, list quality, and issues



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken and written English

- Clear, confident, professional phone voice

- Naturally warm, pleasant, and friendly conversational style

- Previous cold-calling, telemarketing, sales, or real-estate experience strongly preferred

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day

- Able to follow a script without constantly changing or improvising it

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet, professional workspace

- Dependable computer and headset

- Reliable attendance

- Available to work U.S. business hours

- Full-time availability — 40 hours per week

- Coachable, positive attitude and willing to receive call feedback



Vacant-land experience is helpful but not required. We will provide training, scripts, systems, and clear expectations.



COMPENSATION



Starting pay is four to five U.S. dollars per hour, depending on relevant experience and performance.



40 hours per week, Monday–Friday.



BONUS INCENTIVES



In addition to hourly pay, bonus incentives will be awarded when a qualified lead you generate results in a successfully closed real estate deal. Lead attribution will be tracked through our CRM, so accurate notes and lead submission are essential. Bonus details and eligibility will be explained during the interview.



There will be an initial training and performance evaluation period.



CONFIDENTIALITY



This is a trusted position involving confidential business, seller, property, lead, CRM, and company information.



The selected candidate will be required to sign a Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement before receiving access to company systems or proprietary information.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Send a basic résumé summarizing your relevant work experience.

2. Briefly describe your cold-calling, appointment-setting, or sales experience.

3. Tell us what types of campaigns or industries you have called for.

4. Confirm that you are available to work 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours.

5. Tell us what equipment, internet connection, and backup internet/power you have.

6. Include a 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong cold caller for this position.

7. Confirm whether you are available for a group video interview Saturday, August 22, 2026 at 8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time / Sunday, August 23, 2026 at 8:00 AM Philippine Time.



Shortlisted applicants will receive the private Google Meet or Zoom interview link through OnlineJobs.ph. Please do not request the link unless you are invited.



IMPORTANT: Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.



We are looking to hire quickly and begin training immediately.

title: Content Creator & Content Strategist
description:
Content Creator & Content Strategist



Brands: Harvey House Media + Home of the Harveys

Position: Content Creator & Content Strategist

Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract



About the Role



We’re looking for a highly creative, organized, and strategic Content Creator & Content Strategist to work across both Harvey House Media and Home of the Harveys.



This is a unique role because you'll work on two sides of the content world:



Harvey House Media — Helping businesses and brands develop content strategies, tell their stories, grow their online presence, and create content that supports real business goals.



Home of the Harveys — Helping develop and capture engaging family, lifestyle, faith, parenting, travel, brand partnership, and everyday storytelling content across our social platforms.



We aren't simply looking for someone who can hold a camera or follow trends. We want someone who can think creatively, recognize great content opportunities, and help turn ideas into stories people actually want to watch.



What You'll Do

Content Strategy & Creative Ideation

Brainstorm fresh content ideas for both Harvey House Media clients and Home of the Harveys.

Help develop monthly and weekly content strategies.

Create concepts, hooks, series, campaigns, and storytelling ideas.

Stay aware of social trends and identify which ones make sense for each brand.

Research industries, competitors, creators, and emerging content styles.

Help develop content calendars and organize ideas for execution.

Look at performance and help determine what's working, what isn't, and what we should try next.

Think beyond views and likes by connecting content to larger brand and business objectives.

Harvey House Media



You'll help us take what we learn about a client's business and turn it into an intentional content plan.



Responsibilities may include:



Participating in client discovery and strategy meetings.

Learning each client's business, audience, goals, voice, products, and services.

Developing content ideas based on the client's actual business objectives.

Preparing creative concepts and shot lists for content days.

Helping lead and execute client content shoots.

Directing clients on camera and helping them communicate naturally.

Capturing short-form videos, photos, testimonials, educational content, behind-the-scenes footage, promotional content, and brand stories.

Collaborating with editors to ensure the finished content matches the strategy.

Helping turn one content day into weeks or months of strategic content.

Home of the Harveys



You'll also become part of the creative process behind our personal family brand.



Responsibilities may include:



Helping brainstorm family and lifestyle content.

Identifying everyday moments that could become great stories.

Helping develop Reels, Shorts, YouTube concepts, social posts, and recurring series.

Capturing family activities, travel, events, behind-the-scenes moments, and lifestyle content.

Assisting with sponsored brand campaigns and deliverables.

Helping develop creative concepts that naturally integrate brand partners into our content.

Creating shot lists and helping ensure required campaign content is captured.

Helping organize and manage our content pipeline so ideas don't get lost.

Finding creative ways to turn one experience or filming session into multiple pieces of content.



Because you'll be working closely with our family, trust, professionalism, discretion, and understanding personal boundaries are extremely important for this position.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is both a creator and a thinker.



You should be able to walk into a client meeting, family outing, business, event, or content shoot and naturally start thinking:



"There's a story here."



"That would make a great Reel."



"Here's the hook."



"We could turn this into a series."



"Here's how we can capture this once and create five pieces of content from it."



The ideal candidate:



Naturally comes up with creative ideas.

Understands social media culture and current trends.

Has strong storytelling instincts.

Can think strategically about why content is being created.

Is comfortable filming both businesses and people.

Can confidently provide creative direction.

Is comfortable working around a family and children while maintaining professionalism and appropriate boundaries.

Understands the difference between organic lifestyle content and polished brand content.

Can manage multiple brands and projects simultaneously.

Takes initiative instead of constantly waiting for instructions.

Is organized, dependable, flexible, and communicates well.

Can receive feedback and quickly make adjustments.

Understands that great content should ultimately serve a larger purpose.

Preferred Skills



Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:



Instagram

TikTok

YouTube / YouTube Shorts

Short-form video production

Social media strategy

Photography and videography

Creative direction

Content calendars

Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut

Canva

Copywriting

Scriptwriting

Trend research

Social analytics

Brand partnership / sponsored content

Influencer or creator marketing



Agency, creator, or social media experience is a plus, but creativity, character, initiative, strategic thinking, and storytelling ability matter greatly to us.



What Success Looks Like



Success isn't simply posting more content.



We want someone who helps both brands become more intentional, creative, consistent, and effective.



For Harvey House Media, that means helping our clients create content that strengthens their brands and supports measurable business goals.



For Home of the Harveys, that means helping us consistently tell meaningful, entertaining, relatable stories while maintaining the authenticity that makes our community connect with our family.



Ultimately, we're looking for someone who can help us answer:



What should we create? Why should people care? How do we tell the story well? And how can we turn the idea into great content?



To Apply



Please send:



Your resume

A portfolio or examples of content you've created

Social media accounts you've helped create content for or manage

Examples of short-form videos you've filmed and/or developed

2–3 creators or brands whose content strategy you admire

We're looking for someone who wants to create, strategize, tell great stories, work with great brands, and help build something special alongside us.

description:
Position Summary

The Supply Chain & Logistics Coordinator is responsible for monitoring inbound shipments, coordinating with suppliers and freight partners, maintaining shipment visibility, ensuring timely document flow, and providing operational reports to support business continuity and inventory availability.



Key Responsibilities

1. Shipment Monitoring & Tracking

• Monitor all inbound shipments from supplier dispatch through final delivery. 

• Maintain and update shipment tracking reports. 

• Provide regular shipment status updates to management. 

• Identify and escalate shipment delays, missing documentation, and logistics issues. 

• Follow up with suppliers, freight forwarders, brokers, and warehouses regarding shipment progress. 

2. Logistics Coordination

• Coordinate shipment schedules with suppliers and logistics partners. 

• Track container movements and air shipments. 

• Assist in managing shipping timelines and expected arrival dates. 

• Ensure all parties are informed of shipment status changes. 

3. Documentation Management

• Collect, organize, and maintain shipment documentation, including: 

o Commercial Invoices 

o Packing Lists 

o Bills of Lading 

o Air Waybills 

o Customs documents 

• Verify completeness of shipping documents before clearance. 

• Coordinate document submission to brokers and relevant stakeholders. 

4. Operational Reporting

• Prepare shipment status reports and logistics summaries. 

• Maintain shipment trackers and operational dashboards. 

• Provide management with updates on pending, delayed, and completed shipments. 

• Assist in data gathering and reporting for business operations. 

5. Cross-Functional Coordination

• Liaise with suppliers, freight forwarders, brokers, warehouses, and internal teams. 

• Follow up on outstanding actions required for shipment movement and clearance. 

• Support resolution of logistics and documentation issues. 

6. Process Improvement

• Recommend improvements to shipment tracking and reporting processes. 

• Assist in maintaining accurate logistics records and operational procedures. 

• Support implementation of supply chain tracking tools and systems. 

7. Business Support Projects

• Conduct supplier and service provider research as requested.

title: Lead Generation
description:
# Ads & Lead Generation Manager



**Company:** Refined Touch Media

**Position:** Ads & Lead Generation Manager

**Location:** Remote

**Hours:** Part-time to start, with potential for increased responsibility

**Compensation:** Based on experience



## Help Us Generate Better Leads—not Just More Leads



Refined Touch Media helps businesses grow through paid advertising, creative, and lead-generation systems.



We're looking for an **Ads & Lead Generation Manager** to take ownership of our Meta and Google Ads campaigns.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys looking at a campaign and asking:



* Why did performance change?

* Are we attracting the right people?

* Where is the funnel breaking down?

* What should we test next?

* Is the client receiving real opportunities—not just cheap leads?



You won't be expected to simply launch campaigns, follow instructions, or send reports.



You'll be expected to **think, diagnose, communicate, and improve performance.**



## What You'll Own



You will help manage paid lead-generation campaigns for Refined Touch Media and our clients, including:



* Meta Ads

* Google Ads

* Prospecting and retargeting

* Audience and keyword strategy

* Campaign structure

* Budget allocation

* Creative testing

* Landing pages and lead forms

* Conversion tracking

* Lead quality

* Ongoing optimization and reporting



Your main responsibility will be to take paid advertising execution and optimization off the owner's plate while improving the quality and consistency of the leads our campaigns generate.



## What This Role Looks Like



You may start your day by reviewing campaign performance and noticing that CPL has increased.



Instead of immediately changing the campaign, you'll investigate:



* Whether the audience has become saturated

* Whether CPM, CTR, CPC, or conversion rate changed

* Whether the offer or creative is losing relevance

* Whether the landing page or lead form is converting differently

* Whether tracking is working correctly

* Whether lead quality has changed

* Whether the client's sales process is affecting results



Then you'll communicate what you found and recommend the next action.



We want someone who can say:



> "The campaign is still generating clicks at a reasonable cost, but the landing-page conversion rate has declined. Before increasing the budget, I recommend testing a new headline and a stronger problem-focused creative angle."



Not simply:



> "We need new ads."



## Key Responsibilities



### Campaign Management



* Build and manage lead-generation campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads

* Develop campaign strategies based on the client's business, audience, offer, market, and goals

* Research audiences, keywords, search intent, and competitors where appropriate

* Build prospecting and retargeting campaigns

* Recommend campaign structures, budgets, offers, and testing plans

* Monitor campaigns and identify opportunities for improvement

* Manage multiple accounts in an organized and dependable way



### Optimization and Diagnosis



Regularly review campaign performance and determine:



* What is working

* What is not working

* Why performance may have changed

* What should be tested next

* Where budget should be increased, decreased, or reallocated



You may optimize:



* Audiences

* Keywords and search terms

* Locations

* Placements

* Creative

* Copy

* Offers

* Landing pages

* Lead forms

* Retargeting

* Bidding strategies

* Campaign structure



We expect you to **diagnose before making changes**.



### Lead Quality



We care about lead quality, not just lead volume.



A $15 lead that never answers the phone may be less valuable than a $40 lead that becomes a customer.



You should be comfortable looking beyond CPL and evaluating:



* Whether leads match the target customer

* Whether leads are responding to follow-up

* Whether leads are qualified

* Whether the campaign is attracting the right intent

* Whether the offer or form is creating low-quality submissions

* Whether the sales process is affecting the final result



### Tracking and Reporting



* Monitor CPL, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, ROAS, and other relevant metrics

* Verify that conversion tracking is working properly

* Identify discrepancies between platform data and actual leads

* Track tests and document what changed and why

* Communicate performance clearly

* Provide recommendations—not just reports



### Creative Collaboration



You will work with our creative and marketing team.



You are not expected to personally create every video, graphic, or landing page. However, you should be able to identify when creative, messaging, or the offer may be limiting performance.



You should be able to provide useful direction, such as:



* The audience or problem we should focus on

* The hook or angle to test

* The objection the creative should address

* The call to action

* The format or placement to prioritize

* Why the recommendation may improve performance



## What We're Looking For



* Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads

* Hands-on experience managing Google Ads

* Experience with lead-generation campaigns

* Strong understanding of targeting and retargeting

* Experience diagnosing underperforming campaigns

* Understanding of conversion tracking

* Understanding of landing-page and lead-form conversion principles

* Ability to interpret data and make practical recommendations

* Strong written and verbal communication

* Ability to manage multiple accounts

* Organized, dependable, and comfortable working independently

* Willingness to take ownership rather than wait for detailed instructions



You do not need to know every feature inside Meta and Google.



You do need to understand **why you're using a particular strategy and how to determine whether it is working.**



## Who Will Succeed in This Role?



**Proactive**

You identify problems and opportunities without waiting to be told what to do.



**Analytical**

You use data, context, and testing rather than making changes based on instinct alone.



**Curious**

When performance changes, your first instinct is to investigate why.



**Strategic**

You understand that advertising performance depends on the audience, offer, creative, landing page, follow-up, and sales process—not just Ads Manager.



**Accountable**

You communicate problems clearly and develop a plan to improve them.



**Collaborative**

You can work effectively with strategists, designers, video editors, copywriters, and clients.



## What We Offer



**Trust-Based Environment**

We care about performance, communication, and completed work—not micromanaging your day.



**Flexible Working Hours**

Manage your schedule while remaining available for agreed-upon meetings, communication, and deadlines.



**Part-Time Start With Growth Potential**

This role is expected to begin part-time, with the opportunity to take on more responsibility as our client base and advertising department grow.



**Creative Support**

You won't be expected to solve every creative problem yourself. You'll have support from our creative and marketing team and the ability to request the assets campaigns need.



**Performance Reviews**

Regular reviews with opportunities for increased responsibility and performance-based incentives.



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume, portfolio, and brief answers to the questions below.



We are not looking for polished, generic, or AI-generated answers. We want to understand how you actually think about campaigns.



### 1. Campaign Diagnosis



A Meta lead-generation campaign has been running successfully for two months. Cost per lead suddenly increases by 60% over the next three weeks.



Walk us through how you would diagnose the problem before making changes.



What would you look at first, second, and third?



### 2. Lead Quality



A campaign is producing a high volume of inexpensive leads, but the client's sales team says most leads are not answering their phones or are not qualified.



How would you investigate and improve the campaign?



### 3. Targeting



Describe how you would determine who to target when launching a new Meta or Google Ads campaign for a service-based business.



What information would you want before building the campaign?



### 4. Retargeting



How do you approach retargeting?



What audiences would you consider creating, and how would your messaging differ between someone who has never heard of the company and someone who has already visited the website or engaged with an ad?



### 5. Optimization



Once a campaign is live, what is your process for improving it?



Explain how you d
:



* What to test

* When to make changes

* When to leave something alone

* When to increase the budget

* When to pause an ad, audience, keyword, or campaign



### 6. Creative Strategy



If you believe poor creative is hurting campaign performance, how would you communicate what you need from our creative team?



Provide an example of a creative recommendation or brief you would give them.



### 7. Experience



Please provide examples of campaigns you've personally managed, including where possible:



* Platform

* Industry

* Approximate advertising spend

* Campaign objective

* Cost per lead or acquisition

* What you changed

* Result after your changes



We care less about impressive screenshots and more about understanding what you personally contributed to the result.



## Final Note



We're not looking for someone who only knows where the buttons are in Meta and Google.



We're looking for someone who understands **why they're pressing them.**



If you enjoy analyzing campaigns, testing ideas, solving problems, and finding ways to generate better opportunities for businesses, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Mid-Level Shopify Developer / Technical SEO Specialist
description:
is looking for an experienced Mid-Level Shopify Developer / Technical SEO Specialist to take ownership of our website's technical development, performance, and SEO.



This is a hands-on position for someone who already has a strong understanding of Shopify development and technical SEO and can work independently to identify problems, determine the appropriate solutions, implement improvements, and measure the results.



You will be responsible for the day-to-day technical health of our Shopify website, working alongside our content and marketing team and an outside SEO consultant who will provide strategic guidance.



We are looking for someone who can step into the role and take ownership — not someone who needs training in technical SEO.



What You'll Do



Shopify Development

-Customize, maintain, and improve our Shopify theme

-Write, modify, and troubleshoot Shopify Liquid

-Develop and implement custom theme sections, templates, and functionality

-Make HTML, CSS, and JavaScript updates as needed

-Troubleshoot website issues and identify the root cause of technical problems

-Implement website improvements that enhance performance, usability, and the customer experience

-Work with Shopify products, collections, navigation, metafields, templates, and other site structures



Technical SEO & Website Performance

-Take ownership of the site's day-to-day technical SEO

-Independently audit the website to identify technical SEO issues and opportunities

-Monitor and improve page speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall website performance

-Identify and resolve issues affecting crawling, indexing, and organic search visibility

-Optimize Shopify theme code, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, scripts, and other technical elements that affect site performance

-Manage technical SEO elements, including canonical tags, redirects, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, metadata, and indexing

-Implement and maintain structured data/schema markup

-Identify and resolve duplicate content, URL structure, and other technical SEO issues

-Evaluate site architecture and internal linking from a technical SEO perspective

-Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and search performance issues

-Use SEMrush to perform technical SEO audits, monitor site health, identify issues, and track improvements

-Use tools such as PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and SEMrush to diagnose problems and measure results

-Stay current with Shopify, Google, and technical SEO best practices

-Reporting & Measuring Results



An important part of this role is demonstrating the impact of your work.



You will be expected to:

-Establish baseline performance and SEO metrics

-Create and maintain regular reports documenting technical SEO work and website improvements

-Clearly explain what issues were identified, what actions were taken, and why

-Track the results of technical changes over time

-Use data from SEMrush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and other tools to measure progress

-Identify additional opportunities for improvement based on performance data

-Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to the website and management teams



We don't expect you to simply tell us that the website is improving — we want to understand what you found, what you changed, and how the data demonstrates the impact.



What We're Looking For



Required:



-Proven professional experience with Shopify development

-Strong hands-on experience with Shopify Liquid

-Demonstrated experience with technical SEO, preferably for an e-commerce website

-Experience independently conducting technical SEO audits and implementing solutions

-Strong understanding of website performance optimization and Core Web Vitals

-Experience diagnosing and resolving technical SEO issues rather than simply identifying them

-Experience with SEMrush or a comparable professional SEO platform

-Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics

-Strong HTML and CSS skills

-Working knowledge of JavaScript

-Understanding of crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, redirects, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, and site architecture

-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

-Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from identification through implementation and measurement

-Ability to communicate technical findings and results clearly to non-technical team members



Preferred:



-Experience with Shopify Plus

-Experience optimizing large e-commerce websites

-Experience improving Core Web Vitals and Shopify site speed

-Experience with SEMrush or similar technical SEO crawling tools

-Experience working with Google Tag Manager and analytics/tracking implementations

-Experience working with SEO consultants or agencies



This Is a Hands-On Role



We already have a content writer who handles our content needs, so this position is not primarily focused on writing content, blog posts, or product descriptions.



We also have an outside SEO consultant who can provide strategic direction and recommendations. However, the person in this position will be responsible for the day-to-day technical execution and ongoing management of our website's SEO and performance.



We're looking for someone who can review a website, identify when something isn't right, investigate the cause, determine the best solution, implement the fix, and measure the results.



You should be comfortable working independently and bringing problems and opportunities to the team rather than waiting for someone else to identify them.



Compensation & Benefits



Salary: 1,500 USD per Month



Benefits: 5 days of paid vacation, Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid holidays, 13th check in December, raise and bonus based on performance on the anniversary of your hire date. 



Schedule: 8 AM to 4 PM EST until work is established. Depending on performance, the schedule may be adjusted to your preferred hours at a later date. 



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and include examples of Shopify development and/or technical SEO work you have completed. If possible, provide examples of websites you have helped improve and describe the technical issues you identified, the solutions you implemented, and the results. If you have a sample technical SEO audit/report you have created previously, with the confidential information removed, please include it in your application.

Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time

Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as PropStream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins

title: Junior AI Automation Specialist – n8n & AI Tools
description:
# Junior AI Automation Specialist – n8n & AI Tools



**Remote | Full-Time | Philippines**

**Entry-Level / Junior Position**



## About Us



We are a growing cabinetry and custom millwork company based in San Jose, California. Our team works across sales, marketing, design, estimating, manufacturing, installation, customer service, and business operations.



We are actively introducing AI and automation into our daily workflows and are looking for a **Junior AI Automation Specialist** to help us build, test, maintain, and improve practical AI-powered tools and automations.



This is a **junior-level position**.



We are **not looking for a senior AI engineer or an expert who already knows everything**.



We are looking for someone who is technically curious, logical, reliable, and excited about figuring out how AI and automation can solve real business problems.



If you enjoy experimenting with ChatGPT, Claude, n8n, APIs, automation tools, or building small technical projects on your own, we would like to hear from you.



## What You’ll Do



Your main job will be to help turn repetitive manual processes into simple, reliable automated workflows.



You will:



* Build and maintain workflows using **n8n**

* Work with tools such as Make, Zapier, Google Workspace, CRM systems,
 platforms, and other business software

* Connect different applications using APIs and webhooks

* Use AI models such as ChatGPT / OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini inside business workflows

* Build simple AI-powered assistants and internal tools

* Help automate data entry, lead processing, follow-ups, reporting, notifications, and other repetitive tasks

* Use AI to extract, organize, classify, summarize, and process information

* Test automations carefully before deployment

* Troubleshoot and repair workflows when something breaks

* Monitor existing automations and improve their reliability

* Document workflows, logic, account connections, and troubleshooting steps

* Research new AI tools and determine whether they could improve our operations

* Work with our team to understand business problems and translate them into automation workflows



## Examples of Projects You May Work On



You may help us build automations such as:



**Lead Management**



Website inquiry

→ Capture customer information

→ AI classifies the lead

→ Save information to CRM or Google Sheets

→ Notify the correct salesperson

→ Generate a follow-up draft



*
 & Project Information**



Incoming project

→ AI reads the message

→ Extract project name, company, deadline, scope, and contact information

→ Organize the information

→ Create a task or record

→ Notify the appropriate team member



**Sales Follow-Up**



Salesperson enters meeting notes

→ AI organizes the notes

→ Creates a CRM summary

→ Generates a follow-up

→ Schedules a reminder if the customer does not respond



**Reporting**



Collect information from different sources

→ Clean and organize the data

→ Update a dashboard or spreadsheet

→ Generate a simple AI summary for management



**Internal AI Tools**



Build lightweight tools that help our team search information, summarize documents, organize project information, generate drafts, or complete repetitive tasks faster.



These are examples only. Part of the role is continuously identifying other tasks that can be improved through AI and automation.



## Core Tools



You will primarily work with or learn:



* **n8n**

* ChatGPT / OpenAI

* Claude

* Gemini

* Google Sheets

* Gmail / Google Workspace

* APIs

* Webhooks

* JSON

* CRM systems

* Make / Zapier

* GitHub



You may also use AI coding tools such as:



* Claude Code

* Cursor

* Codex

* GitHub Copilot



We do **not** expect you to already be an expert in every tool listed above.



Being able to learn new tools quickly is more important.



## What We’re Looking For



We care strongly about **how you think and learn**, not just how many years of experience you have.



You should be someone who:



* Enjoys solving technical problems

* Likes figuring out how systems work

* Is comfortable learning from documentation, tutorials, YouTube, ChatGPT, Claude, and other resources

* Can break a problem into logical steps

* Tests your work instead of assuming it works

* Pays attention to details

* Is reliable and follows through

* Can work independently after receiving clear direction

* Is comfortable saying, “I don't know yet, but I will figure it out”

* Can explain technical problems in simple English

* Documents what you build

* Is interested in AI and actively experiments with new tools

* Wants to develop long-term skills in AI automation



## Technical Foundation



You should have at least a basic understanding of:



* Automation logic

* APIs

* Webhooks

* JSON

* Data flow between applications

* Basic programming logic



Experience with **JavaScript or Python** is preferred, but you do not need to be an advanced developer.



For example, you should eventually be comfortable using JavaScript or Python for simple tasks such as:



* Formatting data

* Cleaning text

* Manipulating arrays

* Processing JSON

* Working with dates

* Making API requests



Using ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or other AI coding tools to help you write and debug code is encouraged.



## AI Skills



You should have hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.



You should understand or be interested in learning how AI can be used for:



* Information extraction

* Classification

* Summarization

* Structured output

* Content generation

* Data processing

* Prompt design

* AI assistants

* Tool calling

* Simple AI agents



Advanced experience with RAG, MCP, vector databases, or multi-agent systems is **not required** for this position.



You may have opportunities to learn these technologies as your skills develop.



## Education & Experience



Ideal candidates may have:



* 0–2 years of relevant experience

* A degree or current studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field



However, a technical degree is **not required** if you can demonstrate strong hands-on ability.



We welcome:



* Recent graduates

* Students with strong project experience

* Self-taught developers

* Career changers with technical skills

* Candidates who have built personal AI or automation projects



School projects, personal projects, GitHub projects, and experimental automations are all welcome.



## Nice to Have



The following are helpful but **not required**:



* Previous n8n experience

* Make or Zapier

* JavaScript

* Python

* GitHub

* Supabase

* Airtable

* Basic SQL

* CRM integrations

* Web scraping

* Claude Code or Cursor

* Basic database knowledge

* Basic RAG knowledge

* Experience building simple AI agents

* Experience creating internal tools



We want someone with a **good technical foundation and strong learning ability who can grow into more advanced work over time.**



## Schedule



* Full-time remote position

* Philippines-based candidates preferred

* Most technical work can be completed independently

* Some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time will be needed for meetings, project discussions, and testing

* Long-term position for the right person



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. A **1–2 minute Loom video in English** introducing yourself and explaining why AI automation interests you

4. Links to GitHub, portfolio, n8n workflows, or any technical projects you have built, if available



School projects and personal projects are completely acceptable.



Please answer the following questions:



**1. What AI and automation tools have you used?**



**2. Have you used n8n, Make, or Zapier? Tell us about one workflow you have built.**



If you have never used n8n, explain what similar tools you have used.



**3. What is an API? Explain it in simple language as if you were explaining it to a non-technical manager.**



**4. Imagine this workflow:**



A customer submits a form on our website containing their name,
, phone number, company, and message.



We want AI to determine whether the customer is a homeowner, contractor, designer, or builder, save the information, notify the correct salesperson, and prepare a follow-up
.



**Briefly explain how you would build this workflow.**



You do not need to provide code. We want to understand how you think.



**5. Tell us about something technical you did not know how to do at first but taught yourself successfully. How did you figure it out?**



**6. Which AI tool do you currently use the most, and what do you use it for?**



## Practical Test



Candidates who pass the first interview may be invited to complete a **short paid practical test**.



The test may involve building a simple automation using n8n, an AI model, Google Sheets, and an API or webhook.



We care more about your **problem-solving process, logic, testing, and ability to learn** than whether you already know every feature.



## Who Will Do Well Here



You may be a great fit if you are the kind of person who sees a repetitive task and immediately thinks:



**“There has to be a better way to automate this.”**



You don't need to know everything today.



But you should enjoy learning, experimenting, building, testing, fixing, and continuously making systems better.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term as AI becomes a bigger part of how our company operates.

title: Video Editor — Short-Form / Instagram (Full-Time, Remote) — The Robot Studio

- 1+ year editing short-form vertical content, with live posted work we can look up

  not the tool

- Strong instinct for the first 2 seconds: you know why a video gets scrolled past

- At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time

- Working English for briefs, feedback, and a weekly call

- Reliable power and internet — you'll be pulling down large video files daily



NICE TO HAVE

- Motion graphics (After Effects) for lower thirds, spec callouts, transitions

- Sound design chops — servo whir, footfalls, and impact hits matter to us

- Interest in robotics, AI, or tech content



DETAILS

- Full-time, 40 hours/week, fully remote

- Compensation discussed at interview, based on experience

- Paid [weekly/biweekly] via [Wise / Deel / PayPal]

- Long-term role — we run events year-round and this account is a priority for us



TO APPLY


 
 

subject line "Video Editor — [your name]", and

include: instagram links of videos you edited and got posted. doesnt matter personal account or someone else's account. it must be video you have edited and performed well.



1. Direct Instagram links to 5 videos you edited that are actually posted and
